## US-2291 — Upload welder qualification certificate

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-2291 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | s.gayathri4 |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Welding\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 3 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/2291) |

### Description

As a WE3, I want to upload valid certificate of a welder, So that system should generate welder certificate automatically and improve productivity and process efficiency.

### Acceptance Criteria

Pre-requisite(s): 
WE3 can login to the portal and can navigate to "Welder Master List" screen.
  

**_Functional_**
  1. Click on "ASME WQR" to view the WML list and select "WML list". (Ref- Snapshot "WML Navigation"). 
  2. Upon Clicking "WML List", User can able to view the Maintain welder Master List screen. Ref - Snapshot "Maintain welder Master list". 
  3. User can able to select location and WML type from the drop down list , Where system will fetch welder master list. (Ref- Snapshot "Generating details of WML") 
  4. Welding Engineer should have provision to upload the welder certificate in "Welder Master List" screen under Action column as shown in the screen "Maintain welder Master List ". (Ref - Snap shot "Add Certificate").
  5. The WQT number in the certificate to be uploaded must match with the WQT number displayed under WQT column of the welder in that row.  (Client provided Different templates of welder certificate and same is uploaded as a Reference in attachment). Separate User story shall be drafted.
  6. Only PDF should be allowed to upload.
  7. Type of upload - Drag and drop or Upload? -  Client confirm Drag and drop upload. ( Ref the Screenshot "Drag and Drop" where Client use to upload same format)
  8. Size of the file uploaded should be < size. Client confirmed to upto 50 MB.
  9. After successful upload, system should display the message "Document added successfully".  (Location of files to be discussed)  POD team discussed with Thrishul)
  10. If upload is not successful due to size violation, system should display the message “File is too big (50.09MiB). Max filesize: 50MiB".
  11. If upload is not successful due to format violation, system should display the message “File should be one of the following types: .pdf". 
  12. Only a single file should be allowed to upload.  

  13. User should be able to delete an uploaded file. - Confirmed by client to delete provision.
  14. If User uploads a file without deleting an existing certificate that was already present, system should display the message "Certificate is already uploaded, do you want to replace" with an Yes/No option.


     1. Upon clicking Yes, System should replace the existing certificate with the new certificate.
     2. Upon clicking No, System should close the dialog and no changes should happen in the system.


 
**_Performance  _**
NA
 
**_Security_**
NA
 
**_Usability  _**
NA​

## US-2499 — Clear/Reject Under action Column

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-2499 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | s.gayathri4 |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Manufacturing\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 5 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/2499) |

### Description

As a QI3 user, If results are not adequate, I want to reject/return the stages of specific seam, So that It will help to PROD3 for rework.

### Acceptance Criteria

Pre-requisite(s):
  1. QI3 can login to the portal.
  2. QI3 can clear the test results of ferrite and weld visual stage in "Seam list details" screen.


Note: 
Navigation Details Here...: IEMQS Dashboard--> In process Inspection--> Test Result for Inspection seam--> "Seam list details" Page--> Click on "Clear"/ Reject in action item.


**_Functional_**
  1. If user come to conclusion that results are adequate or not adequate, Where user can able to clear/reject the test results flow mentioned below. 
     1. User can able to click reject/return in attend seam test result screen. (Refer snapshot "Individual Clear/Reject").
     2. User can able to click Clear/reject button under action, System will pop-up a new screen "Clear/Reject Confirmation". (Refer Screenshot "Clear Confirmation")​.
        1. User should able to fill "QC remarks".
        2. User have a "Yes" or No" Button.
        3. User select "Yes" Button System will show a message that "Seam Successfully Rejected", System shall follow the logic described below:
           1. If Weld Visual and Ferrite **Both Cleared,**  then system will go with the next stage which is defined in seam ICL.
              1. System will pop-up a message that "Seam Successfully cleared".
           2. If Weld Visual **Cleared**  and Ferrite **Rejected** , then Weld Visual stage and ferrite stage Reject automatically and both stages back to Production tray for Re-Offer.
              1. System will pop-up a message that "Ferrite and Weld visual is rejected".
           3. If Weld Visual **Rejected**  and Ferrite **Cleared** , Later Weld Visual will be Rejected and Visual stage will be back to Production tray for Re-Offer.
              1. System will pop-up a message that "Ferrite is cleared and Weld visual is rejected".
           4. If Weld Visual and Ferrite **Both Rejected** , then both stages go to Rejected and both stages back to offer for inspection-seam for Re-Offer.
              1. System will pop-up a message that "Seam Successfully rejected".
        4. User select "No" Button " System should close the dialog and System will display seam list details Screen.

## US-2572 — Generate the consolidated files ProjectWise-Joint type

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-2572 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Rajeshwari Ariappan |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Welding\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 6 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/2572) |

### Description

As a WE2 user, I want to generate consolidated list of certificates of all the welders as well as welder list, so that it will help in the final dossier submission.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite(s):_**
****
  1. WE2 user can login and navigate to "IEMQS Dashboard"
  2. Welder Project assignment details are displayed in the "Token List" screen.


Navigation Details: WE2 Login--> IEMQS Dashboard--> Select Project no.-->Click "Mega Menu"\-->Click "Welder Master details"\--> "Welder Master Details" Page
  
  

_Functional:_
  1. Generation of files depends on the joint type.
     1. If user select one or more project no. and one joint type then one "certificate binder" and one "welder list" should be generated.
     2. If user select one or more project no. and two joint types then two "certificate binder" and "two "welder list" should be generated.
  2. After selection of Project no. and Joint type user will click on the “Generate” button on shown on in the screen "Selection check box_WMD".  

  3. On clicking "Generate" button, files are generated
     1. Consolidated pdf file must be generated as shown in the pdf "S040851-Welder's Groove WPQ.pdf" and "S040851-Welder's Overlay WPQ".
        1. Pdf name should be      Project No.-Welder Certificate-Joint Type.   
        2. Example:                               SO4951A-Welder Certificates-<Overlay>.pdf        
     2. Excel file must be generated as shown in the attachment "Welder List.xlsx" and format like "Welder list.pdf"
        1. Name should be           Project No.-Welder List-Joint Type  

        2. Example:                                SO4951A-Welder List-<Overlay>.xlsx
        3. Standard format attached "Welder List.xlsx" .
     3. If user will selects multiple project no. then in table also file names will be:
        1. In table project no. column it shows, "First Project No._Last Project No.".
        2. For certificate binder file name as  "First Project No._Last Project No.-Welder Certificates-<Overlay>.pdf"
        3. For welder list file name as  "First Project No._Last Project No.-Welder List-<Overlay>.xlsx"
     4. System should capture all the data like Welder name, WQT Number etc. from token generation and certificates from WML. 
     5. Certificates in the consolidated pdf must be extracted from Welder Master List (WML). 
     6. If welder certificates are not uploaded in the system for any joint type(s), then system should show the message, "Please upload the Certificate for below listed welders". 


           1. System should show the list of welders with WQT No for whom ​certificates have to be uploaded as shown in the screen "Error" as per visuals.
           2. User should be able to search the welders and WQT no. through "Search" field.
           3. Upon clicking "Export" button, Excel(.xlsx) should be generated with all the details in the list.
              1. Generated file directly download on the local drive with .xlsx file format.
           4. User should be able to  view by default 10 rows in table but as per requirement change from drop downs as shown in visuals.


  

Adobe XD visuals link: <https://xd.adobe.com/view/0034b4d5-3b03-4ac3-bb52-8f3c7726b499-5567/>
  

  

Performance: NA

## US-3408 — Multiple certificates upload in WML 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-3408 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Sathish Kumar M |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Manufacturing\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 8 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/3408) |

### Description

As a WE3 user, I should be able to upload multiple certificates of welder in WML in one go, So that It help to reduce time and efforts.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite(s):_**  

****
  1. WE3 user can login and navigate to "IEMQS Dashboard"
  2. Welder Project assignment details are displayed in the "Token List" screen.


Navigation Details: WE3 Login--> IEMQS Dashboard--> Select Project no.-->Click "Mega Menu"\-->Click "Welder Master details"\--> "Welder Master Details" Page--> Click on "WML with Certificates" tab
  

_Functional:_  

  1. Upon clicking "WML with Certificates" tab, user should view the "Upload Certificates" button as shown in the screen "WML with Certificates". 
  2. Upon clicking "Upload Certificates" button, user should be view one popup window as shown in the screen "Upload Certificates". 
     1. Name of all the documents with WQT No. of same certificate. 
     2. System should validate the name of pdf (which contains WQT No.) will match the WQT No. of specific welder. 
     3. User should have provision for "drag and drop or click to upload" option in the "Upload Certificates" popup window. 
     4. User should upload maximum 30 no. of documents in one session. 
     5. Only PDF should be allowed to upload.  

     6. Size of each file upload up to 50MB.  

     7. After successful upload, system should display the message "Successfully uploaded certificates of 15 welders".  

     8. If upload is not successful due to size violation, system should display the message “ "XXXX' File is too big (50.09MiB). Max file size: 50MiB with file name".
     9. If upload is not successful due to format violation, system should display the message ""XXXX' File should be one of the following types: .pdf". 
     10. If User uploads a file without deleting an existing certificate that was already present, system should display the message "Certificate of WQT. No. XXXX is already uploaded, do you want to replace" with an Yes/No option. 
        1. Upon clicking Yes, System should replace the existing certificate with the new certificate. 
        2. Upon clicking No, System should close the dialog and no changes should happen in the system.

## US-4841 — Designing specifications from Part data

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-4841 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Aakanksha Gupta |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IEMQS |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 2 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/4841) |

### Description

****
**As a  **IEMQS engineer, **I want** to get the job specifications related to the part data **so that** I can complete the part design for welding operations, manufacturing operations, and quality operations provided by the Brah-M application.**__**

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisites:_**
  1. IEMQS API is shared with specific request body along with the documentation in JSON format
  2. Authentication mechanism is agreed between "3D Automation", Integration and IEMQS
  3. API design and contracts are agreed between IEMQS and "3D automation" teams
  4. IEMQS API should send the response to Integration post processing the data received from Integration 
     1. If the transaction is completely successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 200, status must be "success"
     2. If the transaction is partially successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 200, status must be "Partial success"
     3. If the transaction is not successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 500, status must be "Failed"


 
**_Functional requirements_**
**  
**
**Assumption:**
**  
**
  * On clicking <"Part Approval"> button in "3D Automation", the API developed by Integration team should be called automatically
  * Integration team ​dependent on IEMQS team to provide interface endpoint to start SIT.
  * To close this user story unit testing can be performed using wrapper end point (as a workaround since we don't have IEMQS endpoint)  



**Requirements:**
  * The data shared by '3D Automation" should be available in the Integration in the expected JSON format(sample json file is attached)
  * Transformation of the field to be performed as per field level mapping sheet wherever applicable and transformed message has to be attached as an artifact.
  * Required transformation to be done on the data received from "3D Automation"
  * IEMQS API should be automatically triggered with the transformed data
  * Send the response received from IEMQS(post processing in IEMQS) to "3D Automation" automatically


 
 
**_Performance requirements_****  NA**
 
_**Compatibility requirements: NA**_
 
_**Usability requirements: NA**_
 
**_Security requirements:  NA_**

| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 2 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/4845) |

### Description

****
**As a  **IEMQS Engineer, **I want** to get the job specifications related to the BOM data **so that** I can complete the part design for welding operations, manufacturing operations, and quality operations provided by the Brah-M application.**__**

### Acceptance Criteria

**__**
**_Pre-requisites:_**
  1. IEMQS API is shared with specific request body along with the documentation in JSON format
  2. Authentication mechanism is agreed between "3D Automation", Integration and IEMQS
  3. API design and contracts are agreed between IEMQS and "3D automation" teams
  4. IEMQS API should send the response to Integration post processing the data received from Integration
     1. If the transaction is completely successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 200, status must be "success"
     2. If the transaction is partially successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 200, status must be "Partial success"
     3. If the transaction is not successful, JSON response code from IEMQS must be 500, status must be "Failed"


 
**_Functional requirements_**
**  
**
**Assumption:**
**  
**
  * On clicking <"BOM Data Approval"> button in "3D Automation", the API developed by Integration team should be called automatically
  *  Integration team ​dependent on IEMQS team to provide interface endpoint to start SIT.


**Requirements:**
  * The data shared by '3D Automation" should be available in the Integration in the expected JSON format
  * Transformation of the field to be performed as per field level mapping sheet wherever applicable and transformed message has to be attached as an artifact.
  * Required transformation to be done on the data received from "3D Automation"
  * IEMQS API should be automatically triggered with the transformed data
  * Send the response received from IEMQS(post processing in IEMQS) to "3D Automation" automatically


 
 
**_Performance requirements_****  NA**
 
_**Compatibility requirements: NA**_
 
_**Usability requirements: NA**_
 
**_Security requirements:  NA_**

### Description

As a ENGG3/PMG3/PLNG3/WE3/QI3/QA3/NDE3/AUX3/LOG3 user, I want to upload data as per assigned procedure for the specific project, so that activities can be performed by the team as per client specifications.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Prerequisite:**
  1. Design Department must have Documents assigned and tagged to specific project against the department. 
  2. User must have uploaded relevant documents for the assigned procedure 


**  
**
**Functional:**
  1. Visual: [L3_Maintain Procedure (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/89e9f384-19ce-4ae8-9942-15680814350f-dcba/screen/207f49d6-93a1-4fdf-af12-b00ea1c0776b)
  2. After uploading any one of the documents, the Preview icon on the action column should be made clickable, upon clicking the same, a consolidated file should be generated and will appear under the "document" column as per visuals. The sequence of the consolidated fille will be as per the sequence selected while clicking Preview icon (The consolidated file format will be in PDF). 
  3. User can click on the PDF generated from the Document column to review with O365 or using Universal viewer (existing application feature). Also, user can download the same by clicking on the download button 
  4. Once the user is satisfied, after clicking the "submit" button from the actions tab, it should successfully submit the document for review to the L2 user, and a popup as per visuals should be displayed. 
  5. While the user is working on the document, the status will be visible as "Draft". After the user submit the document, the status will change from "Draft" to "InProcess."
  6. The color-coding logic for the left bar present in the table on the visual will be as below:
     * Status: Draft (When a procedure is yet to be acted) -> Color: Grey
     * Status: Draft (When a procedure is returned from L2) -> Color-> Red
     * Status: InProcess -> Color: Amber
     * Status: Completed (Approved from L2 or approved from client)-> Green 
     * Status: Completed (Commented/returned from Client) -> Red 
  7. The user can click on the timeline button for each record to view the timeline of that specific line item. 



**Note:**  
  1. The Rev.No. will remain unchanged and will remain as R0. 
  2. For technical details, please refer attached document



**Usability:**
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

        1. User can not deselect the existing selected position no. 
     2. User should be able to view all the added existing stages. 
     3. User should have provision to edit/delete the stages in the "Action" column. 
        1. Upon clicking "Edit" button, user should be able to edit the details for specific stage. 
           1. User should not able to edit the "Stage code" and "Seq." from the fields. 
           2. User should be "Acc. Std", "App. Spec" and "Insp. Ext.", "Remarks" should change the details. 
           3. After modification, user should be able click "save" to save the details. 
           4. Upon clicking "Cancel" button, no changes in the details. 
        2. Upon clicking "Delete" button, user should be able to view pop message with "Delete confirmation"
           1. Upon clicking "Yes" button, system should delete the stage. 
           2. Upon clicking "No". No changes happens in the system. 
     4. Upon clicking "Add New stage" button, user should be able to view and add the details in the new row in the list. 
           1. System should fetch the data from the stage master.  

           2. User should be select "Stage code", "Insp. Ext." from drop down menus. After selection of stage system should show "Seq." in the screen.
           3. User should be able to add the data manually in "Acc. Std.", "App. Spec", "Remark" fields. 
           4. upon clicking "Save" button in action column, stage saved successfully in list.  

           5. Upon clicking "Cancel" button in action column, no change happens in the list.
           6. If ICL is in "Approved" status, system should show pop message "Do you want to revise it?".
              1. Upon clicking "Yes" button, user should able to add the new stage in the QID.
              2. Upon clicking "No" button, No changes in system.
     5. Upon clicking "Save and submit ICL" button, system should incorporate all the modification done by user and shows message as "Successfully submitted ICL Part" as shown in the visuals. 
        1. System should redirect to "Part/Assembly inspection checklist page". 
        2. ICL Status should be updated as "Sent for Approval". 
     6. Upon clicking "Save as Draft" button, system will the save all the data. 
        1. System should redirect to "Part/Assembly inspection checklist page". 
        2. ICL Status should be updated as "Draft". 
     7. Upon clicking "Cancel" button, no changes happens in the system, "Stages" page will close & System should redirect to "Part/Assembly inspection checklist page".


**_Usability:_**
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a design engineer, I want to get the EnquiryHeader and EnquiryEquipmentDetails from EMS, so that I can identify the Project details from ERP LN

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-Requisite:_**  

**_  
_**
* Interface design document is signed off by HEIC Product Manager/Track Lead 
* Enquiry and Enquiry Serial number passed to the Integration API follows the below 
  * They are registered with EMS 
  * Enquired project is in approved status and email should be sent to Designer/Proposal Engineer 


* Data supplied by EMS is in the agreed JSON format 
* EMS has published the API to receive the request from BRAH-M application 
* EMS sends the response to Integration layer in JSON format as per Interface design document 
  

  

  

**_Functional requirements:_**  

**_  
_**
  * Request from BRAH-M must be sent to the EMS(through API published by EMS) 
  * Response from EMS should be sent to BRAH-M via Integration API 
  * All error conditions specified in the Interface design document must be validated 


 
**Note**
  * Proxy can be used till the BRAH-M sends the API request 
  * Proxy can be used till EMS publishes the API to receive the data from Integration 

  

  

  

  

**_Compatibility requirements: NA_**  

  

  

  

**_Usability requirements: NA_**  

  

  

  

**_Security requirements:_**  

  

  * The integration should be secure, and should only allow authorized users and systems to access and transmit data. 


  

  

  

  

**_Documentation requirements:_**  

**_  
_**
  * Integration team has drafted Interface design document, which has all the required information related to data transfer from EMS to Brah-M 


  

  

  

**_Maintenance requirements:_**  

  

  * The integration should be easily maintainable, and should allow for easy configuration and customization to meet changing requirements or business needs.

### Description

As a ENGG3/PMG3/PLNG3/WE3/QI3/QA3/NDE3/AUX3/LOG3 user, I want to directly upload procedure document, so that I can quickly submit the same to the L2 personnel.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Prerequisites:**
  * User should have procedures assigned to their tray 
  * The procedure should be in Draft Status 


  

**Functional:**
  * User should be able to directly upload documents from local system after clicking upload button as per visual: [L3_Maintain Procedure (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/89e9f384-19ce-4ae8-9942-15680814350f-dcba/screen/f439ee13-451c-4234-9427-467e95b0678d)
  * The direct upload functionality will only be applicable when the status of the particular line item is "Draft"
  * After uploading the document, user can click on the document to view it 
  * User can download the uploaded document after clicking the download button 
  * Once the document is uploaded, the Submit Action button will get enabled for submitting the document 
  * In case of direct upload of the document, without using the binder capability i.e. by expanding the document and creating the documents using parameters, the preview button will be disabled 
  * The preview button (eye) will only be enabled when user is manually uploading documents one by one by expanding the particular procedure document 


**Note:**  
For technical details, please refer attached document.  

**  
**
**Usability:**
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-7384 — System generated Part ICS

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-7384 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Sathish Kumar M |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 11 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/7384) |

### Description

As a QI3 user, I want to view system generated Part ICS, so that it will save my time.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite:_**
  *  System should generate the ICS only for the  which parts in the ICL 


**_Functional:_**  

  * After clearing of last stage from Part ICL, system should notify the user who has maintained Part ICL.  

  * System should fetch the "project no from" and "project no to" from part ICL. 
    * System should shows same project no. in both the fields. 
  * System should fetch and view "part/item/assembly no." linked in part ICL. 
  * System should fetch and view the "Drawing No." from project H-BOM. 
  * Need to add "Drawing revision no." field next to "Drawing No." field. 
    * system should fetch the "Drawing rev no." from Drawing document session,
    * User should be able to view the details of drawing rev no.
  * System should fetch and view the shop location cleared of part ICL in "Cleared from Shop" field. 
  * User should be able to add details of "Cleared to shop" from the drop down menus.  

  * System should validate the ICL, if ICL is
    * For "Part", system shows “Identification details are marked on part” in "identification" field.
    * For "Assembly", “Identification details are marked on assembly”  in "identification" field.  

  * System should fetch the "total quantity" count and this quantity should view in the "Quantity" field. 
  * System should able to add the "Description" of each stage from "Part details" needs to be bind with this field based on part ICL and view in the "Inspected for following operations" field.
  * System should show "Remarks" field empty. 
  * System should select and view "Cleared for Next Operation" field as "Yes".
  * System should select and view "TPI/Customer Cleared" field as "NA".
  * User should be able to select "Send Email to" from drop down menus.

## US-7593 — Secure API using JWT

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-7593 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | arunachalam |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 7 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/7593) |

### Description

Security of API is a Non functional requirement. Without security the data cold be accessed or modified by an unauthorized user or malicious attacker.To avoid this we can used JWT based token authentication.

### Acceptance Criteria

Making the API ready for the new development 
It should have  

  

~~Logging & Error Handling ~~
Authentication 
  

1) when user calls authenticated API without credentials then authenticated apis should respond with 401 
2) when user calls authenticated  API with right credentials along with their role and claims in JWT token then authenticated apis should respond with 200,
3) when  user calls a authenticated api which doesn't have authentication, then that api should respond with 200 
4) When the token expires then the refresh token will be passed to the api and then a new access token be sent back and then the api will be authenticated 
5) when an unknown user calls /**public****/api/users/authenticate** then 404  will be returned 
6) when an  /**public****/api/users/refresh** called with an wrong/expired refresh/auth token then 401 will be returned  
  

To Generate Token use  /**public****/api/users/authenticate**  
To generate refresh token use**   /public**/api/users/refresh****
TECH:

**

## US-8324 — Angular implementation for consuming api with JWT

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-8324 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Lahu.Kumbhar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-UX |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 8 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/8324) |

### Description

Security of API is a Non functional requirement. Without security the data cold be accessed or modified by an unauthorized user or malicious attacker.To avoid this we can used JWT based token authentication.

### Acceptance Criteria

1)Call the **public****/api/users/authenticate** api with valid credntials and get the token
pass this token to the authenticated api's to get the response  
  
2)When the above token is expired then call  /**public****/api/users/refresh** api to receive the refreshed token,pass the token to authenticate any authenticated api
  

3)When the refresh token expires then we can't use the /**public****/api/users/refresh**  api to generate the tokens,we need to relogin to generate the token using  **public****/api/users/authenticate**
**  
**
**The configured expiry time**  
AuthToken :60 seconds  
RefreshToken : 60 minuets

  3. In case of editing a published procedure, the toggle button should automatically get to the off state (unpublish state)  

  4. If user wants to edit an already published procedures, then upon clicking edit button will make a change the revision from R0 to R1 state. 
     * User to show a confirmation popup message, as per visual
     * If selected Yes, then the revision state will change from R0 to R1 and a new line item will be created which will have data copied from previously created procedure
     * User can make desired changes here
     * If selected No, then the user can cancel editing the current procedure and confirmation window will get closed.
  5. Visual: [Procedure Master - High Fidelity (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a1770f95-a43b-4687-bffe-6ad51b6f1393-f424/)  



  
Usability: 
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers. 
  

Note: For technical details please refer attached doc

## US-9006 — US -3 Success while Fetching Part/H-BOM/Seam list data automatically

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9006 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9006) |

### Description

As a DE3/DE2 User, I want to Maintain 3D automation configuration to get data from PLM light to the IEMQS automatically, so that in future I will not have to fetch data manually every time from PLM light to IEMQS.

### Acceptance Criteria

### Prerequisites -  

  * Users should be logged in.   

  * 3D automation configuration should be done by Key user.


### Functional -  

  * System should start fetching selected data as per "Business Process" field.  

    1. System should fetch "Part List" data through middleware,  

       * System should fetched only approve status part list data.  

       * System should add the fetched part list data as per their respective location in same as AS-IS process.
    2. System should fetch "H-BOM List" data through middleware,  

       * System should fetched only approve status H-BOM list data.  

       * System should add the H-BOM list data as per their respective location in same as AS-IS process.  

       * System should insert Bill of material items in equipment as per attached image.
         * Item code - Project No.-Equipment, (Refer 2nd Image of H-BOM).
         * Item code - Project No.-CRS, (Refer 3rd Image of H-BOM).  

    3. System should fetch "Seam List" data through middleware,  

       * System should fetched only approve status Seam list data.  

       * System should add the Seam list data as per their respective location in same as AS-IS process.
    4. System should not allow Users to Modify/ Edit/ Delete/ Insert in all the fetched Part List/H-BOM List/Seam List in their respective sessions for this configurable project. 
    5. System should show approved status for all the fetched Part List/H-BOM List/Seam List automatically in their respective sessions in AS-IS process. 
  * User should be able to see Successful Message in Notification at the landing page "X Part/X- BOM/X-Seam lists fetched successfully." every time data flow from PLM to IEMQS  

  * System should get the data from BRAH-M platform to IEMQS for the configurable projects only. 
  * If any Part List/H-BOM List/Seam revised, 
    * System should fetch only approved revised Part List/H-BOM List/Seam List data from BRAH-M to IEMQS through middleware.
    * System should not add duplicate data in their respective location.


  

**Special Note**  

  1. The existing tables webpages stored procedures functions views to be used in the to be processed to get the data automatically. 
  2. System should allow to upload data into the IEMQS for which configuration is not done. 




### Usability:  

The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.
  

Notes
  1. Project related Part page in Legacy system.  
  
  

  2. Project related H-BOM data page in Legacy system.  
\--->\--->  
  

  3. Project related Seam data page in Legacy system.

## US-9020 — (US 7) TC review - Chemical Analysis Grid

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9020 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\NLP Team |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9020) |

### Description

As a WE2/WE3 user, I want to Review and Approve the TC data, so that I can Approve it and proceed for further steps

### Acceptance Criteria

## Prerequisites -  

## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * User should have uploaded the certificate and the data scanned and extraction analysis has been done on the same.
  * User should be shown only relevant Grid as per uploaded TC.


### Functional -
  1. For "**CHEMICAL ANALYSIS (SINGLE VALUE, MAX) WELD METAL "** Grid- (Refer Page 17)
     * User should be able to view grid of chemical Analysis with fetched data shown as per visuals.
     * User should be able to view **chemical element** present in WBMS in first column shown as per visual. [TC Review (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f2f11170-dac5-4337-ad6d-c032a8445f84-a7a2/)
       * All rows/number of rows are dynamic as per the extracted data from TC.  

     * User should be able to view "Required (WBMS)" field with fetched data shown value as per visuals.
       * "Single Max value" \- Example -0.03
       * "Range" Value- Example- 0.05-0.08
       * "NA"\- Static word
       * "Report"- Static word
     * User should be able to view "Actual (TC)" field -  

       * System should check if actual value is same as required value or within the range of required value for match and mismatch. 
       * System should assign color to field if value is matched (Green color) or mismatched (red Color) shown as per visuals.
       * System should show "Actual (TC)" field in editable mode,
         * User can edit and enter value in "Actual (TC)" field,
           * System should have the saved fetched data from NLP in different column in backend.
           * System should save edited value in different column. 
             *  don't touch the fetched value as it could be required for future functionalities to compare NLP FTR report. 
         * If user changed value, system would compare for match and mismatch for fetched value and also compare every time user enter value in "Actual (TC)" field with "Required (WBMS)" field.
         * **Flow 1 - If range is given in****" Required (WBMS)" **field, 
           * If, enter/fetched value is not within required range.
             * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
           * If, enter/fetched value is within required range.
             * System should consider this matched show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.  

         * **Flow 2 - If single value is given in  ****" Required (WBMS)" **field, 
           * If, enter/fetched value is greater than required value.  

             * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
           * If, enter/fetched value is less than required value.  

             * System should consider this matched show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.  

         * **Flow 3 - If "Report" is given in** **" Required (WBMS)" **field,  

           * If "Actual (TC)" field is blank 
             * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.  

           * If "Actual (TC)" field have some fetched values,  

             * System should consider this matched show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.  

         * **Flow 4 - If "NA" is given in** **" Required (WBMS)" **field,  

           * System should not match and mismatch for this row and show "Grey" color in fields shown as per visuals.
     * User should be able to view status in "**Test Pass Condition** " field for every element.
       * System initially should show "Green "color \- if value is matched as per visuals.  

         * System should show "Passed" message in the field. 
       * System initially should show "Red" color- if value is mismatched as per visuals. 
         * System should show "Failed" message in the field. 
       * System should not show status for "NA" value in **" Required (WBMS)" **field**,  **as per visual.


  

**Special Notes-  **

### Description

As a DE3/DE2 User, I want to Maintain 3D automation configuration to get data from PLM light to the IEMQS automatically, so that in future I will not have to fetch data manually every time from PLM light to IEMQS.

### Acceptance Criteria

Prerequisites -  

  * Users should be logged in. 
  * Navigation: Latest Landing Screen -> Mega Menu-> Configure 3D Automation 


  

**Functional -**  

  1. System should capture the PS number/ login ID of person who initiates the request.
  2. If System capture error while fetching Part List/H-BOM List/Seam List data
     * System should show Error message in landing page. 
       * Message - "Error while fetching data, please download Error log file here." 
       * Notification also contains link of file. 
       * Generated file directly downloads on the local drive.
         * Name of downloaded file: PSNo._DATE_TIME 
         * DATE format (DDMMYYY) 
         * TIME format (HRMINSEC)
         * example: 20001746_04-04-2023-041847  

     * System should generate and send error file by mail to the person who initiate the request as per PS number/ login ID. 
     * System should send same error log file by mail to IT administrator (User who are having IT1, IT2 and IT3 roles) 


  

**Usability-**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-9176 — Extracting WBMS data from ERP-LN

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9176 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Nagaraj Raghunath Revankar |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IEMQS |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 5 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9176) |

### Description

**As a** Welding Engineer, **I want to** verify that the welding and brazing material specification (WBMS) data from ERP-LN matches the vendor-shared test certificates, **So that** I can ensure that the materials used in my welds are of the correct quality and meet the required standards.

### Acceptance Criteria

Pre-Requisite: 
  

  *  WBMS data should be updated in ERP-LN by Welding Engineer with the level L2/L3. 


  

  

• Functional requirements:  

  

  * The Wielding Engineer will key-in approved WBMS number and Rev Number
  * If WBMS number doesn't exist in ERP-LN, it should send a message as 'WBMS number doesn't exist'
  * The latest WBMS data from ERP-LN must be fetched & be sent to '**IEMQS TC review****wielding****  consumable module**'.
  * Appropriate Error message should be shown if there are any failures while fetching the data.


  

Non-Functional Requirements:
  

• Performance requirements:  

  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds on **IEMQS TC review  ****wielding****  consumable module**. 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day (less than 5 times) 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

A new button named as "Submit to TPI " needs to be added as below helper screenshot 
  

Reference Image: 
  

  * The logic for the button "Submit to TPI" will be that, on click of it, the selected report should go to the pending records screen for getting it signed by TPI 
  * Validation for Submit to TPI: 
    * Set the flag in table QMS060, TPI status = offered

     3. In "Source Seam details", User should be able to select "From Seam "and "To Seam" from dropdown menus.  

     4. All resulted seam list will be shown in the "Seams shortlisted - Count X" field.  

        * User can add and remove seam from the resulted seam multiselect dropdown list.
     5. After clicking "+" button selected seam will be add in the "Seams selected - Count X" field  

        * User can add and remove seam from the resulted seam multiselect dropdown list.
     6. In "Destination Quality Project details", User should be able to select "From Quality project" and "To Quality project" from dropdown menus.
     7. All resulted Quality project will be shown in the "Quality project shortlisted - Count X" field.  

        * User can add and remove seam from the resulted seam multiselect dropdown list.
     8. After clicking "+" button selected Quality project will be add in the "Quality project selected - Count X" field  

        * User can add and remove seam from the resulted seam multiselect dropdown list.
     9. Upon clicking "Transfer" button, all the details should be transferred from selected seam to targeted seams. 
     10. Upon clicking "Close" button, System should close the window.


**Special Note -  **
> **The existing business application code to be used in new screen, screen has been improved there is no change in business logic table structure, stored procedure and linkages of the tables.**
  

Usability:
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-9315 — US -1 Configure 3D Automation-Main Screen

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9315 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9315) |

### Description

As a DE3/DE2 User, I want to Maintain 3D automation configuration to get data from PLM light to the IEMQS automatically, so that in future I will not have to fetch data manually every time from PLM light to IEMQS.

### Acceptance Criteria

## Prerequisites:
  * Users should be logged in. 


## Navigation:
## 
  *  Latest Landing Screen ----> Mega Menu----> Configure 3D Automation.


 
### Functional -  

  

Upon clicking " Configure 3D Automation " button in Mega Menu,   

  1. User should be able to view "Configure 3D Automation" page shown as per visuals - [Configure 3D Automation Prototype Link](https://xd.adobe.com/view/26f6ec1f-d057-4865-9074-8b20608fcefe-73a5/)  

  2. User should be able to view the hierarchy of the page via breadcrumbs with back button shown as per visual.  

  3. User should be able to view **" Product Type"**, **" Business Unit"**, **" Contract Number"** and **" Project Number" **fields as per visuals.  

     * User should be able to view single select drop-down menu with predictive search functionality.  

     * All respective fields are mandatory.  

     * Product Type - Location?  

     * Business unit - Location?
     * "Contract Number"- Location?
     * "Project Number" - Location?
     * If user select any one Project Number in multiselect whose Quality project does not exist,  

       * System should disable the checkbox option of "Seam list" in the "Business Process" multiselect dropdown.
  4. User should be able to view "Automation" toggle button to toggle between to "Yes" and "No" shown as per visual.  

     * Initially, system should select/toggle to "No" field as shown as per visual,  

       * Upon toggling to "Yes" in "Automation",
         * System should disable "Product Type", "Business Unit", "Contract Number" and "Project Number" fields with selected data.
         * In backend, System should check "Quality Project" is available for all selected "Project No" or not,  

         * System should enable the Business Process field.
       * Upon toggling to "No" in "Automation",  

         * System should enable "Product Type", "Business Unit", "Contract Number" and "Project Number" fields with selected data.  

         * System should disable the Business Process field.
  5. **If user select first Project number directly** , System should fetch "Product Type" "Business Unit" and "Contract Number" automatically,
     * System should disable the "Product Type" "Business Unit" and "Contract Number" fields.
     * System should populate/fetch data automatically only if "Product Type" "Business Unit" and "Contract Number" are blank initially.
  6. User should be able to view **" Business Process"** fields shown as per visual.  

     * User should be able to view Multi select drop-down menu with predictive search functionality.  

     * All options in dropdown are static-
        1. Part List
        2. H-BOM List
        3. Seam List 
           * System should disable the Seam List option, 
             * If "Quality Project" is not available for selected "Project No".  

           * System should enable the Seam List option, 
             * If "Quality Project" is available for selected "Project No".
        4. Mandatory to select at least one option,  

  7. User should be able to view "Save" button to be shown as per visual.  

     * System should enable" Save" button only when all the mandatory fields are filled.
     * Upon clicking Save button,  

       * **Flow 1 -** If "Project No." is already existing for selected "Business Process", 
         * System should provide a pop-up window "Record already exists for selected Business Process. Please refer below table." with "OK" button.
         * Upon clicking on OK button,
           * System should clear the "Business process" field.
       * **Flow 2 -  **Else, system should show a "Confirmation" pop-up window with "Yes" and "No" buttons.
         * Message in pop up window - Are you sure you want to start 3D automation?
         * Upon clicking "Yes",
           * System should start fetching data of selected "Business Process" through middleware.  

           * System should add multiple rows of all selected combination "Configure 3D Automation" grid.
            * System should capture "PS Number" of person as per login details.
            * System should capture "Date" when project added in the list.


 Usability-
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

**Notes -  
**
  * Mapping for Project with Quality project.

## US-9371 — Digital Compilation Folder Structure (Read and Write) Folder- Design Engineering

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9371 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 11 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9371) |

### Description

As a ENGG-1/2/3 (Design Engineer) user, I want to view Design Engineering folder and access the records/documents in a consolidated format, so that I can compile them and send to next level

### Acceptance Criteria

Navigation: Landing Page-> Mega Menu->e-Signature & Digital Dossier->Digital Compilation Tab
  

Functional:
  * On clicking the Design Engineering - folder will open list of records/documents as per visual 
  * **Sub Folders: Uploaded Documents, Procedures**
  * By default, the data in grid will be visible for the selected favorite project, but user can also view other projects data by clicking on the project dropdown. Switching to other project, will show the project description and should populate the relevant data for the selected project in the grids below  



  * User can view the document by clicking on the Attachment link  

  * User can click on required line items using checkbox and click on "Compile" button 
  * User can also select a single file and click on "Compile" button 
  * Clicking on "Compile" button will open a popup where user needs to enter the Document name, and description and then clicking on "Compile" with make a single document of the selected line items and the consolidated file and will be visible as per visual 
    * Status: 
      * Before Compilation: Not Compiled 
      * After Compilation: Compiled 
    * Please not that, the line item with status as "Compiled", can't be sent again for compilation 
  * User will be shown a success message post that 
  * Now user can submit the compiled file, by clicking on the checkbox and clicking on "Submit to QA" button 
  * User can delete the compiled file, before submitting the compiled file to QA. In this case, the individual files status in bottom table will change from "Compiled" to "Not Compiled"
  * The status for top table (Compiled Files) will be as follows: 
    * Submitted 
    * Not Submitted 
  * Once a file has been sent to QA, then the delete button will be disabled and user will not be able to resubmit them 
  * User can also individually send the files using checkbox to QA by clicking on the button "Submit to QA"
  * User can export the line item on clicking on Export button. If user has searched specific line items, then those will only get exported 
  * User can access the filter the functionality as per visuals 
    * Filters: Stage, Type, Status  

  * User can use the Search functionality to search relevant line items 
  * User can view more/less line items by selecting Rows dropdown 
  * User can press back button to redirect back to immediate previous screen 


Note: The already existing project wise authorization, which is implemented and operational is applicable to Dossier as well as e-Signature  

  
Usability:
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-9381 — Digital Dossier (Read and Write) Compilation

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-9381 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Anudeep.Sett |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 11 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/9381) |

### Description

As a QA1, QA2, QA3 user, I want to compile Digital Dossier project wise, so that I create and submit it for next steps

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite:
User should have indexed the documents as per requirement
Navigation: Landing Page-> Mega Menu->e-Signature & Digital Dossier->Digital Dossier
  

**Functional:**
  * ~~The compile button will get activated, once the user has mapped all the compiled files as per the predefined index  
~~
  * The Compile button will get activated if at least one line item is mapped to the index 
  * On click on the Compile button. a success message should be shown as per visual: [Digital signature type 1 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/196233ad-90ee-4000-be92-707e59a9b277-4c31/screen/4168d275-744f-4593-aa78-14fe7f423f3c)
  * After compile button is pressed, a popup will appear asking for below things: 
    * Page Numbering Format 
      * Full Continues Number: Complete documents should be appended with numbers like 1,2,3.... 
      * Section Wise Continues Number: section wise numbering will be present. for each new section, numbering will start from 1 
      * Full Page out of total page: Eg, Page 1 of 200, Page 2 of 200 ..... 
      * Section Wise- Page out of total page: Eg, for each section page numbering will be present, like for section 1 if total pages are 50 then for section 1, page numbering will be Page 1 of 50, Page 2 of 50... likewise for other section again the numbering will start from 1 
      * No Numbering: no page numbering will be present 
    * Page Number Positioning: 
      * Top Left 
      * Top Middle 
      * Top Right 
      * Bottom Left 
      * Bottom Middle 
      * Bottom Right 
  * As per the above-mentioned page formatting, the pages need to have the numbering and positions to be appended. 
  * Also, a section breaker as well as sub section breaker page needs to be appended by the system in the compiled document. The section breakers will be placed after main sections as well as subsections (Template and logic provided under attachment) 
    * In the attached section breaker, the L&T logo needs to be reduced in size and is expected to come in bottom middle position 
  * If a user clicks on Compile button before mapping all the files as per predefined mapped index, then the user should be shown a warning popup "All the files are not mapped to index, do you want to Compile? ". On clicking on Yes, all the mapped filed should get merged into a single files and to be shown in top grid as per visual 
  * User can see the status against the compiled documents: 
    * Submitted to TPI 
    * Not Submitted to TPI 
  * User should be able to view the approval flow by clicking on the history icon 
  * User can click on the Dossier MRB1/DossierMRB2 to view the compiled documents 


Note: 
Please not that, once for a MRB, compilation is done, then user will not be able to recompile, unless the user deletes the Compiled file from the top grid
The already existing project wise authorization, which is implemented and operational is applicable to Dossier as well as e-Signature
  
Usability:
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

Status ; Not submitted 
Compiled 
Submitted 
Returned 
  

Digital Dossier 
Once compiled and sent to TPI or PMG - There won’t be option to compile that MRB for that index 
  

If status of final dossier is not send- any new compilation on same index will update the dossier without changing revision. 
  

If the status is Sent -  any new compilation on same index will create new Revision (if the status is returned) 
  

Final Dossier compilation 
Popup - Page numbering format - in chat 
Numbering Position - Top right, Top Middle, Top left, Bottom left, right, middle 
By default its numeric no. 
  

  

**With TPI**
TPI Approved dossier 
TPI Commented dossier 
TPI return comments 
Send to PMG 
  

  

**With PMG**
Customer Approved dossier 
Customer Commented dossier 
PMG return Comments

Perquisite: User should have compiled files 
Navigation: Landing Page-> Mega Menu->e-Signature & Digital Dossier->Digital Compilation Tab
  

Functional:
  * Once user has compiled files, they will be visible in the top grid as per visual: [Digital signature type 1 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/196233ad-90ee-4000-be92-707e59a9b277-4c31/screen/e83d5b0b-08f5-476a-8fa5-08317080af68)

Perquisite: User should have compiled files

Functional:
  * User should be able to delete the compiled files using the delete button as per visual: [Digital signature type 1 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/196233ad-90ee-4000-be92-707e59a9b277-4c31/screen/e83d5b0b-08f5-476a-8fa5-08317080af68)

Now, if user deletes the merged file from top grid, then in the Comple file grid (bottom grid), the status for the individual files will change from "Compiled" to "Not Compiled"

## US-10208 — (US 4) TC review - Scanning and extracting data 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-10208 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\NLP Team |

| Tags |  |

### Description

As a WE2/WE3 user, I want to upload TC, so that I can scan and view results.

### Acceptance Criteria

## ​Prerequisites -  

## 
## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * Navigation: Latest Landing Screen-> Mega Menu-> TC review-Weld Consumable
  * User should have uploaded a pdf file for upload and scan option.


### Functional -
  

Continuous of 
  * [#9017](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/9017) 
  * [#10207](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/10207) 


  * Upon clicking **" U****pload and Scan " **option at Upload test Certificate page,  

  * Initially, System should disable the **" U****pload and Scan " **button** ** till all the mandatory field are filled and till user uploaded a single pdf file.
    * In hover of disabled "Upload and Scan" button, System should show "Please upload a pdf file to scan".
  * User Should be able to view "Data extraction in progress" in progress bar shown as per visuals. [TC Review (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f2f11170-dac5-4337-ad6d-c032a8445f84-a7a2/)  

    * User should be able to view Details of "WBMS No" and "WBMS Rev. No" shown as per visual.
    * User should be able to view "EXTRACT DATA AND VIEW TEST CERTIFICATE DETAILS **DRAFT**  " field shown as per visual.
      * User should be able to view progress bar for "Certification scanning in progress...." as per visual. 
      * User should be able to view progress bar for "Data extraction in progress...." as per visual. 
      * System should show as message "Data Extraction in progress" "It may take up to 6 minutes" as per visual. 
        * Just FYI - Got confirmation from NLP team, 
          * The TC Review application takes about maximum 60 sec for TC with 5 tables.
          * On an average, the model takes about 20secs for a table to infer.
          * Bohler has maximum tables (11 tables) and it will take about 5 mins +/- 1min.
      * After completion of scanned and data extraction, 
      * User should be redirect to the "Ready for Review" page automatically.  

        *         * System should show message "Successfully scanned and Data Extracted" as per visual.
      * System should add new row in the Index grid of "TC review -Weld Consumables".
        * System should show status "Ready for Review". 
        * System should save Reviewed on and Reviewed by information. 
  * ​In case of Interruption in data extraction process or scanning process-
    * If only partially data extraction happens/ somehow scanning process is not completed, it should not be gone into the database.
    * If background it should complete and add in the TC Index grid page.  

      * System should show "Ready for Review" status in the TC Index Grid, if somehow data extraction close in between.



**  
Special Notes-  **
  1. The data should be fetched from ERP LN through middle ware to IEMQS. 
  2. Table structures, table schema, mandatory, primary index, the complete details need to be taken for ERP LN 


Usability:
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a WE2/WE3 user, I want to view the comparative analysis data Impact test Grid, so that I can view for any discrepancies and act on it

### Acceptance Criteria

## Prerequisites -  

## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * User should have uploaded the certificate and the data scanned and extraction analysis has been done on the same.
  * User should be shown only relevant Grid as per uploaded TC.


### Functional -
  
**For Impact Test -**
  

User should be able to view **IMPACT TEST** GRID with fetched data shown as per visuals, [TC Review (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f2f11170-dac5-4337-ad6d-c032a8445f84-a7a2/)
  * User should be able to view "PWHT Condition", "Test Temp {UNIT}", "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}", "Acceptance Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}", "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}", "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}", "Impact Energy Single Value Test", "Impact Energy Avg Value Test" and "Impact Test" columns in the grid.
    * In a "Test Temp {UNIT}" column, this UNIT need to be fetched from WBMS. for example, ℃ or °F.
    * In all given field, "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}", "Acceptance Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}", "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" and "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}" there's UNIT need to be fetched from WBMS. for example, (J)  

    *   

    * For "Test Temp {UNIT}", System should show value given in the "Remark" field for both PWHT MIN and MAX rows
    * For "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" for Min, System should show value as per above example image  

      * >= 48
    * For "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" for Max, System should show value as per above example image,  

      * <=48
    *  "Acceptance Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}", System should show value as per above example image  

      * >=55
  * System should fetch data automatically for all the above fields except "Actual Impact Energy Avg".
  * **Flow 1**  \- For all Test Details, if respective PWHT Condition is "MIN & MAX",  

    1. System will add two rows in the one for "MIN" and one for "MAX" in the grid.  

  * **Flow 2**  \- For all Test Details, if respective PWHT Condition is "MIN"/ "Max",  

    1. System will add one rows as per given PWHT Condition in the grid.
    2. For both flow Format - MIN - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS), Example -MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr, 
    3. MAX - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS), Example -MAX - 705+/-10 ℃ / 34 Hr, 


  * For**  "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}",**  

    * User should be able to enter data in "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" all three editable fields and automatically calculate "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}" field value respectively as per visuals. 
      * System should calculate "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}" field - Adding "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" fields value and divided by 3. for Example -
        * Suppose 3,5,8 value fetched in "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}".
        * "Actual Impact Energy Avg" will be - (3+5+8)/3 = 18/3=6.
      *  In "Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}" field enter/fetched value,
        * Flow 1 -If in all three fields values are not as per given condition in "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}".
          * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
          * System should show only those fields red which are mismatched and violating the given condition.
        * Flow 2 -If in all three fields values are as per given condition "Acceptance Impact Energy Single {UNIT}".  

          * System should consider this matched show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals. 
          * System should show only those fields green only which are matched and not violating the given condition.
      *  In "Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}" field calculated value,  

        * Flow 1 - are not as per given condition in "Acceptance Impact Energy Avg".  

          * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
        * Flow 2 - are as per given condition in "Acceptance Impact Energy Avg".  

          * System should consider this matched show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.
  * For **" Impact Energy Single Value Test"** and **" Impact Energy Avg Value Test"** for status,  

    1. System initially should show "Green" \- if condition is matched.
       * System should show "Passed" message in the field.
    2. System initially should show "Red" \- if condition is mismatched.
       * System should show "Failed" message in the field.
    3. System should update the status, if user edit the field and condition is changed from matched to mismatched and vice-versa 
  * For **" Impact Test"**** ** for status,  

    * System initially should show "Green" color, if both "Impact Energy Single Value Test" and "Impact Energy Avg Value Test" fields are in "Passed" status.
      * System should show "Passed" message in the field. 
    * System initially should show "Red" \- if any one of the field "Impact Energy Single Value Test" and "Impact Energy Avg Value Test" is in "Failed" status.  

      * System should show "Failed" message in the field.
  * All rows are dynamic as per the extracted data from TC. 


**Special Notes-  **  

  1. The data should be fetched from ERP LN through Middleware to IEMQS. 
  2. Table structures, table schema, mandatory, primary index, the complete details need to be taken for ERP LN 


Example - 
|  |  |  | Editable fields  |  calculated field  |  |  |   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
PWHT Condition  | Test Temp {UNIT}  | Acceptance Impact Energy Single {(J)}  | Acceptance Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}  | Actual Impact Energy Single {UNIT}  | Actual Impact Energy Avg {UNIT}  | Impact Energy Single Value Test  | Impact Energy Avg Value Test  | Impact Test   
MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr  | -30  | >=48  | >=55  | 62  | 70  | 68  | 67  | Passed  | Passed  | Passed   
MAX - 705+/-10 ℃ / 32 Hr  | -30  | >=48  | >=55  | 90  | 57  | 91  | 79  | Passed  | Passed  | Passed   
MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr  | 60  | >=52  | >=57  | 68  | 50  | 78  | 55  | Failed  | Failed  | Failed   
MAX - 705+/-10 ℃ / 34 Hr  | 70  | >=54  | >=58  | 50  | 53  | 51  | 51  | Failed  | Passed  | Failed

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

        *  FYI- Do not modified the fetched values as it could be required for future functionalities to compare NLP FTR report.
      * If User changed value in "Actual" field, System would compare for match and mismatch for fetched value and compare every time user enter/edit value in "Actual" field with "Acceptance" field.
      * **Flow -1-  **When Specified single Value is min. If, enter/fetched value is not greater than required minimum value.

      * **Flow -2-  **When Specified single Value is max. If, enter/fetched value is greater than required maximum value.
        * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
          * for example - required as per WBMS is <=100, Actual value from TC is 102, then system should show consider this Mismatched and show in Red Color.
        * If enter/fetched value is less than required maximum value, consider this matched and show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.
          * Example - required as per WBMS is <=100, Actual value from TC is 97, then system should show consider this Matched and show in Green Color.
      * **Flow -3-  **When Specified Value is in range. If, enter/fetched value is not within the range.
        * System should consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
          * for example - required as per WBMS is 80-100 Actual value from TC is 78 or 103, then system should show consider this Mismatched and show in Red Color.

      * System should show "Failed" message in the field.
  * User should be able to view "**Remarks** " button in "Remark" column for every row shown as per visuals.  

  * Upon clicking on "Remark" button 
    * User should be able to view "Add Remark" window with "Text field", "Save" and "Cancel" button shown as per visuals.
    * User should be able to enter and edit in the user specific text field with 1000 character. 
      * Not Mandatory field. 
    * Upon clicking on "Save" button,  

      * System should save all changes and close the window.
    * Upon clicking on "Cancel" button,
      * System should not save any changes and close the window.

If exists, display error message  
if not, ERP API to be called.

### Acceptance Criteria

## ​Prerequisites -  

## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * Navigation: Latest Landing Screen-> Mega Menu-> TC review-Weld Consumable


### Functional -
  1. User should be able to view to add new Test Certificate page by clicking on "+Add TC" as per visual: [TC Review (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f2f11170-dac5-4337-ad6d-c032a8445f84-a7a2/screen/773480a1-5e70-427d-b424-cce7d558df16?fullscreen)
  2. User should be able to view the hierarchy of the page via breadcrumbs as per visuals.  

  3. User should be able to view progress bar dynamically in all pages "Upload test Certificate->Data extraction in Progress->Ready for review->Approved" as per progress as per visual. 
  4. User should be able to view and enter "TC Number" manually. 
  5. User should be able to view "WBMS" fields as per visual.  

     * User should be able to view and enter data manually. 
     * WBMS format \- HXX-XX-XX 
     * System should check that combination of TC number; WBMS number and Rev No should always be unique.   

       * In case this combination exists then system should show message that TC No has been reviewed for this WBMS No and Rev No.
  6. User should be able to view "Rev No." and enter data manually as per visual. 
  7. Upon clicking "Get Data" button, system automatically fetch WBMS No data from ERP LN.
     * For Invalid WBMS No and Rev No, System should pop up a message "This data not exist." ( which Handled by middleware team.


  

**Special Notes-  **
  1. The data should be fetched from ERP LN through Middleware to IEMQS. 
  2. Table structures, table schema, mandatory, primary index, the complete details need to be taken for ERP LN 


**  
**
**For Table details, please refer attached documents.**  

  1. Please keep the table name as it is.  

  2. Supplier No and TC No field length and data type to be taken from ERP LN  

  3. Supplier NO, TC NO, and Status fields needs to be added in LTWPS056.

The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

  * After user maps the relevant index, user can save them by clicking on the "Save" Button

### Description

As an QA1, QA2, QA3, QC1, QC2, QC3, NDE1, NDE2, NDE3 user, I want to view all the pending records project wise in my tray, so that I access them.

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
Records should have been sent for getting it signed to TPI from legacy portal 
  

Navigation: Landing Page-> Mega Menu->e-Signature & Digital Dossier->Pending Records Tab 
  * Reference visuals: [Flow 4 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/18edfa74-4ac0-4d63-aca3-f328c7431fd7-4dbe/screen/8adc4a23-22b3-446d-a614-53e6a43254af)
  * Create an API endpoint that would return all the pending records (with TPI) for any provided project.  

  * The endpoint should accept the project number, search string, signature status, stage, sort column, sort direction, page number, and count of entries per page. 
  * project number is mandatory 
  * search string, signature status, stage, sort column and sort direction are optional
  * Based on the provided filters, sorting conditions and page criteria, the API should return the collection of pending records.
  * The endpoint should also return the count of total pending records and total number of pages.
  * The endpoint should return total number of TPI's for each pending record as defined in Table QMS025 and also return how many TPIs have already signed the document (This needs to be captured when the TPIs digitally sign any document).

DB tables to refer: 
QMS060:NDE 
QMS050: QC/QA 
A new table needs to be created

### Description

As an QA1, QA2, QA3, QC1, QC2, QC3, NDE1, NDE2, NDE3 user, I want to get the records reviewed, signed and approved from the TPI/Customer, so that I can get approved records in the system

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
  1. Toggle button should be active for View as customer 
  2. Records should have been sent for getting it signed to TPI from legacy portal 


Functional: 
  * Once the user fills the details in the overlay, system should check whether the details entered for the selected document doesn't already exists 
  * If the details for the selected document already exists, then on clicking on Approve should shown an error that "Document Already signed for the selected TPI"
  * If the details entered for the selected document is unique, then on clicking on Approve button, the system should attach the sign corresponding to the selected TPI 
  * User can also clear and resign before clicking on Approve button 
  * System should show a loader while pasting signatures in the document (while API call for Approval is in progress) 
  * System should update the signature status once sign is captured (The system should update DB after signature entry is completed) 
  * Once a user clicks on Approve, and if the signature is successfully captured across the document, then the signature from the pad will get removed 
  * Visual Link: [Flow 4 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/18edfa74-4ac0-4d63-aca3-f328c7431fd7-4dbe/screen/4ca34a94-8fb3-4921-86c5-3e8dc2ed9261)
  * Error Handling: 
    * If the document, has two TPI fields, and user selects TPI-3 from dropdown, then on clicking on Approve, system should check and show an error that "TPI-3 doesn't exists."
    * If a user has not signed the box and clicks Approve, then system should check and show an error that "Signature doesn't exist, please sign" (Client-side validation) 
  * Mandatory Fields: 
    * Witnessed/Approved By 
    * Date

  * The updated sequence should get updated in Maintain Index as well as Digital Dossier tab

## US-10530 — Access Request - App Hub

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-10530 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Samir shah |
| Area Path | ECOM |
| Iteration Path | ECOM |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/10530) |

### Description

Access request is an common application for Domain ID Creation, VPN Access and Internet Access of any newly joined employees and trainee.  

  

**The following are step to generate access request in Application Hub.**
  

  1. Once log in into the Access Request, they have the option to add new request 
  2. Upon clicking the add new button, the user will be redirected to a page which will ask the following detail. 
     1. Location 
     2. Option (What type of request) 
     3. Purpose 
     4. Username 
     5. Reporting to (whom are you reporting to) 
     6. Mobile number 
     7. Valid date 
  3. Upon entering all the details, the user will have the option to save or submit the request.
  4. Once the user submits the request, they can view their request on the Access Request List. 
  5. On Submission of request, one email trigger to approver to review the request. 
  6. Once a request is added, the Approver has the access to either Approve, Postpone or Reject the request. 
  7. The Approver has to write a remark as in why are they rejecting the request otherwise the website shows an error. 
  8. If the approver postpones or rejects a request, it shows on the Pending List. 
  9. Once the Approver approves the request, the details of the request is mailed to the Infra team. 
  10. The Infra team then works on providing the user with the access to what was asked via the request. 


  

**Application Integration approach changed.**
  

Earlier, employee details were getting fetched from Infor ERP LN database using the link server, due this tightly coupled integration, if Infor ERP LN database service goes down then access request application will also get down. To avoid such incident we have used a new approach to create masters in ECOM database and used across ECOM applications. Using the database scheduler data will synchronized from Infor ERP LN database to ECOM database on daily basis.

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional requirements:  

  1. User should be able to submit request 
  2. Approver should get email notification
  3. Approver should able to take any one of the action like Approve, Reject or postpone.
  4. User from Infra team gets email notification for required action.
