## US-11495 — Lifting Lug - Download

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11495 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Ramadass P |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11495) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to download the existing Lifting Lug calculation, so that further processes can be carried out

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. User should be able to view the download icon against all the line items as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/a2eb1cda-a6fb-4aba-911c-44f36ddc2424)
  2. It should open a universal viewer, where user can view the document and save/print as well 
  3. PDF Format: 
     * Refer attachment for PDF sample doc, 
     * The PDF should be system generated 
     * The document orientation should be in portrait mode 
     * The Doc No should be system generated and the nomenclature will be: <capacity/thickness/SL.No>, E.g, if capacity of a lug is 30MT, Thickness is 50mm and SL.No is 1, then the Document number should be 30MT-50T -1 
     * The Doc should append the latest date of printing that document 
     * Notes: 
       * For the fillet size, if the value for Full penetration weld is only Safe, then system should mention that: "Weld Lug with Full Penetration Weld Both Sides"
       * For the fillet size, if the value for fillet weld is Safe, then system should mention that: "Weld Lug with Fillet Weld Both Sides"
       * If both are safe, then system should capture above two statements as: Statement 1 <next line> OR <next line> Statement 2 <next line> anyone can be used 
     * If user has entered Remarks while saving a record, then the remarks should be captured under Notes 
     * For Lug Capacity, system should print the value of "Load on Lug/1000"
     * At the bottom under the Prepared By box, the user downloading the record, his/her PS No and name should get captured as per login 
     * At last this message needs to be appended: **This document is system generated, physical signature is not required**
  4. User can also download the record from the records detail page, once the record is saved 


Note: Please refer attachment for PDF doc format

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to get the output based on the entered inputs for the Lifting Lug calculations, so that I can know whether the calculations are safe or unsafe

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

1\. System should apply required calculations based on provided inputs. 
2\. Once all the mandatory fields are filled by the end user, the output will be as below, system should dynamically generate output based on input by the end user:  

3.**Output fields:**  

> a) L1= <in mm, Decimal number, up to 2 decimal places, max limit=4 integer and 2 decimal places e.g. 1111.11>, non-editable (read only) 
> b) Sheer Stress = <in kg/mm2, up to 2 decimal places, max limit=4 integer and 2 decimal places e.g. 1111.11>
> c) Tensile Stress = <in kg/mm2, up to 2 decimal places, max limit=4 integer and 2 decimal places e.g. 1111.11>
> d) Bending Stress = <in kg/mm2, up to 2 decimal places, max limit=4 integer and 2 decimal places e.g. 1111.11>
> e) For Full Penetration Welding=<up to 2 decimal places, max limit=2 integer and 2 decimal places>
> f) For Fillet Weld= <up to 2 decimal places, max limit=2 integer and 2 decimal places>
> g) For Weight = <Non editable field, up to 4 digits, based on calculations> This value is formula based, and this value needs to be shown in round figure, for calculation, refer excel 
>   
> 
Note: 
  1. For calculations, please refer attachment for formula, check the cells with red color, those are outputs, clicking on the cells will show the formula used 
  2. If user has deleted any one of the input, and if that input is used as a formula in any of the output fields, then that output should become blank  

  3. User should be able to generate multiple outputs based on unique combinations of input provided by the end user

## US-11501 — Lifting Lug - Final Result 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11501 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 12 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11501) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to know the status of the output for Lifting Lug, so that I can know whether the calculations are safe or unsafe

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

**Induced Stress Results:** The results as per calculations needs to be displayed as **Safe** or **Unsafe** as per visual based on below logic and should get generated dynamically once the last mandatory field is fed by the end user:  

> a) If the output result of Sheer Stress is less than "9.6", then system should show its result as Safe. For other values, the status will be Unsafe. 
> b) If the output of Tensile Stress is less than "24", then system should show its result as Safe. For other values, the status will be Unsafe. 
> c) If the output result of Bending Stress is less than "15.84", then system should show its result as Safe. For other values, the status will be Unsafe. 
> d) If the output result of Full Penetration welding is less than "10", then system should show its result as Safe. For other values, the status will be Unsafe. 
> e) If the output result of Fillet Weld is less than "10", then system should show its result as Safe. For other values, the status will be Unsafe. 
  

Note: 
If the results are Unsafe, then user can again enter the input fields and should be able to generate the output. 
>   
>

## US-11504 — Lifting Lug - Saving Result

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11504 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 13 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11504) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to Save my calculations for Lifting Lug Calculations so that it can be stored in the system for future references.

### Acceptance Criteria

33Functional:
  1. The Save button for saving the calculation will be active or inactive will be based on below logic, that when:
     * The **Sheer Stress** AND **Tensile Stress** AND **Bending Stress** results are SAFE and **either of** **Full Penetration Weld** or **Fillet Weld** is SAFE,   

     * For any other cases the Save button will not be in active state 
  2. If user wants to write any remarks for the particular record, then user can write remarks in the Remarks input box. The box will be user input,<input type-alphanumeric> with max limit of 200 characters. 
  3. On click of Save button, the record should be added in Index with the next available SL. No. as well as in DB.  

     * If one of the Penetration weld is Unsafe, then a popup as per visual needs to be shown to the user
     * A toast success message as per visual should be shown to the user
     * The users PS No, Name and Date needs to be stored in DB and should be displayed in the index page as per visual 
  4. After a record is Saved, below button will be hidden:  
Cancel, Reset, Save, Save as Draft
  5. Once the records is saved, in the main index grid, the status will be "Completed" and the user detail will be saved and displayed in the main grid. Also, if remarks are written then it will also be shown in the main grid, if the remarks are not written, then in the main grid the remarks icon will be shown in disabled format. 
  6. User will not be able the enter remarks once the record is saved  

  7. After a result is saved, then the status in detail page also needs to be shown as below:  
  

  8. After saving records, if the user wants to go back to the index screen, then user can use the arrow button as shown in below screenshot, it will redirect the user to index page

As a PLNG2,3, I want to access the Copy functionality in the Lifting Lug calculations, so that I can reuse existing records entries

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. In the index page of Lifting Lug, user should be able to see a copy button next to each saved records line item. (Status to be Completed) 
  2. Clicking on Copy should open a new Index's detail page, with all the input as well as output field along with the current result (Safe and Unsafe). Please not that these input fields will be in editable mode.

  4. Save Button: 
     1. The save button will be activated only when the user has provided combination of inputs which is unique from the copied record AND the SAFE condition also needs to be validated by the system

  5. Once the record is saved a new line item in the index should be made.

## US-11579 — Lifting Trunnion - Calculations and Output 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11579 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 13 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11579) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to get the output based on the entered inputs for Lifting Trunnion calculations, so that I can know whether the calculations are safe or unsafe

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

1\. System should apply required calculations based on provided inputs. 
2\. Once all the mandatory fields are filled by the end user, the output will be as below.  

3. Output fields to be shown in application front end  

**  
**
**Strength of Lifting Trunnion**
  1. Shear stress = P / [ Ap ]: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  2. Allowable shear stress = 0.3 * YTRN : <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>  

  3. Induced Bending Stress = P*E / Zp: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  4. Allowable Bending Stress = 0.5*YTRN: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>  

  5. Combined Maximum tension in pipe: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  6. Allowable Tensile stress = 0.5* YTRN: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>  

  7. Combined Maximum Shear in pipe: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  8. Allowable Shear stress = 0.3*YTRN: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>  



  

**Strength of Weldment**  

  1. **Induced stress due to bending:  <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>**
  2. **Induced stress due to shear:  <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>**
  3. Combined Maximum Tension in Weld: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  4. Combined Maximum Shear In Weld: <maximum 3 digit, two decimal places allowed>


**Other Calculations**
  1. Cross Sectional Area of Pipe:  <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  2. Weld Area: <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  3. Weld Efficiency: Constant value, 0.7
  4. Section Modulus of Weld: <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  5. Section Modulus of Pipe: <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  6. Load per Trunnion (Pt / 2): <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  7. Load With Impact Factor: <maximum 10 digit, two decimal places allowed>
  8. Fillet Size Weld Between Pipe and Shell (KP) = System should calculate and show result based on the inputs. This value should be shown as a reference value as per visual  



> **Below Output fields are not to be shown in webpage, but should be stored in DB for use in Printing:**  

  1. E+Extra: (D/2-(((D/2)^2) - (DPI/2)^2))^1/2) + 10 ) + E
  2. Volume of Pipe: Pi(DPI/2)^2-Pi(((DPI-2TPI/2)^2)*E (This need not to be stored in DB)
  3. Volume end cover plate: Pi((DE/2)^2-(H/2)^2)*TE (This need not to be stored in DB)
  4. Volume of stopper plate: Pi((DE/2)^2-(DPI/2)^2))*TE (This need not to be stored in DB)
  5. Weight of Lifting Trunnion: (Volume of plate + Volume end cover plate + Volume of stopper plate) * 7.86/1000000 in KG - (This output is required to be stored in DB)  

  6. Capacity of Trunnion: Load per trunnion/1000 in MT


>   
> 
Note: 
  1. For calculations, please refer attachment for formula, clicking on the cells will show the formula used 
  2. The outputs needs to be shown as per visual 
  3. Some outputs needs to be shown on click of a small calculator shaped button named "Other Calculation" as per visual. Clicking on it will open a popup window as per visual 
  4. The calculations with a "i" button as per visual contains the involved formula that needs to be shown on clicking it 
  5. Visual Link: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/979cfb76-24fd-44de-9eb3-ddb797e8e041)

## US-11592 — Lifting Trunnion - Final Result 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11592 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 13 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11592) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to know the status of the output for Lifting Trunnion, so that I can know whether the calculations are safe or unsafe

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

  1. **Strength of Lifting Trunnion:  
  

     * If the value of Sheer Stress is less than Allowable Sheer Stress _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Induced Bending Stress is less than Allowable Bending Stress _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Combined Maximum Tension in Pipe is less than Allowable Tensile Stress _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Combined Maximum Sheer in pipe is less than Allowable Sheer Stress _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_  
  

_Then the Final Result for "Strength of Lifting Trunnion" will be **SAFE** , in all the other cases it will be **UNSAFE  
  
**_**


  1. **Strength of Weldments:  
  
**
     * If the value of Induced stress due to bending is less than  Allowable Tensile Stress in Weld _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Induced stress due to shear is less than Allowable Shear Stress in the Weld _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Combined Maximum Tension in Weld is less than Allowable Tensile Stress in Weld _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_
AND  

     * If the value of Combined Maximum Shear In Weld is less than Allowable Shear Stress in the Weld _< Individual Status will be: SAFE else UNSAFE>_  
  

_Then the Result for "Strength of Weldments" will be **SAFE** , in all the other cases it will be **UNSAFE**_**  
  
**

Note: **  
**
  1. If the results are Unsafe, then user can again enter the input fields and should be able to generate the output. 
  2. Refer Excel for detailed information of the formulas 


>   
>

  1. User should be able to access search capability in the Lifting Trunnion main screen as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/52e38f4c-c804-4cea-8f7c-fc1a56d7ff23)
  2. In case no relevant search result are obtained, then a placeholder icon needs to be shown 
  3. User should be able to search based on any of the relevant keyword from the grid 
  4. User should be able to export the data by clicking on the Export button 
     1. If user has not searched for any specific results, then all the data should get exported 
     2. The name of export file should be: SummaryOfLiftingTrunnion 
  5. User should be able to filter data as per visual: 
     1. Diameter 
     2. Thickness 
     3. Eccentricity   
Please not that in the filter dropdown, if there are more than 5 items to display, then only first 5 will be visible to user, and user can search for other values from the dropdown itself 
  6. User should be able to sort data as per visual, on sorting any specific column, the arrow direction will become downwards. At a time, only once column can be sorted, in case user switch to other column sorting, then the current columns sorting will be reset

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to download the existing Lifting Trunnion calculation, so that further processes can be carried out

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. User should be able to view the Download icon against all the line items as per visual 
  2. Clicking on the download icon should show a popup with message as per visual 
  3. It should open a universal viewer as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/52e38f4c-c804-4cea-8f7c-fc1a56d7ff23), where user can view the document and save/print as well 
  4. PDF Format: 
     * Refer attachment for PDF sample doc, 
     * The PDF should be system generated 
     * The document orientation should be in potrait mode  

     * The Doc No should be system generated and the nomenclature will be: <capacity/thickness/SL.No>, E.g, if capacity of a lug is 30MT, Thickness is 50mm and SL.No is 1, then the Document number should be 30MT-50T-1 
     * The Date needs to be printed of the current date of printing by the user 
     * Notes: 
       * It should print the values as per the grid (Refer attachment) 
       * If should print the Notes as per attachment, notes F1, F2, F3 will be static respectively, Note F4, will be dynamic and will only be printed if user has written remarks while saving the record 
     * The data in the grid needs to be taken from the relevant output values 
     * At the bottom under the Prepared By box, the logged in users name and PS no needs to be captured and printed. 
     * The approved by needs to be shown only, without any name or date time stamp 
     * At last this message needs to be appended: **This document is system generated, physical signature is not  ****required**
  5. User can also download the record from the records detail page, once the record is saved 
  6. PDF Document name should be LiftingTrunnion_<DocNo>


Note: Please refer attachment for PDF doc format

**Navigation:  **

**_Functional:_**  
  

Upon clicking "\+ Add New Stage" in the "Milestone Activity Master" page,
  1. User should be able to view to " Add New Milestone Stage" Page as per visuals. [Flow 1 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/bec48669-c5f2-45ea-bc4a-58a87f630809-eb97/)  

  2. User should be able to view the hierarchy of the page via breadcrumbs and back button as per visuals.  

  3. User should be able to enter the "Milestone Stage", "Description", "Ref. Procedure No", "Rev No " in the milestone stage field as per visuals.  

     * All these fields are User specific,
       * "Milestone stage"  

       * **"** Description" - 100 character  

       * "Ref. Procedure No - 50 character  

       * "Rev No" \- 5 numerical character

         6. "AFTERPWHT_PARTICL"
         7. "AFTERHYDRO_PARTICL"
         8. "NCR"
         9. "JEP"

         * User should be able to view "NA" option selected automatically.
         * User should be able to change by selecting other option from dropdown.
       * Upon clicking "Delete" button - System should delete the respective Activity row.  

  5. Upon clicking "+Add New Activity" button,  

     * User should be able to view newly added row in editable form at Activity list Gird as per visuals.

     * Initially Save button will be disabled,
       * System should check all mandatory fields for enabling Save button.
     * System should show a message "Milestone Stage and Activities are saved successfully".  

     * System should capture the "Date" of that activity added (Format - DD/MM/YYYY)   

       * Should update in the "Update on" field in Index page".  

     * System should capture the "Person Name" as per "PS Number" of login person.   

       * Should update in the "Last update by field in Index page".
     * User should be able to view new stage added in the "Milestone Stages" index page.  

     * System should revert back to Milestone Activity Master page".  

  7. Upon clicking Cancel button, 
     * System should not save any data and revert back to the Maintain Milestone stage page.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-Requisite:**
  * IIoT user should have AssetID information. 
  * CREMS database should be updated with latest values for the required fields 


  

**Functional requirements:**  

  * Integration will get AssetID as an input from IIoT user.
  * Integration will expose an query API, which will be consumed by IIoT dashboard to pass the input.
  * Based on the input, Integration team will be fetching fields like: assetID,balanceDays,projectCode,taskID,taskDesc,plannedStartDateMCShop  
as expected output parameters from CREMS application.
  * Extracted output parameters will be shared with the IIoT team in JSON structure.


  

**Non-Functional requirements:**  

**Performance requirements :**
  *  Once requested data should be available to IIoT team with in 30 seconds. 
  *  API should be available 24 X 7 to IIoT team to consume 
  *  There can be multiple requests in a day

NA

NA

  API contract is applied

**As an II** oT dashboard user, **I want to** request operator information from the ERP-LN application along with welder stamp number if available in ERP-LN, also from IEMQS if it is not available in ERP-LN, **So that** I can know the operator details with the welder stamp number.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-Requisite:_**  

**_  
_**
* PSNumber and Name should be updated in ERP-LN 
* CSNNumber should be updated in ERP-LN. 
  

  

**_Functional requirements:_**
  * Integration API to fetch all the CSNNo, PSNumber, Name, weld stamp number from ERP-LN API. 
  * If weld stamp number is not available in ERP-LN, intergration will call IEMQS API along with respective PSNumber to get Weld stamp number from IEMQS database. 
  * Integration API will merge the IEMQS and ERP-LN API response and send the data to IIoT 
  * If there is any IEMQS API call failure and it will not be possible to fetch welder number from IEMQS alone, in that case, welder stamp numbers which is available in ERP-LN alone will be shared with IIoT.   

  * Welder stamp numbers which are not available from IEMQS due to IEMQS API call failure, a message "ERROR" will be sent as response to IIoT.


• Performance requirements: 
  * IIoT will trigger request API once in a day 
  * Once requested data should be available to IIoT team with in 30 seconds. 
  * API should be available 24 X 7 to IIoT team to consume 
  * There can be multiple requests in a day 


  

 
**_Compatibility requirements: NA_**

  * API contract

Functional:

## US-11751 — Moon Plate - Calculations and Output

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11751 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Anudeep.Sett |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11751) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to get the output based on the entered inputs for the Moon Plate calculations, so that I can maintain exact results for fixture designing

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  1. System should apply required calculations based on provided inputs.  

  2. Once all the mandatory fields are filled by the end user, the output will be as below, system should generate output based on click of "Generate" button:  

  3. **Output Fields:**
     * For Moon Plate when selected dropdown from "Moon Plate to be welded on" is "ID of shell": 
       1. ID = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>
       2. A = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>
       3. B = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>
       4. D = - <Hyphen should come>
       5. F = \- <Hyphen should come>
       6. Weight = <round figure, max limit=7 digit>
     * For Moon Plate when selected dropdown from "Moon Plate to be welded on" is "OD of shell": 
       1. OD = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>  

       2. A = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>  

       3. B = <in mm, round figure, max limit=7 digit>  

       4. D = \- <Hyphen should come>  

       5. F = \- <Hyphen should come>
     * For Straight Plate: 
       1. ID =\- <Hyphen should come>
       2. OD = \- <Hyphen should come>
       3. W = \- <Hyphen should come>
       4. C = \- <Hyphen should come>
       5. A = \- <Hyphen should come>
       6. B = \- <Hyphen should come>
       7. Weight = <round figure, max limit=7 digit>
     * Total Weight = <round figure, max limit=7 digit>
  4. Once user clicks on generate button for Moon Plate or Straight plate, the calculated values in a grid format as per visual should get added. (Whichever place is empty should be shown with a hyphen -)  
This excel screenshot is for reference purpose, please refer prototype for accurate design structure  
  

  5. If user has entered values for Moon Plate as well as straight plate, then on click of generate, two separate line items should get created in the grid. Similarly, if only one section is input, then the relevant line item needs to be updated 
  6. The Generate button will be activated if either the moon plate input or the straight plate input are fully entered be the user. In other cases, it will remain disabled 
     1. If user has entered moon plate data partially and straight plates data fully, then on click of generate button, the line item of straight plate should be calculated and added to the grid. Same will be the case of vice-versa.
  7. In the grid, the calculations need to be referred as per the attachment in the User story and for Total Weight, system should add all the weights and display the Total weight on every click of generate button 
  8. As per requirement, user should be able to click on generate to calculate the data and accordingly a new line item should be added in the grid 
  9. On click of generate button, system should save the data as draft automatically 
     * For saving the data as draft, system should check the "Title" entered by the user at the beginning, if the Title matches with the selected project No., of a previously present data in index table, then user should not be allowed to get the output on clicking on generate, and an error should come to change the "Title". 
     * It may be noted that, two different projects may have same Title 
     * In the details page, the draft as per visual should be shown as below:  
  

     * Once a data is generated, in the index page, a new line item should get created with status as Draft 
     * The modified by and modified on should get updated with every click on Generate button 
  10. After the data is generated successfully and a new line item is created, the user input fields should be reset to blank for the user to enter next set of inputs except Project No and Title(Primary Details) 


>   
> 
Note: 
  1. For calculations, please refer attachment for formula, 
  2. User should be able to generate multiple outputs based on unique combinations of input provided by the end user
  3. The grid should be horizontally and vertically scrollable as per visual
     1. The total weight should not be scrollable as per visual

## US-11794 — Moon Plate - Download

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11794 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Ramadass P |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11794) |

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to download the existing Moon Plate calculation, so that further processes can be carried out

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. User should be able to view the download icon against all the line items as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/a2eb1cda-a6fb-4aba-911c-44f36ddc2424)
  2. Clicking on the download icon should show a popup with message as per visual 
  3. It should open a universal viewer, where user can view the document and save/print as well 
  4. PDF Format: 
     * Refer attachment for PDF sample doc, 
     * The PDF will be in landscape mode 
     * The PDF should be system generated 
     * The Page number should be appended at top right side 
     * The Doc No should be system generated and the nomenclature will be M-(Summation of Quantity)-SL No, Eg, if the summation of total quantity is 200, and Sl no is 2, then Doc Name should be: M-200-2 
     * The Doc should append the date of the current printing date 
     * The Fig 1 and Fig 2 needs to be printed on below conditions 
       * If user has calculations done only for Moon Plate, then Fig 1 needs to be only shown 
       * If user has calculations done only for Straight plate, then Fig 2 needs to be only shown 
       * If user has calculations done for Moon Plate as well as Straight Plate, then both Fig 1 & Fig 2 needs to be shown 
     * The Fig 3 and Fig 4 (3D image), will always be shown 
     * The Notes as per attachment in User story needs to be shown 
     * The grid formed needs to be shown below as per attachment 
     * If user has entered Remarks while saving a record, then the remarks should be captured under Notes with next bullet point 
     * At the bottom in last page, under the Approved By box, the creators name and PS number should be mentioned 
     * At last this message needs to be appended: This is an electronically generated document and does not require physical signature 
  5. User can also download the record from the records detail page, once the record is saved 
  6. PDF Document name should be MoonPlate_<DocNo>


Note: Please refer attachment for PDF doc format

## US-11798 — ERP-LN get weld consumable data

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11798 |
| State | Closed |

### Description

**As a  **IIoT dashboard user, **I want to**  verify that the welding consumable specification data from ERP-LN based on the PSnumber, date and time , **So that  **I can get the weld consumable/flux item details along with the quantities

### Acceptance Criteria

Pre-Requisite: 
  

  *  ERP-LN application should have PSNumber updated 


  

  

• Functional requirements:
 
  * Integration team will get input as PSNumber (mandatory input), StartDate,EndDate from IIoT user.
  * Integration will expose an query API, which will be consumed by IIoT dashboard to pass the input.  

  * Based on the input, team will be fetching fields like: weldConsumableName,weldConsumableBatchNumber,weldKg(calculated value for issue and return quantity),projectID & SeamNumber as expected output parameters from ERP-LN application.
  * Extracted output parameters will be shared with the IIoT team in JSON structure.  



  

Non-Functional Requirements:
  

• Performance requirements: 
  

  *  Once requested data should be available to IIoT team with in 30 seconds. 
  *  API should be available 24 X 7 to IIoT team to consume 
  *  There can be multiple requests in a day 


 • Compatibility requirements:
  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

## US-11853 — IIoT to IEMQS: FTR percentage data to be delivered

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-11853 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Nagarathna Billawa |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IOT |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 7 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11853) |

### Description

**As an** IIoT dashboard user, **I want to** see welder performance by accessing quality related data called First Time Right (FTR), **so that** I can know the first time right amount work done in a percentage

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-Requisite:**
  * IIoT user should provide ProjectNo, SeamNo,Welder PS No,Start Date, End Date as Input to Integration. 
  * IEMQS database should be updated with latest values for the required fields 


  

**Functional requirements:**  

  * Integration will get ProjectNo, SeamNo,Welder PS No,Start Date, End Date as an input from IIoT user.
  * Integration will expose an query API, which will be consumed by IIoT dashboard to pass the input.
  * Based on the input, Integration team will consume IEMQS API to share the input parameters.
  * Integration will consume IEMQS API to consume the following output parameters : FTR Percentage, ProjectNo, SeamNo,Welder PS No,Start Date, End Date.
  * Extracted output parameters will be shared with the IIoT team in JSON structure.


**Non-Functional requirements:**  

**Performance requirements :**
  *  Once requested data should be available to IIoT team with in 30 seconds. 
  *  API should be available 24 X 7 to IIoT team to consume 
  *  There can be multiple requests in a day 


 **Compatibility requirements:**
NA 
**Usability requirements:**
NA 
**Security requirements:**
  API contract is applied

As a PLNG2,3, I want to access the Ovality Ring Screen, so that I can view all the existing calculations.

### Acceptance Criteria

22Functional:  

Navigation: Landing Screen-> Mega Menu-> Planning Calculation-> Ovality Ring Tab  

  

1. User should be able to view the grid with Index as per visual
2\. If there is no data, then a placeholder icon to be shown to the user 
3\. Pagination to shown as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/1c8726f6-b1f2-4083-818f-38ed27f6ee34)

6\. User should be able to view remarks by clicking on the Remarks icon
7\. If the status is draft, then the download and copy icons should be disabled for the line item and only eye button needs to be shown

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to add a new index, so that I can perform required calculations for Ovality Ring as per requirement

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  1. User should be able to add a new index on clicking the button as per visual: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/a2eb1cda-a6fb-4aba-911c-44f36ddc2424)
  2. Clicking on it should open the details page  

  3. Firstly in the left side there will be a placeholder image as per visual and in the right side user needs to enter primary details: [Flow 21 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/afbab5f0-f289-4442-ac86-2baf22d2251f-fae9/screen/42b1aa01-d1a7-4560-9a52-171b67313c9a)
  4. By default, the switch selection will be Bolting Ring 
  5. If a user continues with the Bolting Ring selection, then: 
     1. User will be required to select "Supply Ring Segment" from dropdown. 
     2. Based on the dropdown selection, appropriate sketch will appear in the left-hand side as per visual 
     3. There will be three different types of sketches based on the user input. (Refer attachment and visual for further reference) 
     4. There will be note which needs to be shown above the sketch as per visual 
        * F1. RING CAN BE MADE IN SEGMENT WITH W1 WEP. DETAILS AS PER PLATE AVAILABILITY 
        * F2. UNSPECIFIED FILLET WELD SIZE SHALL BE 0.7* MIN THK. OF MATING PARTS  

  6. If a user selects Welding Ring: 
     1. As soon as user selects option of Welding Ring, on the left side, its sketch should appear as per visual 
     2. There will be note which needs to be shown above the sketch as per visual. The note F2 will have a dynamic field, and will update as per user input selection of Segments 
        * F1. RING CAN BE MADE IN SEGMENT WITH W1 WEP. DETAILS AS PER PLATE AVAILABILITY  

        * F2- Supply Ring in XX Segments   
  

  7. User should be able to abort the process and return back to main screen, if the user doesn’t want to add new index by clicking on the Cancel button. In this case, no new line items will get added on the index page, there should be a popup as per below screenshot

### Description

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite:_**  

  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. QI3/QI2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick Links\---> Click "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page
  2. QI3/QI2 User -->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->Maintain activities page of selected favorite project.


**_Functional:_**  
  * User Should be able to view "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page shown as per visuals-_[Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/)_

    * For ICS Generated, Under Three dot-
      * User should be able to view "Print", "Timeline" button directly.

  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


****
**Navigation:  **
  1. QI3/QI2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick Links\---> Click "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page
  2. QI3/QI2 User -->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->Maintain activities page of selected favorite project.




**_Functional:_**  
  * Upon Clicking "+Add New" button in Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) Page shown as per visuals. _[Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/)_
    1. User should be able to view "Add New Digital Vertical Checklist" page as per visual.
    2. User should be able to view the hierarchy of the page via breadcrumbs with back button as per visuals.  

    3. User should be able to view "Project Number", "Assembly", "Description", "Milestone Stage", "Rev No" and "Release Date" field as per visuals. 
       * All these fields are mandatory to fill.
       * For "Project Number",
         * User should be able to enter and select from ~~multiselect~~  **single select****** Dropdown menu (Predictive search) field. 
         * User should be able to view "Project" Number of first and count of all other selected project" +X" as per visuals.  

           * Example - for total 3 person - 1st ("Project **+2)**
         * Location - Project Global master
      * For "Assembly" and "Milestone Stage",
         * User should be able to enter and select from Dropdown menu (Predictive search) field. 
         * For "Assembly" \- Dropdown menu comes from "Bill of material" table (Refer Attached Screenshot) 
         * For "Milestone Stage" - 
           * System should show a Combination of "Milestone Stage" and "Description" from the "Milestone Activity Master" Page 
           * Format - "Milestone Stage"\- "Description" 
             * Example: "Hydrotest- Coke Drum"
           * In tool tip, while hover User can see full name of the Milestone stage (If length is longer than given field size) 
             * For example- "Hydrotest- Coke Dru..."
       * For "Assembly Description" field, 
         * User should be able to enter up to 50 Character (user specific field)
         * In tool tip, while hover User can see full name of the "Description" field (If length is longer than given field size)  

       * System should show Rev No automatically and initially start with R0. 
         * Revision number is depend on Combination of "Project Number", "Assembly" and "Milestone Stage".
       * If User selected any combination of "Project Number", "Assembly" and "Milestone Stage" which already exist,   

          * System should show a confirmation pop up window with message and option "Leave" and "Continue".**(Page 59)**
            * Message -There is an existing Vertical checklist for the selected options. Click on Continue to select a new milestone stage, or you can Leave the session.           
            * Upon Clicking "Leave "
              * User should be redirected to related "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) Page".

| Field | Value |

| ID | US-11931 |

| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Chamala Jayasankar Reddy |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/11931) |

### Description

As a QI3/QI2, I want to maintain Milestone stage activities for project/Assemblies.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite:_**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**_Functional:_**  
  

**There are two flow to add activities in the "CHCEKLIST" grid. _[Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/)_**  

  * **1st flow (Automatic) -**  
    * System should automatically fetch and add list of activities in the checklist grid as per selected milestone stage automatically. 
       1. System should show Sr No. in the same sequence as per selected Milestone stage activities page.
          * Initially Start from 1 (Top row) and sequence follow. 
          * User should be able to view drag and drop buttons to move activity rows Up & Down.
       2. For all the fetched activities, System should show "Activity" field in editable form.
          * User should be able to view Multiselect checkboxes for all these activities. 
            * Initially all these activities pre-selected and User can deselect as per requirement.
          * User should be able to edit/enter in the "Activity" field. 


  * **2nd flow (Manually)-**  
    * Considering 1st flow is automatically completed and User want to add a new activity.
      * Upon clicking "+Add New Activity", 
          1. System should add a new blank row in the Checklist Grid.
          2. System should show Sr No. sequence accordingly as per the number of activities available in the checklist grid.
             * Initially Start from 1 (Top row) and sequence follow.
             * User should be able to view drag and drop buttons to move activity rows Up & Down.
          3. User should be able to enter activity in the "Activity List" (mandatory User specific) field as per visuals.
          4. System will consider NA in the category.
          5. User should be able to view Multiselect checkboxes for all new added activities also.
             * Initially all these added activities pre-selected and User can deselect as per requirement.  
  

  * Before Saving/Submitting if user changed the milestone stage,  

    * System should show a Pop-up "Confirmation" window with "Yes" and "No" buttons. 
      * Message in pop up - "Changing the Milestone Stage will discard all the updates that you have made in the Checklist Grid. Do you want to proceed?". 
      * Upon Clicking "Yes", 
        * System should clear the Checklist grid and add new list of activities as per selected Milestone stage. 
        * Refer - 1st flow again. 
      * Upon Clicking "No", 
        * System should close the pop-up window of confirmation. 


**Usability:**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to get the output based on the entered inputs for the LSR/ISR Angle calculations, so that I can proceed ahead with next steps based on the calculations

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

1\. System should apply required calculations based on provided inputs. 
2\. Once all the mandatory fields are filled by the end user, the output need to be dynamically generated and a grid as per visual needs to be shown   

3.**  Output fields:**  

**  
**
**  
**
**  
**
**  
**
**Below Values are Formula based:**
>   1. Approx BOM weight: <Values, upto 4 digit, non decimal>
>   2. QTY of ANGLE ISA (X): <Value upto 5 digit, non decimal>in mtr
>   3. QTY of END Plate: <Values, upto 5 digit, non decimal> in Nos
>   4. QTY of STUD:  <Values, upto 5 digit, non decimal>in Nos
> 

**Below Values are combination of User Input and static values :**
> >   1. Part Name: ANGLE ISA(X) - Description: 25x25 or 50x50, to be taken as per user input of ANGLE. The value "5 Thk" will be always static 
>>   2. END Plate: 
>>      1. If ANGLE ISA (X) is 25x25 then END PLATE Description should be = 20x20. The Value "6 Thk" will be always static 
>>      2. If ANGLE ISA (X) is 50x50, then END PLATE Description should be  =45x45. The Value "6 Thk" will be always static
>>   3. STUD: The value will always be static "M8 x 100 Lg"
>>   4. The values of Material for ANGLE ISA(X) and END PLATE will always be MS and hyphen for STUD 
>> 

**Logic for below display output:**
> > **  
> **
>>   1. RING OD/ID(Y) = As per user input<max 5 digit, non decimal>
>>   2. STUD TO STUD DIST. (Z) = As per user input<max 5 digit, non decimal>
>>   3. LSR ANGLE MADE IN = As per user input<max 2 digit, non decimal>
>> 

>   
> 
Note: 
  1. For calculations, please refer attachment for formula 
  2. If user has deleted any one of the input, and if that input is used as a formula in any of the output fields, then that output should become blank  

  3. User should be able to generate multiple outputs based on unique combinations of input provided by the end user

  1. IEMQS User other than QI3 User \-->Mega Menu---> Click "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page

### Description

As a PLNG2,3 I want to get the output based on the entered inputs for the Ovality Ring calculations, so that I can send the exact measurements for further steps

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional:
  

  1. System should apply required calculations based on provided inputs.  

  2. Once all the mandatory fields are filled by the end user, the output will be as below, system should dynamically generate output based on input by the end user:  

  3. **Output fields  For Type of Ring: Bolting Ring**
       * Height of Bolting Plate (H) = <in mm, maximum 3 digit, non decimal>
       * Hole (P): <in mm, maximum 2 digit, non decimal>
       * X,Y Coordinate: <in mm, maximum 3 digit, non decimal>
       * Approx BOM Weight: <in Kg, non decimal, maximum 7 digit>  
  

     * Below Fields are a combination of input and calculated outputs to be shown in grid format as per visual  

       * For line item "Ring Plate": ID: <As per user input provided>, OD<calculated value based on formula, non decimal, maximum 5 digit>, THK<As per user input>, QTY=1 _(static value)_ , ​Material= MS _(Static value),_ Remark= Note: F1 _(Static Value)_
       * For line item "Bolting Plate": <to be taken from output value (H)>, <to be taken from input value (W)>, <to be taken from input value (T)>, QTY= <calculated value, maximum 2 digit>, Material = MS (static value), Remarks<->
       * For line item "STUD": <M static value, value to be taken from input>, <LG static, value to be taken from input>, QTY<calculated value, maximum 2 digit>, Material<->, Remark (-) 
       * For line item "NUT": <M static value, value to be taken from input>, QTY<calculated value, maximum 2 digit>  
Reference Image:  
  

  4. **Output fields  For Type of Ring: Welded Ring**  

       * "Ring Plate": ID<as per user input>, OD<calculated value, maximum 5 digit, non decimal>, THK (as per user input), QTY _< static value 1>,__ __​_ Material = MS _Static Value,_ Remark= F1
  5. Above the sketch, after the output is generated, in the Note, the number of segments should be updated:  
  



Note: 
  1. For calculations, please refer attachment for formula 
  2. If user has deleted any one of the input, and if that input is used as a formula in any of the output fields, then that output should become blank  

  3. User should be able to generate multiple outputs based on unique combinations of input provided by the end user

     * The Doc No should be system generated and the nomenclature will be: If user has selected Type of Ring as Welded Ring and the Ring THK is 30 and SL No is 1 then Doc No will be **WR-30-1**.      * The Doc should append the latest date of printing that document 
     * Notes: 
       * In case of Type of Ring selected is "Bolting Ring", then the Notes should be as per visual in which F3 will be printed if user has provided remarks. Note F1, and F2 will be static and will always be printed 
       * In case of Type of Ring selected is "Welded Ring". then the Note F1 will be static, F2 will be a combination of static and dynamic content, and F3 will be printed if user has provided Remarks 
     * At the bottom under the Prepared By box, the user downloading the record, his/her PS No and name should get captured as per login 
     * At last this message needs to be appended: **This document is system generated, physical signature is not required**

### Description

As a PLNG2,3, I want to access the Copy functionality in the Ovality Ring calculations, so that I can reuse existing records entries

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. In the index page of Ovality Ring, user should be able to see a copy button next to each saved records line item. (Status to be Completed) 
  2. Clicking on Copy should open a new Index's detail page, with all the input as well as output fields. Please not that these input fields will be in editable mode. 
     1. If user has copied a line item of Bolting Ring with 2 segment, then in details page, by default the Bolting ring will be shown with 2 segments and the figure, user can change the segments here. Also, the switch button will be hidden, and if a user wants to enter data for other ring like welding ring, then user will not be able to do so 
  3. User should be able to enter the inputs fields again as per requirement. 
  4. Save Button: 
     1. The save button will be activated only when the user has provided combination of inputs which is unique from the copied record 
     2. If the user doesn't make changes in the input fields, then the Save button will be disabled. 
  5. Once the record is saved a new line item in the index should be made.

## US-12313 — Scanning Document: Image Processing

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-12313 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Rajeshwari Ariappan |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 12 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/12313) |

### Description

As a IEMQS user, I want to scan the document, so that I will be able to know whether the document in use is latest or outdated

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. The camera should scan the image and show the relevant result on click of shutter button  

  2. The system should process the image after scanning and should follow as per visual design [DCR (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/10341a6f-0558-4aaf-821c-466c6849f5c6-4567/)
  3. In case the image is not properly scanned due to any reason (not properly handling device, document is folded or not in proper shape to scan) system should display relevant error message as per visual 
  4. The system should capture project no, document no, revision no, upon successful scanning of the image
  5. A success toast message will appear after successful scanning
  6. Post the display of toast message system should dynamically populate results 


**Logic for fetching and displaying results based on scanned document for both the scenarios**
**  
**
  * Document Verification Logic


  1. System should process the image data (Project No, Document, Revision No, Document Issue Date) and should pass the data to DIN tables for getting latest details  

  2. Conditions to be checked in DIN table:  

     1. The Project No, Document No and Revision No, should match the latest issued DIN (Document Index Note)
     2. The document should be released
     3. DIN should be released for the scanned project 
        1. If there are more than one projects scanned through image, then system should pass first project to DIN table 
     4. If there are multiple DIN present in a project, then all the released DIN should be checked


**
DB Tables:
    * DES081    Maintain DIN 
    * DES082    DIN Reference Document 
    * DES083    DIN Life Cycle 
    * DES084    DIN History 
    * DES059    Maintain document 
    * DES060    Document mapping 
    * DES089    Maintain DCR 


  

**
  * DCR fetching logic 
    1. System should pass all projects one by one along with document no and revision no to get applicable DCR. System should check in DCR table- Main project and applicable project fields in DCR table (DES089) 
    2. DCR should be in "released" state only 
    3. Clicking on DCR should redirect to the details page of DCR : <https://iemqs.lthed.com/DES/DCR/Detail?q=pqYqU/RkxTJ33m5247ZiuQ==> of the selected DCR . (This link is for reference purpose only) 


**Scenario 1: Document is Outdated**
  1. User should be able to view three grids as per visual 
  2. The first grid will show the result as outdated and display the scanned project no, document no, rev no and Doc Issue Date. Please note that in case there are more than one project available, then system will show the first project. Please note that the value for Doc Issue Date needs to be fetched from DIN Released Date (DB- DES083) 
  3. In the next grid, system should show the latest available documents project no, document no, and rev no. . Also, it will contain the Doc Issue Date as well 
  4. In the third grid, if the latest document has DCR or Applicable projects, or only Applicable projects or both, then those should be shown as per visual
     1. In case the Applicable projects don't have any DCR, then in the DCR column a message needs to be shown as "No Released DCR". 
     2. The DCR's will be clickable and clicking on it should take to the relevant DCR detail page
     3. For Reference purpose only, please refer actual visual design for correct data:
     4.   
  
  




**Scenario 2: Document is Latest**  

  1. User should be able to view two grids as per visual
     1. The first grid will show the status as verified along with Project No, Document No, Rev No and Doc Issue Date
  2. In the second grid, if the document has DCR or Applicable projects, or only Applicable projects or both, then those should be shown as per visual
     1. In case the Applicable projects don't have any DCR, then in the DCR column a message needs to be shown as "No Released DCR". 
     2. The DCR's will be clickable and clicking on it should take to the relevant DCR detail page




Note: 
  1. The breadcrumbs, arrow button needs to be shown and should be accessible as per visual 
  2. Clicking on arrow button will take the user to scan document screen:  
  

  3. Clicking again on the floating document verification icon will open the scan document screen

### Description

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite:  
US: 12313 
Navigation: Landing Page-> Document Verification Icon 
Functional: 
  

**Scenario 1 - First Time Manual Input**
  1. User should be able to enter below details manually after clicking on the manual icon 
     1. Project No: System should dynamically populate data as soon as user type relevant keyword, user can either pick value from dropdown or can write manually. (DB-COM001 to be used for project no) 
     2. Document No: System should dynamically populate data as soon as user type relevant keyword, user can either pick value from dropdown or can write manually
     3. Revision No: This will be a user input; system should not dynamically populate values here. Validations- Numeric values, max length=2 
  2. Before entering the above mandatory fields, a placeholder as per visual needs to be shown: [DCR (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/10341a6f-0558-4aaf-821c-466c6849f5c6-4567/screen/2dbb6754-048a-4850-a59a-327c91358574)

  4. A success toast message needs to be shown after display of the result  

  5. If the user has entered invalid inputs or inputs which don't have any relevant results, then the placeholder image needs to be shown as per visual 


Please note that the output whether it is verified or outdated should follow the same logic and screen as per US#12313 
  

**Scenario 2  **\- Modifying Input****
  1. If user has entered values and generated output, and again if a user want to update the input fields then user can do so 
  2. If user modifies Project No, then the Document number and Rev number fields should get reset 
  3. If user modifies Document No, then the Project No will remain as it is and the Rev No should get reset 
  4. If user modifies Revision No, then the Project No and Document No will remain as it is 
  5. Once user modifies input fields, then system should dynamically show result along with a success toast 
  6. If the user has entered invalid inputs or inputs which don't have any relevant results, then the placeholder image needs to be shown as per visual 


Note: 
  1. The breadcrumbs, arrow button needs to be shown and should be accessible as per visual 
  2. Clicking on arrow button will take the user to scan document screen:  
  

  3. Clicking again on the floating document verification icon will open the scan document screen

## US-12382 — FTR Button functionality

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-12382 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Rajeshwari Ariappan |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/12382) |

### Description

As a QI3/QI2, I want to maintain Milestone stage activities for project/Assemblies.

### Acceptance Criteria

**
**Pre-requisite:**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 


  
**
**Functional:**
**  
**
**FTR on Index page for "ICS Generated" status,**  

  * For ICS Generated status on Index page of Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) Page shown as per visuals-_[Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/)_
    * User should be able to view "FTR "(First Time Right) column with percentage in every row shown as per visuals.
      * User should be able to view "X%" shown as per visuals.
      * System should show percentage on the basis of out of Z activities, Y activities cleared first times and didn't return back to Action by user.
        * FTR = (Y/Z) * 100 =X%
      * System should capture the data as per number of activities submitted and didn't return back to action by user directly cleared.
      * Timeline of activities -Not Started--->Under inspection-----> Cleared.  

        * OR System should capture data with the help of activities status to understand how many activities are cleared in first time.
        * Exception \- In new revision, if QC change "Action by" person, System should consider timeline Latest from Not started to Cleared timeline flow chain. 
          * Timeline of activities - Not Started--->Under inspection\---->**Not started \--->Under inspection---->Cleared.**  

    * Example -   

      * For a project we added 10 new activities-  

      * For 6 activities Status flow are - Not Started--->Under inspection---->Cleared  

        * Cleared in first flow and didn't return back to Action By user.
      * For 4 activities Status flow are- Not Started--->Under inspection---->**Returned** \--->Under inspection---->Cleared.  

        * Didn't Cleared in first flow and return back to Action By user. 
      * Out of 10 Activities, 6 activities cleared in first time and didn't return back to the "Action by" User.  

        * Hence, FTR = (6/10) * 100 = 60%.  



  

**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

**Notes -**
****
Continuous of,
**Maintain Activities for Action by User -1,  **Refer [#12328](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12328).
**Maintain Activities for Action by User -2,  **Refer [#12331](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12331)   

  

**_Functional:_**  
  * User should be able to view "**Submit " **button shown as per visuals. [Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/screen/bc468b55-e642-4032-b8fa-668f5398c0e9)
  * Upon Clicking "Submit" button,
    1. If activity has assigned to a category, 
       * First, system should show Category wise Confirmation pop-up with "Yes" and "No" button, upon clicking "Yes",
          * Systems should show pop-up window of "Clear Confirmation " with "Yes" and "No" button,
       * Not Applicable for Activity assigned to "NA" Category 
    2. If activity category is **" NA".**
       * System should directly show a pop-up window of "Submit (offer) ".
       * Not applicable if activity is assigned to a Category (other than "NA").
    *     * System should show a pop-up window of "Submit (Offer)" Confirmation.  

      * User should be able to view "Remark (Optional)" field shown as per visuals.
        * User should be able to enter in remark field and It's not mandatory.
      * Upon Clicking Submit button,  

        * System should show a message "Activity Submitted Successfully" shown as per visuals.  

        * System should update the "Remark" column field of respective activity row with the latest remark.  

        * As per the status,  

          * System should update the status of respected activity row from "Not started" to "Under inspection" status.  

          * System should update the status of respected activity row from "Returned" to "Under inspection" status.  

      * For activities which are assigned to multiple "Action by" person, 
        * Any one of the "Action by" (Whichever submitted first) person can submit only. 
          * Status will update for all the "Action by" person automatically.

## US-12629 — Mfg. Search Result - Running Steam Status

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-12629 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/12629) |

### Description

As a MFG2, PROD3 user, I want to view the Running Seam status as per rules set, so that, I can quickly access it for assessing the status of Seams

### Acceptance Criteria

2Functional: 
  1. Once the user clicks on search button, then the relevant results as per input parameters for the created group needs to be shown: [Production (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a46c498f-9086-40f1-b2b6-fee2fc8c94b3-f13f/screen/4feb0fbc-e699-4e84-ba79-6c5c8d376599) under the created group name 
  2. If a user has picked any specific time from the Shop status dropdown, then the results will be generated accordingly. For example, if a user has selected time as 6 hours, then the line items with delay of more than 6 hours needs to be shown in the search results. If user has not selected any value form shop status dropdown, then all the results which are ready to offer will be shown as per the search parameters 
  3. Also, on click of search, the entered parameter details under the group name will be stored in DB against the logged in users PS No, so that once the user comes back, then the user can revisit the dashboard quickly 
  4. All the line items with Status as "Ready to Offer/Returned/Rejected" will be displayed 
  5. User should be able to access the pagination feature 
  6. The created group should get replicated with the selected search parameters in QC as well as NDE tabs 
  7. The count for all the three dashboards needs to be shown as per visual, please note that this count will change if user makes any changes in the group's search parameters or switch to other group. The logic for count is- its the summation of all the line items present in the grid  
  

  8. The right side search parameters bar can be collapsed or expanded by clicking on the button on top right hand side corner 


Logic for displaying Result: 
  1. System should check the seam inspection status as Ready to Offer/Returned/Rejected 
  2. Delay Logic 
     1. The system should check the Clearance date and time of previous stage. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn   
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
     2. If the line item is the first stage of ICL, then the delay should be displayed as hyphen (-) always 
  3. If the seam is returned or rejected by the approver, then the time count will increase accordingly. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn  
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
  4. The time delay color coding will be as below: 
     1. Green: Delay of 0-2 hours 
     2. Orange: Delay of More than 2 and less than equal to 4 hours 
     3. Red: Delay of more than 4 hours 


The data, logic and DB tables, needs to be referred from Legacy portal for displaying the results 
Path: Login->In Process Inspection-> Offer/Reoffer Inspection Seam (Login Id- Vishal Prajapati)

     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:  **  

  

Upon Clicking Link of "ICS Generated",
>   * System should redirect User to Inspection Clearance Slip Page (Draft) (Refer attached image)
    * Link - [Inspection Clearance Slip :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/ICS/Maintain/Details)
    * System should fetch the "Project no from" and "Project no to" from Maintain Activities page.  

    * System should show same project no. in both the fields.

  * System should fetch and view all the "Drawing No." from project H-BOM.

## US-12744 — Mfg. Top Filter

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-12744 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/12744) |

### Description

As a MFG2, PROD3 user, I want to filter data as per the delay time, so that I can quickly find out relevant items which are delayed

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: User should have searched the results at least once and the grid should have populated on the left side 
Functional: 
  1. The top box will contain total count of line items as per search parameters in terms of various time delays as per visual. The logic will be, for the filter "Delayed by 1-2 hours", it will show all the seams with delay between one to two hours. Similarly the logic needs to be followed for 2-4 hours, 4-9 hours and 9+ hours.  

  2. User should be able to filter grid data as per Delay 
  3. Reference Visual: [Production (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a46c498f-9086-40f1-b2b6-fee2fc8c94b3-f13f/screen/3f7d55f7-0757-4207-bfb2-e41efc6e02c1)  

  4. The data in this filter should be dynamically generated as per the search result and based on the delay time 
  5. Clicking on any box should generate relevant delay items in the grid 
  6. If the user wants to clear this filter and view all the data, then the user can click on All button 
  7. In case any box has no delayed seam to show, then the count will be shown as 0 and it should not be clickable in this scenario

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-12752 |

| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | parameshwari.babu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/12752) |

### Description

As a QI3/QI2, I want to maintain Milestone stage activities for project/Assemblies.

### Acceptance Criteria

* System should update the "Remark" column field of all submitted activity row with the latest remark.


**Pre-requisite:**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:  **  

**  
**
**continuous of  Submitted-1 status row  -[#12253](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12253) **
**For Submitted****  status row -**
**  
**
  * User should be able to view "Clear All" button shown as per visuals. [Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages) (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a2d0f14b-885a-407a-bfb2-32dcb8d7debf-f783/screen/bc468b55-e642-4032-b8fa-668f5398c0e9)
    * System should enabled the "Clear All" button only if,  

      * At least a single activity is available with "Under Inspection" status with "NA" category in Checklist gird.
      * Else system should disable the "Clear" All button for all other category and "other" status
    * System should disable the "Clear All" button,
      * If all available "Under Inspection" status activities are with category other than "NA in Checklist gird.
    * Not Applicable for activities category other than "NA"  

  * Upon clicking "Clear All" button,  

    * "Clear All" button functionality should be dynamic to the checklist grid.
      * If User filtered activities on the checklist grid,
        * "Clear All" button should be applied only those applicable activities. 
      * If User didn't filter activities or cleared the previously used/initials filters,
        * "Clear All" button should be applied to all applicable activities of the checklist grid. 
    * System should show a pop-up window of "Confirmation" with "Yes" and "No"
    * Confirmation Message in pop up window-  

      * 1st message -"{X}" activities that fall into specific categories must be cleared separately.
        * X means - Total count of activities with “Under Inspection" status and with other than "NA" category
        * Example - "5" activities that fall into specific categories must be cleared separately.
      * 2nd Message -"Are you sure you want to clear all "{Y}" “Under Inspection" activities?"
        * Y means - Total count of activities with “Under Inspection" status and with "NA" category
        * Example - Are you sure you want to submit all "30" “Under Inspection" activities.
    * Upon Clicking "Yes" button - System should a message "Activities Cleared Successfully".  

      * System should clear all the activities of Under-inspection status with category "NA".  

      * System should update the status of all clear activity row from "Under inspection" to "Cleared" status.  

      * System should update the "Remark" column field of all cleared activity row with the latest remark.
        * Applicable only if user added remark in remark filled while submitting.
      * If all the activities under the checklist Grid are cleared,  

        * System should update the status from "Submitted" to "ICS Generated" for the respective project row in the index Grid of "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)  

      * After clearing of last Activity from Checklist Grid, System should send auto generated Mail to the QI who has maintained this activities list.  

        * Mail should contain link of "ICS generated" page.   

          * System should add a new row at index page of ICS generated page in draft status.  

        * ICS generated -Refer US [#12670](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12670)   

    * Upon Clicking "No" \- System should a close the pop-up window.  



**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

        * X means - Number of count of activities with (“Not Started”+"Returned") status and with other than "NA" category
        * Example - "5" activities that fall into specific categories must be submitted separately.
      * 2nd Message -"Are you sure you want to submit all (“Not started” & "Returned") "{Y}" activities?"
        * Y means - Number of count of activities with ("Not started"\+ "Returned") status and with "NA" category
        * Example - Are you sure you want to submit all “Not started” "30" activities.
    * Upon Clicking "Yes" button - 
      * System should show a message "Activities submitted Successfully".
      * System should submit all the activities of "Not started" status with category "NA".
      * System should update the status of all submitted activity row from "Not started" / "Returned" to "Under inspection" status.  

      * System should update the "Remark" column field of all submitted activity row with the latest remark.
        * Applicable only if user added remark in remark filled while submitting.  

      * System should send notification to QC.  

      * For notification functionality,
        * Refer 3 and 4 points of [#12656](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12656) 
    * Upon Clicking "No" \- System should a close the pop-up window.  



**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

        *        * Upon Clicking "Responsible Department" field User should be able to view list in dropdown menu.

  4. User should be able to view **" Target Date"** field shown as per visuals.  

     * Upon clicking field or calendar icon, User should be able to view and select date from the "Calendar" as shown as per visuals.
     * "Target Date" is Mandatory field.
  5. User should be able to view **" To be completed before" **field shown as per visuals.
     * User should be able to enter & select "Responsible Department" from single select dropdown menu with predictive search functionality.  

     * "To be completed before" is Mandatory field.

### Description

As a IEMQS user, I want to View level wise links of "Milestone Stage Master" page and "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page in Mega Menu and add links in Quick links. So that, I can quickly access the same.

### Acceptance Criteria

**__**
**__**
******Pre-requisite:  
**
  * User should be able to logged in the system. 
  * As per PS No, 
  * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
  * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  
**
  * QI2 User -->Mega Menu---> Click "Milestone Stage Master" Page. 
  * QI2 User -->Select favorite project-->Quick Links--->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->Respective level wise Maintain activities page of selected favorite project. 
  * All IEMQS Users -->Mega Menu---> Click Respective level wise "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" Page. 
  * All IEMQS Users -->Select favorite project-->Quick Links--->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->Respective level wise Maintain activities page of selected favorite project. 


  

**Functional:  
**
  

Feature  | Function  | Module  | Sub Process  | Locations  | Roles   
---|---|---|---|---|---  
3845  | Quality Control  | Final Inspection  | "Milestone Stages Master" | HZW,LTP,PEW,RNW  | QI2   
3845  | Quality Control  | Final Inspection  | "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" | HZW,LTP,PEW,RNW  | QI2 and QI3   
3845  | Quality Control  | Final Inspection  | "Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" | HZW,LTP,PEW,RNW  | All IEMQS Users - User wise page functionlity will change   
  

  

  * In Mega Menu, this module needs to be shown as per above mentioned flow.
  * For Quick links, 
    * User can add links  "Milestone Stages Master" and Digital Vertical Checklist (Milestone Stages)" from Mega menu.
    * When a User accessing session through Quick link from Landing Page, 
      * System should respective level wise Maintain activities page of selected favorite project.
  * From MEGA Menu  

    * In all feature as per prototype, User should be able to view left Side menu bar.
    * Upon click on side Menu bar
      * System should be able to enable only links which are not related to project.
        * example - SIN  

      * System should disable all the project specific links.
  * From selected Favourite page then Notification/Quick Link, 
    * User should be able to view left Side menu bar as per prototype.
    * Upon click on side Menu bar
      * User should be able to view side bar menu as per selected favourite project. 


**Usability:**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a QA1, QA2, QA3, QC1, QC2, QC3, NDE1, NDE2, NDE3 user, I want to enable the client for getting e-sign using WACOM device, so that the TPI/client can review and sign on them

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
  1. Toggle button should be active for View as customer 
  2. Records should have been sent for getting it signed to TPI from legacy portal 


Functional: 
  * User should be able to view the digital pen icon on opening the PDF as per visual: [Flow 4 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/18edfa74-4ac0-4d63-aca3-f328c7431fd7-4dbe/screen/25200ddc-e6d1-4c36-865e-490f6d50ed4e)

  * On click of the signature box area, the system popup should appear for connecting the WACOM device. Once the device is connected, user can put their signature and once they are satisfied, they can confirm it. They may also clear and e-sign again using the clear button.  Post signing, the signature will be displayed on the signature box. 
  * After this, user can approve and the signature will be pasted over the document as per selected TPI 
  * The same behavior will also be applied in case of multiple selection of documents for e-signing
