     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. All IEMQS user Other than QI2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click "Maintain Critical to Quality" Page


**Functional:**  
  

Continuous of [#13274](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13274)

  * User should be able to view three section,

    2. System should show "Responsible Department" wise tabs.
       * System should**scroll down page directly to the "Responsible Department" sections.**
          * User should be able to view his department tab first as shown as per visual.
          * "CTQ implementation" section should be comes under the Responsible department as shown as per visuals
    3. SUPPORTING DOCUMEMNT ({X}) 
       * X - Number of counts of total uploaded documents
  * First **"**CTQ details " section ****\- User should be able to view all below fields under the**CTQ details section  **in **view only mode.**
      1. "Reference Doc Type"  

      2. "Reference Doc no",
      3. "Clause No. (optional)"
      4. "Initiating Department"
      5. "CTQ Description" 
      6. "Is CTQ applicable to Milestone Stage (Optional)" 
      7. "Milestone Stage"
      8. "CTQ applicable to Seam(optional)"
      9. "Seam Type"
      10. "Seam Number (Optional)" 
      11. "CTQ applicable to Part/Assembly (optional)" 
      12. "Part/Assembly Number" 
      13. "Is CTQ applicable to Blasting and coating (Optional)"  

      14. "Is Inspection Protocol required for CTQ"   
  

  * Second **" Responsible department Wise sections" **\- Every department should have his own Section and fields.  

    * User can edit his department fields only and view other department sections in view only mode as shown as per visuals.  

    * User should be able to view all below fields under every section of responsible department tab shown as per visuals.  

    * System should fetch fields data automatically and show data in **view only mode.**  

      1. "Action To Be Taken.
      2. "Applicable Document (optional)"  

      3. "JEP Document "
      4. "To be completed before"
      5. "Target Date"
      6. CTQ Implementation session  



  

  * Third -"**Through document "** Under CTQ Implementation session, 
    * For **" Yes"** in "Through document", 
      * User should be able to view "CTQ Doc Status by Responsible Dept", " Doc No. Rev. by Responsible Dept" and "Verified by QC" shown as per visuals.
      * User should be able to enter and select from** ****" CTQ Doc Status by Responsible Dept"** single select dropdown menu with static options.
        * Static options are "Completed", "In- Progress", "Pending" and "Not- Applicable".
        * Mandatory field to select from dropdown menu
      * User should be able to enter in** ******"  Doc No. Rev. by Responsible Dept" field (user specific mandatory field)
      * User should be able to view "Verified by QC" in ****view only mode.****  

    * For **" No"** in Through document",  

      * System should hide "CTQ Doc Status by Responsible Dept", " Doc No. Rev. by Responsible Dept" and "Verified by QC" shown as per visuals.  
  

  * Fourth **-******" At Working Level Team"********** ** Under CTQ Implementation session shown as per visuals <https://xd.adobe.com/view/5071ffd0-4e81-49b3-a29e-f66c17b7711c-0522/> 
    * **For  **" Yes"** in **" At Working Level Team"**  
**
    * User should be able to view "Training / TBT Required", "Attendance Record / Photo" and "Verified by QC" shown as per visuals.
    * User should be able to enter and select from **" Training / TBT Required"** single select dropdown menu with static options.
      * Static options are "Yes", "No" and "Not Applicable" (Mandatory field to select)
      * If User select "No" or "Not Applicable", "Attendance Record / Photo" field should be disabled.  

      * If User select "Yes", "Attendance Record / Photo" field should be mandatory.
        * Upon clicking on Attendance Record / Photo" file attachment icon,
          * System should open a pop-up window of "Upload Attendance Record / Photo" should be open to upload file with "Cancel" and "Save" button. 
          * **Mandatory to attach single file.**
          * User can drag and drop or click "Upload a File" button to add file. 
            * User can deselect file with cross sign. 
          * Upon clicking "**Save** "  

            * Uploaded files should be shown as Hyperlink in the "Attendance Record / Photo".
            * System should save file and close a pop-up window of "Upload Attendance Record / Photo".
          * Upon clicking "**Cancel** "  

            * System should close a pop-up window of "Upload Attendance Record / Photo".
            * System should not save any attached file.
    *  User should be able to view "Verified by QC" in ****view only mode.****  

    * For **" No"** in At Working Level Team**" ,**
      * System should hide "Training / TBT Required", "Attendance Record / Photo" and "Verified by QC" shown as per visuals.


  

**

**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-13305 — QC Search Result - Running Steam Status

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13305 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13305) |

### Description

As a QC-1/2/3 user, I want to view the Running Seam status as per rules set, so that, I can quickly access it for assessing the status of Seams

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. Once the user clicks on search button, then the relevant results as per input parameters for the created group needs to be shown: [QC Service (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/d5b1dc51-a70e-4291-99b4-47435bbe4c5e-80e2/screen/47afcc74-a808-4c0a-95f1-1dd6e2fab9f7) under the created group name 
  2. If a user has picked any specific time from the Shop status dropdown, then the results will be generated accordingly. For example, if a user has selected time as 6 hours, then the line items with delay of more than 6 hours needs to be shown in the search results. If user has not selected any value form shop status dropdown, then all the results which are offered will be shown 
  3. Also, on click of search, the entered parameter details under the group name will be stored in DB against the logged in users PS No, so that once the user comes back, then the user can revisit the dashboard quickly 
  4. All the line items with Status as "Offered" will be displayed 
  5. User should be able to access the pagination feature 
  6. The created group should get replicated with the selected search parameters for NDE tab as well 
  7. The count for all the dashboards needs to be shown as per visual, please note that this count will change if user makes any changes in the group's search parameters or switch to other group. The logic for count is- it's the summation of all the line items present in the grid  
  

  8. The right-side search parameters bar can be collapsed or expanded by clicking on the button on top right-hand side corner.  



  

  

Logic for displaying Result:
  1. System should check the seam inspection status as Offered
  2. Delay Logic
     1. The system should check the Clearance date and time of previous stage. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn  
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
  3. If the seam is returned or rejected by the approver, then the time count will increase accordingly. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn  
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
  4. The time delay color coding will be as below:
     1. Green: Delay of 0-2 hours
     2. Orange: Delay of More than 2 and less than equal to 4 hours
     3. Red: Delay of more than 4 hours


  

  

  

The data, logic and DB tables, needs to be referred from Legacy portal for displaying the results 
Path: Login->In Process Inspection-> Test Result for Inspection-Seam (Login Id- Ulhas B Patil)

### Description

As a QC-1/2/3 user, I want to filter data as per the delay time, so that I can quickly find out relevant items which are delayed

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: User should have searched the results at least once and the grid should have populated on the left side 
Functional: 
  1. The top box will contain total count of line items as per search parameters in terms of various time delays as per visual. The logic will be, for the filter "Delayed by 1-2 hours", it will show all the seams with delay between one to two hours. Similarly the logic needs to be followed for 2-4 hours, 4-9 hours and 9+ hours.

  4. The data in this filter should be dynamically generated as per the search result and based on the delay time 
  5. Clicking on any box should generate relevant delay items in the grid 
  6. If the user wants to clear this filter and view all the data, then the user can click on All button 
  7. In case any box has no delayed seam to show, then the count will be shown as 0 and it should not be clickable in this scenario

         * "Part/Assembly Number" with (i) - Mandatory field, if "CTQ applicable to Part/Assembly (optional)" is applicable.

    * User should be able to view **" Edit Department"** button at the right end of the session.

  5. Upon clicking "**C****lose "** button,
     * System should close the page and revert back to the "{"CTQ Doc. No."} Draft" page.

## US-13319 — NDE Search Result - Running Steam Status

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13319 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |

| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13319) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to view the Running Seam status as per rules set, so that, I can quickly access it for assessing the status of Seams

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. Once the user clicks on search button, then the relevant results as per input parameters for the created group needs to be shown: [NDE Service (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/7364fee8-4371-4c26-8cd4-f657cd7f3c73-2637/screen/cfa1affb-dd86-437f-aaf6-ea615af3da7f) under the created group name 
  2. If a user has picked any specific time from the Shop status dropdown, then the results will be generated accordingly. For example, if a user has selected time as 6 hours, then the line items with delay of more than 6 hours needs to be shown in the search results. If user has not selected any value form shop status dropdown, then all the results which are offered will be shown 
  3. Also, on click of search, the entered parameter details under the group name will be stored in DB against the logged in users PS No, so that once the user comes back, then the user can revisit the dashboard quickly 
  4. All the line items with Status as "Offered" will be displayed 
  5. User should be able to access the pagination feature 
  6. The right-side search parameters bar can be collapsed or expanded by clicking on the button on top right-hand side corner.  



Logic for displaying Result:
  1. System should check the seam inspection status as Offered
  2. Delay Logic
     1. The system should check the Clearance date and time of previous stage. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn  
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
  3. If the seam is returned or rejected by the approver, then the time count will increase accordingly. (Refer DB table. Seam(QC Stages) - QMS050.InspectedOn  
Seam(NDE Stages) - QMS060.TPIInspectedOn
  4. ~~The time delay color coding will be as below: ~~
     1. ~~Green: Delay of 0-8 hours ~~
     2. ~~Orange: Delay of More than 8 and less than equal to 16 hours ~~
     3. ~~Red: Delay of more than 16 hours~~
  5. The time delay color coding will be as below:
     1. Green: Delay of 0-2 hours
     2. Orange: Delay of More than 2 and less than equal to 4 hours
     3. Red: Delay of more than 4 hours


  

The data, logic and DB tables, needs to be referred from Legacy portal for displaying the results 
Path: Login->In Process Inspection-> NDE Test Result - Seam  (Login Id- Ajit Anupam) 
For Reference: [NDE Seam Test Details :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/IPI/SeamListNDEInspection/NDEView)

## US-13323 — NDE - Top Filter

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13323 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13323) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to filter data as per the delay time, so that I can quickly find out relevant items which are delayed

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: User should have searched the results at least once and the grid should have populated on the left side 
Functional: 
  1. The top box will contain total count of line items as per search parameters in terms of various time delays as per visual. The logic will be, for the filter "Delayed by 8+ hours", it will show summation of all the seams with delay of more than eight hours. Similarly, if the filter is "Delayed by 16+ hours", it will show summation of all the seams with delay of more than sixteen hours. Likewise for filter 24+ and 32+hours respectively  

  2. User should be able to filter grid data as per Delay 
  3. Reference Visual: [NDE Service (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/7364fee8-4371-4c26-8cd4-f657cd7f3c73-2637/screen/58cd1179-6f2f-4929-9c77-d58dd0aa4d9e)  

  4. The data in this filter should be dynamically generated as per the search result and based on the delay time 
  5. Clicking on any box should generate relevant delay items in the grid 
  6. If the user wants to clear this filter and view all the data, then the user can click on All button 
  7. In case any box has no delayed seam to show, then the count will be shown as 0 and it should not be clickable in this scenario

## US-13361 — QI2 -"{"CTQ Doc. No."} DRAFT" 3 - Pending dept/Approve/close

| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 17 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13361) |

### Description

As a QI2 user, I want to maintain CTQ identified in project so that I can Approve and close identified CTQ in project.

### Acceptance Criteria

e​**Pre-requisite:**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. QI2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click "Approve Critical To Quality" Page


  

**Functional:**    

For Draft status "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} project row at "Approve Critical To Quality" page grid.  

Continuous of 
  

Continuous of [#13308](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13308)   

  1. User should be able to view "**Pending Department " and "Approve" **button" for grid in "{"CTQ Doc. No."}** **DRAFT** "** page shown as per visuals. [Approve/Close Critical To Quality_QI2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/e21608ee-250f-4df6-9fa2-7e5a8503ed79-b745/screen/77b688e4-552c-4e50-a4c4-c5ecab1c8280)  

     1. **Flow 1**  - If any one or more than one selected "Action by Department" not submitted any (At least one) CTQ record or didn't select "No CTQ" option.
        * System should **enable the Pending Department** **button** and Disable the Approve button.  **(Refer Page 4****)**
          * As per mapping of "Action by Department" list and "Created Department" field. (Just for information)
     2. **Flow 2 -  **If all the selected "Action by Department" submitted at least a single CTQ record or selected "NO CTQ" option.
        * System should Disable the Pending Department button and **enable the Approve button.**
  2. Upon clicking of **" Pending Department"** button,  

     * System should show an overlay window of "Pending Department/s for "{"CTQ Doc. No."}"  

       * System should show the list containing the name of "Action by Department" who didn't submit any CTQ record or didn't select "No CTQ" option.  

     * User should be able to view Close button, Upon clicking of "Close" button, 
         * System should close the overlay window of "Pending Department/s for "{"CTQ Doc. No."}"  

  3. User should be able to view "**Approve " **button" for grid in "{"CTQ Doc. No."}** **DRAFT** "** page,  

     * **1st case -  **In Backend, System will check for **flow 1 and flow 2 validation** first and accordingly enable and disable "Approve" button. 
     * **2nd case** \- System should validate all mandatory fields should be in filled/taken action in all the selected records. (Status should be in "Draft "or "Submitted")
        1. If any one of CTQ records in grid are in "Draft " and "Submitted" status (all mandatory fields are not filled/action taken)
           * System should disable the "Approve" button and in hover of disable "Approve" button, 
             * User should be able to view message "Enable when all data is entered".  

        2. If all the selected records are in "Draft " or "Submitted" status (all mandatory fields are filled/action taken)
          * System should enable the "Approve" button, Upon Clicking Approve button - 
           * System should show a popup window of "Approve Confirmation" with "Yes" and "No" button as shown as per visual.  

           * Message in pop up window - "Do you want to Approve this CTQ?  

           * Upon clicking "Yes" button,  

             * System should show a message - "{"CTQ Doc. No."} has been approved successfully".
             * System should change status of submitted record row from,
               * "Draft " to "Approved" status.
               * "Submitted" to "Approved" status.  

             * System should change status from "Critical To Quality Detail **DRAFT** " page to "Critical To Quality Detail **APPROVED** " page.
             * System should Change the respective "{"CTQ Doc. No."} status from **DRAFT** " to **APPROVED** " in the Index Page of Approve/Close Critical to Quality Page.
           * Upon clicking "No" button,  

             * System should show close the popup window of "Approve Confirmation".  

  4. User should be able to view "**Close " **button" in "{"CTQ Doc. No."}** **DRAFT** "** page,
     * Upon clicking of close button, User should be revert to "Approve/Close Critical To Quality" Page.

User should be able to view "CTQ Detail" session in "Critical To Quality Detail **Draft** " Page  

​**Pre-requisite:**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:**  
Continuous of [#13308](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13308) 
  * Upon click on "+ADD Detail ", System should redirect user to "Critical to Quality **DRAFT** " page shown as per visuals. [Approve/Close Critical To Quality_QI2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/e21608ee-250f-4df6-9fa2-7e5a8503ed79-b745/screen/77b688e4-552c-4e50-a4c4-c5ecab1c8280)  **(Refer Page 6****)**
  * User should be able to view three sections, 
    1. CTQ DETAILS
    2. System should create and show "Responsible Department" wise tabs as shown as per visuals.
       * User should be able to view "Edit Department" button. 
         * If there are no department, 
         * Mandatory to add/select at least single Department. 
       * "CTQ implementation" section should be comes under the Responsible department as shown as per visuals.  

    3. SUPPORTING DOCUMEMNT ({X}) 
       1. X - Number of counts of total uploaded documents 
    * Detail Field by functionality covered in [#13048](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13048) and [#13050](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13050)  
  * First "CTQ details" section - 
    * User should be able to view all below fields under the CTQ details section in **edit mode.**
      1. "Reference Doc Type" -Mandatory field  

      2. "Reference Doc no"- Mandatory field
      3. "Clause No. (optional)"
      4. "Initiating Department" - Mandatory field
      5. "CTQ Description" - Mandatory field
      6. "Is CTQ applicable to Milestone Stage (Optional)" 
         * "Milestone Stage" with (i) - Mandatory field, if "Is CTQ applicable to Milestone Stage (Optional)" is applicable.
      7. "CTQ applicable to Seam(optional)"
         * "Seam Type" with (i) - Mandatory field, if "CTQ applicable to Seam (optional)" is applicable.
         * "Seam Number (Optional)" with (i)
      8. "CTQ applicable to Part/Assembly (optional)" 
         * "Part/Assembly Number" with (i) - Mandatory field, if "CTQ applicable to Part/Assembly (optional)" is applicable.
      9. "Is CTQ applicable to Blasting and coating (Optional)"  

      10. "Is Inspection Protocol required for CTQ" - Mandatory field.
         * Initially "No" button should be auto selected.
  * Second "Responsible department Wise sections" -
  *   * User should be able to view **" Edit Department"** button at the right end of the session.  

    * Upon Clicking "Edit Department" button,  

      * System should open the overlay window of "Edit Department" with "Close" button.  

      * User should be able to view All department list with multiselect checkboxes option.  

        * User can select and deselect department from the multiselect checkboxes.  

        * Upon clicking "Close" button.  

          * System should close the overlay window of "Edit Department" and show a message,  

            * Message - "{"CTQ Doc. No."}" has been updated successfully.  

            * System should update the "Responsible department" Wise sections.  

              * All field/actions button under the newly added section should be blank.  

            * For unchecked department, system should delete the section.
    * Every department should have his own Section and fields.
    * User should be able to view all below fields under every section of selected department responsible department tab in**  edit mode** with fetched/previously filled or selected option data.  

      * System should fetch and put same data in same type of field for different department.
      1. "Action To Be Taken - Mandatory field.
      2. "Applicable Document" with (i) - Mandatory field.  

         * "JEP Document " - Mandatory field, If User select "JEP Document/ Drawing" in "Applicable Document " dropdown field.
      3. "To be completed before"- Mandatory field.  

      4. "Target Date"- Mandatory field
    * For Implementation/ Supporting document -[#13314](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13314)   

    * Upon clicking **" Save and Close" **and **"****Close "**** ** button, -[#13314](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13314)   

    * System should hide the** "Save and Next"** button for Draft page.

| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13395) |

### Description

As a IEMQS USER other than QI2 user, I want to maintain CTQ identified in project so that I can submit records to QI2 user for approval.

### Acceptance Criteria

**I​**Pre-requisite:****
**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system.
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:**  
  

Continuous of [#13274](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13274) and [#13298](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13298) 
**
  * **1st Flow -** In "CTQ Doc Status by Responsible Dept", User selected "In- Progress" or "Pending" option from the dropdown menu.  [Maintain CTQ_Other Dept (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f064dcff-621d-4970-8456-87153797a413-a537/screen/cf2e1e3b-3d2b-45a4-ba62-2c37e387326e)  

    * System should show "Save and Close" and "Close" button only and Hide "Implement and Close" button.  

  * **2nd Flow -  **In "CTQ Doc Status by Responsible Dept", User selected "Completed" or "Not- Applicable" option from the dropdown menu.  

    * System should show only "Implement and Close", "Save and Close" and Close button only.  
  

  * Upon Clicking**  "Save and Close"** button,  

    * Message should be shown - "CTQ Detail record saved successfully".
    * System should save all the changes made by user.
    * System should change CTQ record status from "APPROVED" to "IN-PROGRESS".  

      * As per above two flow Validation
    * System should change the "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} APPROVED" to "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} IN-PROGRESS".  

    * System should also change the status of respective  "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} APPROVED" to "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} IN-PROGRESS" in selected record "Maintain Critical to Quality" page.
    * System should close and revert to "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} IN-PROGRESS) page.  
  

  * Upon Clicking**  "Implement and Close"** button, 
    * System should validate all the mandatory fields or highlight the mandatory fields. 
    * System should show a pop-up window of "Implementation Confirmation" with "Yes" and "No" buttons. 
    * Message in Pop up window - "Do you want to implement this record", 
      * Upon clicking "Yes" button, 
        * System should change CTQ record status from APPROVED/IN-PROGRESS to "IMPLEMENTED" 
          * As per above two flow Validation
        * System should change the "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} APPROVED" to "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} IN-PROGRESS".
        * System should close and revert to "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} IN-PROGRESS) page.

**Pre-requisite:**

     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page.

**Navigation:  **
  1. As a QI3 user \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click "Maintain Critical to Quality" Page
  2. As a QI3 user\-->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->"{"CTQ Doc. No.**{Status}** "}" page of selected favorite project. 


**Functional:**    

  

For "In-Progress" status "{"CTQ Doc. No. "} project row at "Maintain Critical To Quality" page grid shown as per visuals [Maintain CTQ_QI3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/7549957e-6c13-4b2c-baca-02689c15081e-201a/screen/ccfbb81e-2334-41f3-8f94-003b6ceae995/)
  

  * Upon clicking of any project row (Anywhere in row) of "Maintain Critical To Quality" page grid. 
  * System should open project related page CTQ Number page "{"CTQ Doc. No."} **IN-PROGRESS** " page.
  * User should be able to view the hierarchy of the page via breadcrumbs with back button shown as per visuals.
  * System **should freeze all the header part** of selected/created "{"CTQ Doc. No."}" project Page.  

    * For more than one "Action By Department" And "Identical Projects" field 
      * User should be able to view field as covered in- [#12848](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12848) 
  * User should be able to view Grid with CTQ records shown as per visuals.
    * Columns are "Reference Doc. No", "Clause No.", "CTQ Desc.", "Action to be taken"," Responsible Department", "Target Date", "Status" and Actions buttons.  

    * System should show all records available under the "{"CTQ Doc. No."}.
    * System should fetch Grid data automatically.  

  * In Action column of approved status row, 
    * User should be able to view "**Timeline " and "Delete"** icon. 
      * For "Timeline" functionality -[#13150](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13150) 
  * User should be able to view "Print" button directly and "Export", "Copy" button under three dots..  

    * For "Print" functionality - [#13156](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13156)   

    * For "Export" functionality - [#12917](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/12917)   

    * For "Copy" functionality - [#13176](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13176) 
  * For Pagination and Sorting of Grid -[#13149](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13149)   

  * For "Filter" functionality - [#13149](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13149) 
  * Upon Clicking of anywhere in the record row,
    * User should be able to view "Critical to Quality **IMPLEMENTED " **Page shown as per visuals.
      * User should be able to view three section, 
      1. CTQ DETAILS
      2. System should show "Responsible Department" wise tabs.
         * System should scroll down page directly to the "Responsible Department" sections.
            * User should be able to view his department tab first as shown as per visual.
            * "CTQ implementation" section should be comes under the Responsible department as shown as per visuals
      3. SUPPORTING DOCUMEMNT ({X}) 
         * X - Number of counts of total uploaded documents
    * First** ****" CTQ details"** section - Viewed only mode fields detailed covered in [#13298](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13298) 
    * Second **" Responsible department Wise sections" - Viewed only mode fields detailed covered in [#13298](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13298).**  

      * User are able to view and edit all department section. 
    * Flow - If QI3 is a responsible department, 
      * System should enable the Implementation and Verification fields. 
    * Third -In "**Through document " **and **" At Working Level Team" **for selected section, Under CTQ Implementation session 
      * For **" Yes",**  

        * User should be able to view "Verified by QC" dropdown menu with static option.
          * Static options are - "Completed", "In-Progress", "Pending", "Returned" and "Not Applicable".
          * Mandatory fields 
      * For **" No" -** System should hide "Verified by QC" field  

    * User should be able to view "Verify", "Return" and "Close" button shown as per visuals.
      * Upon clicking "Verify" button,'
        * System should check mandatory field and highlight the mandatory field if its not filled/selected.
        * System should show a pop-up window of "Verify Confirmation".
          * Message in popup window - Do you want to verify this record?(optional) 
          * user should be able to view "Remark" not mandatory field.
            * User should be able to enter in text field (user specific) 
          * Upon clicking "Yes" button
            * System should show message -"CTQ Record Verified Successfully".
            * System should change record status to "Verified" after all responsible department action are verified by QI3 user.
          * Upon clicking "No" button
            * System should close pop-up window of "Verify Confirmation".
      * Upon clicking "Return" button,  

        * System should show a pop-up window of "Return Confirmation".
          * Message in popup window - Do you want to return?". 
          * user should be able to view "Remark" mandatory field.
            * User should be able to enter in text field (user specific) 
          * Upon clicking "Yes" button
            * System should show message -"CTQ Record Returned Successfully".
            * If a single record returned by QI3, System should change record status to "Returned".
          * Upon clicking "No" button
            * System should closer pop-up window of "Return Confirmation".
      * Upon clicking "Close" button,  

        * System should revert back to "{"CTQ Doc. No."} **IN-PROGRESS** " page.


**Usability:  
**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

1. As a IEMQS USER other than QI2 user in Maintain Critical Quality session I want to Approve CTQ identified in project so that I can Approve /close records.
  2. As a QI2 user, in Approve/Close Critical to Quality session, I want to maintain CTQ identified in project so that I can submit records to QI2 user for approval.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:**  

  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. As a IEMQS user other than QI2 \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click "Maintain Critical to Quality" Page--->  [Maintain CTQ_Other Dept (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f064dcff-621d-4970-8456-87153797a413-a537/screen/d60f4b40-1e6a-4e60-9fa5-160d7ff55bfe)
  2. As a QI2 user \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click "Approve/Close Critical to Quality" Page---->[Approve/Close Critical To Quality_QI2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/e21608ee-250f-4df6-9fa2-7e5a8503ed79-b745/screen/ae8f6052-8825-4eaa-9a52-ec80e19c3045)  

  3. As a IEMQS user\-->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--->"{"CTQ Doc. No.**{Status}** "}" page of selected favorite project. 


**  
**
**Functional:**
  * User should be able to view "Revise" button under three dots available beside the "Print" button.  
    * System should show "Revise" button only for "{"CTQ Doc. No."} page has status - "Approved" and "In- Progress".
  * Upon clicking of "Revise" button in "{"CTQ Doc. No."} (Status - Approved/In- Progress) page after approving first time,   

    * System should show a pop-up window of "Revise Confirmation" with "Yes" and "No" button, (Refer Page 30) 
    * Message in popup window- "Do you want to revise the record?". 
    * Upon clicking on "Yes" button, 
      * System should change "{"CTQ Doc. No."} page status back to Draft status. (Page 48)  

      * User should be able to view "Critical to Quality" Detail draft page with Draft page functionalities shown as per visuals [Maintain CTQ_Other Dept (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f064dcff-621d-4970-8456-87153797a413-a537/screen/5b9e6765-c0e0-46a3-a7cb-e41cf516897b/) (refer page 48) 
        * Draft status Page Functionality already covered previously in different user stories. 
          * Draft status Page functionality is different as per QI2 (Approve/Close Critical to Quality page) And all other IEMQS user other than QI2  "Maintain Critical to Quality page.
        * If User added new record through Add detail button, 
          * User should be able to view newly added record in grid as Draft status with respective action button as shown as per visual. (Refer page 48) 
        * In header part Revision number should change to new revision.  

          * System should change revision of "{"CTQ Doc. No."} after a record saved by the user in the "Critical to Quality Detail" draft page. 
        * In Index page system should also update the CTQ revision number to new revision  

          * System should also save the superseded data in history. 
            * [#13241](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13241) \- Just for Information  

      * First flow - All IEMQS user other than QI2 revise the "{"CTQ Doc. No."} to new revision.
        * System should show draft page functionality, So User can submit record to QI2 user for approve.
      * Second flow - QI2 revise the "{"CTQ Doc. No."} to new revision / QI2 got new record approval request - (continuous of First flow).
        * System should show Draft page functionality, so QI2 user can Approve the record.
        * If User delete the record before approving,
          * System should not delete the record and change status of the record from "Draft" to "Deleted".
          * System should show all deleted status record at the end of the grid.
            * Upon clicking of respective "Deleted" Status record, - functionality Covered in [#14982](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/14982) 
    * Upon clicking on "No" button,  

      * System should close pop-up window of "Revise Confirmation".


**Usability:  
**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a WE3 user, I want to see Quality ID at the time of Test plan preparation.

### Acceptance Criteria

Pre-requisite: 
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. WE3 User -->Select favorite project-->Click "Quick Links"\--> Click "Maintain Quality ID/Test Plan/ Shop Weld Plan" page. 
  2. WE3 User -->Mega Menu---> Click "Maintain Quality ID/Test Plan/ Shop Weld Plan" page.   

  3. WE3 User -->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--> Open Maintain **Quality ID** /Test Plan/ Shop Weld Plan" page (respective quality project should be selected selected)


****Note: The existing code should run as it is. There is no change in  business logic, validation and integration to other modules.****
****  
****
Flow - When user comes in identical project  "Maintain Quality ID/Test Plan/ Shop Weld Plan" page.
  * System should show all the Quality IDs added by the user in the "Quality project" (main Project for whom this was defined as an identical project) should be also shown in the "Quality ID" session. 
  * User still allowed to use Add QID and Get QID functionalities and there is no linkage to the main QID project. 
  * If user select one QID from "Quality ID" window and one or more seam no. through check box from "Test plan" window, then only "Link" button is enabled for the user. 
    * Upon clicking "Link" button user should be able attached all selected seams to selected QID as per visuals.
    * If any seam no. is already attached to any other QID, then QID is overwrite on the same seam. 
    * If "QID" is not selected from "Quality ID" window, only seam no. is selected on "Test Plan" window then "Link" button is disabled to the users. 
    * Not applicable for Approved and sent for approval status seams in test plan 


****
Usability:
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-13419 — Notification in CTQ

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13419 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13419) |

### Description

As a IEMQS user want view project wise update though Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification and directly redirected to particular "{"CTQ Doc. No.**{Status}** "}" page of selected favorite project notification.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite:_**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**_Functional:_**  
  

**Notes - QI3 user will be decided at the time of CTQ created or the person (QI3) who added the records in particular  "{"CTQ Doc. No"} another than department and QI2 user.**
**  
**
System will send notification to the required user and User should be able to view project wise notification on the landing page 
  

  1. System should send notification to All the selected "Action by Department", QI3 user and QI2 user. 
     * Whenever a new CTQ Created by clicking on "Create CTQ" button.
     * "Add New" button ----> "Create CTQ" button.
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been created".  
  

  2. System should send notification to QI2 user when any other IEMQS user submit record. 
     * Whenever a CTQ record submitted, clicking on "Submit button".
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{DRAFT}** "}" page \---->"Submit" button.
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been submitted by "Name of Action by Department submitted the record".
     * In Case of NO CTQ,
       * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-NO CTQ has been submitted by "Name of Action by Department didn't submit the record".  
  

  3. System should send notification to All IEMQS user selected in "Responsible Department after approval of CTQ Doc. No. 
     * Whenever a CTQ record Approved, clicking on "Approve" button.
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{DRAFT}** "}" page. ------>"Approve button".
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Approved".  
  

  4. System should send notification to QI3 user when any other IEMQS user Implements the record. 
     * Whenever a CTQ record Implemented, clicking on "Implement button.
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{IN-PROGRESS}** "}" page ----->Critical to Quality (APPROVED/IN-PROGRESS page) \----->"Implement" button.
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Implemented by "Name of Responsible Department who has implemented the record".  
  

  5. System should send notification to "Responsible Department" only which record is returned back by the QI3 user. 
     * Whenever a CTQ record Returned, clicking on "Return button".
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{IN-PROGRESS}** "}" page\----->Critical to Quality (IMPLEMENTED) page ----->"Return button".
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Returned".  
  

  6. System should send notification to QI2 user when QI3 user Verified a record.  

     * Whenever a CTQ record verified, clicking on "Verify" button.
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{IN-PROGRESS}** "}" page\----->Critical to Quality (Approved/In- progress page) \--\---->"Verify" button.
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Verified".  
  

  7. System should send notification to Responsible department and QI3 user who verified the record, when any CTQ record closed by the QI2 user, 
     * Whenever a CTQ record "Closed', clicking on "Closed" button.
     * "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{VERIFIED}** "}" page\----->Critical to Quality (Approved/In- progress page) ----->"Closed".
     * Notification message format -"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Closed".  
  

  8. Upon clicking of Notification link,
     * System should redirect user to the selected project notification "{"CTQ Doc. No. **{Status}** "}" page. 
     * Status could be (DRAFT/APPROVED/IN-PROGRESS/CLOSED page)


**Notes - Message should be****different****  as per above given format everything else will remain as per design standard.**
**Example -**
**"{"CTQ Doc. No"}-CTQ has been Closed.**
**Created by - PS No -Name**
**Date / Time (AM/PM)**
**  
**
  

**Usability:**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

  2. Clicking on it will open a new screen as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/7e504dca-a839-46bf-ab09-ffdd9419ac84)

### Description

As a NDE-2/3, I want to upload the documents of the user, so that it can be stored for future references

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have added relevant basic details of the user 
Functional: 
  1. User should be able to see a grid for document upload as per visual [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/7e504dca-a839-46bf-ab09-ffdd9419ac84)
  2. The status will be by default "Pending" and will change to "Uploaded" once a document is uploaded 
  3. Below fields will be shown by default: 
     1. Passport Size Photograph- User should be able to upload the passport size photograph by clicking on the upload icon (Max size, 25 MB, allowed formats: PNG, JPEG). 
     2. Govt Id Proof (Adhaar card/PAN Card): User should be able to update the govt id proof (Maximum size-50 MB, PDF format
     3. CV: User should be able to upload the CV (Maximum size: 50 MB, allowed format-PDF format
  4. The below fields should appear as per the dropdown selection done by user while entering the basic details 
     1. 10th standard certificate: User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 50MB, allowed format-PDF format
     2. 12th standard certificate: User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 50MB, allowed format-PDF format
     3. Graduation certificate: User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 50MB, allowed format-PDF format
     4. Post Grad Certificate:User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 50MB, allowed format-PDF format
     5. Diploma Certificate:User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 50MB, allowed format-PDF format
     6. Technical Qualification Certificate: User should be able to upload the certificate (Max Size: 200MB, allowed format-PDF format
  5. For all the upload documents, below should be followed: 
     1. User can either drag and drop or select from system the document to upload as per visual. As soon as user uploads the file, the uploaded by and uploaded on should get updated as per logged in user PS no and name. The upload status will be Pending by default, and after the document is uploaded, it should change to Uploaded  

     2. If a user wants to reupload the document, then he can do so, by clicking again the upload button, and then user and either delete the document or reupload or can simply upload the new document, which should replace the existing document
     3. User should be able to download the document by clicking on the download icon
     4. User should be able to use the sorting functionality on columns as per visual


Note: 
  1. All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual
  2. Once the main certificate is generated, then user will not be allowed to modify the basic details

Please note: For instance, if a user is tagged to three different NDE methods viz RT, PT and MT, and user deletes all the line items one by one, then once the user deletes the last line items for that user, then it should delete all the data of that user and it will be a hard delete.   7. There will be one more filter which will be in the form of Toggle Button. It will be named as "View Scheduled Tests"

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to schedule vision test, so that I can notify the user for the same

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have filled the basic details of the user along with uploading the documents and should have saved it 
Functional: 
  1. Once the status changes to In-Progress, and in pending action to "Schedule Vision Test", user should be able to schedule the vision test by clicking on the scheduling icon from the index screen 
  2. Clicking on the scheduling icon should open an overlay from right side as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  3. Alternatively, user can also click on the Pending Action columns "Schedule Vision Test", 
  4. Clicking on it should open a right side overlay as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  5. The "Name" and "Schedule for" should be auto populated for the selected line item and should be non-editable as per visual 
  6. User should be able to enter details as below: 
     1. Test Date: Calendar Picker 
     2. Test Location: Dropdown selection, values: AMNHEC , SFU, PEW, VHEW 
     3. Time (Optional): User input (Maximum 5 characters, colon symbol allowed) 
     4. Examiner: User Input (system should suggest name as per user input) 
  7. Once the user fills all the mandatory input values, then the save button should get activated 
     1. Once a user clicks on Save button, then on the Index page, for the selected line item, the status will change from "In-progress" to "In-progress (Scheduled Vision Test)", and in the Pending Action it should change from "Schedule Vision Test" to "-" [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/) The popup should come as per visual 
  8. On the scheduled date of the test, in the Pending action column, the value will come as "Upload/Create VE Certificate"


Note: 
  1. In case of any reason the vision test for the user is postponed or preponed, then the user can change the date and time accordingly, by clicking on the schedule vision test icon from the index screen
  2. All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual

## US-13594 — New User - Email for Vision Test Schedule

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13594 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gopi.Alli |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13594) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to let the end user know about the test date of the vision test, so that the user is aware of the same and comes in a timely manner for attending it

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have scheduled vision test for the required user 
Functional: 
  1. Once a vision test is scheduled for a user, system should send an email notifying about the vision tests, date and time (optional) to the user 
  2. System should pick the email address of the user from the basic details and should keep the examiner in CC 
  3. Frequency of the email: 
     1. Before 10 days of scheduled date 
     2. Before 3 days of scheduled date 
     3. On the scheduled date 
     4. Please Note that: In case, the test is scheduled on the current day while scheduling, then while saving it, an email should get triggered.  

  4. The user who has scheduled the exam should be in CC 


Format:
Subject: Vision Test Schedule 
  

Dear {User’s Name},
 
Your vision test is scheduled on {Date} at {Time}. Requesting your timely presence for the same.
 
Best Regards,
  

 
This is a system generated email. Please refrain from replying on the same
  

**_Important Note:_**
If a user's vision test is rescheduled, then the updated email in the above-mentioned frequency should be sent to the user.

## US-13600 — New User - Uploading Training Details/Certificate

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13600 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13600) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to upload the training details of the user in the system, so that the record should be save for future references

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
Training should have been scheduled for the user 
  

Functional: 
  1. After 15 days from the date of the training scheduled start date, in the index page for that line item, the status should change from "In-progress (Scheduled Training)" to "In-progress"
  2. In the Pending action column, it will change from "-" to "Upload Training Certificate"
  3. User should be able to navigate to the Training tab for the specific user via preview button 
  4. For uploading training details, below needs to be followed 
  5. The below details should be auto-populated and should be in non-editable mode: 
     1. Name 
     2. Gender 
     3. Age
     4. Department
     5. Method
     6. Examination Location
     7. Revision No (By default R0 in non editable mode)
  6. User should be able to download the certificate template by clicking on "Download Certificate template". The sample format is attached with this story in ADO, please note that the sample format is different for different locations. _(Please note that no mapping needs to be done for the fields, the user will download the word file, and is supposed to manually enter the data)_
  7. User needs to mandatorily upload the below certificates:
     1. Training Certificate
     2. Mockup Certificate 
  8. For uploading the above two certificates, user needs to click on the pin icon, which will open as popup [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/0dbf6372-855e-451c-baad-15e607ffe2bb)
  9. User needs to enter Total Training Hours (User Input, maximum 4 digit, numeric), Training start date (calendar picker, should come be default in editable mode), and user needs to enter Training end date (calendar picker). 
  10. Post this user needs to upload the document (Max Size 100 MB, Allowed format-PDF 
  11. After clicking on save, it should appear in the grid, wherein the user can also reupload if required, download it, as well as view it by clicking on the pdf icon 
  12. The below two certificates will be optional 
     1. Equipment Training certificate 
     2. Additional Training 
  13. These two optional certificates will also be uploaded in the same manner as the mandatory certificates are uploaded 
  14. Once the two mandatory certificates are uploaded by the user, then the status for the line item in the index page will remain "In-progress" and in the pending action column, it will change from "Upload Training Certificate" to "Schedule NDE Test"
  15. Please note that when the certificates are uploaded, then in the grid, the uploaded by and uploaded on also needs to be updated by the system 


Note: 
  1. All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual
  2. If a user has multiple discipline selected, then the same should get reflected to other line items as well.

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to upload NDE test result details for the users, so that their tests results can be stored in the system for future references

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have NDE test scheduled for them 
Functional: 
  1. The basic details in read only format needs to be shown as per visual 
  2. The user can start the test by clicking on the Start Online test from the NDE Method Examination tab 
  3. Here the basic details will be shown prepopulated as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/1f16bc61-59f2-4f97-9280-3b257665fd2c)
  4. It should redirect the user to the legacy portal test page  
For reference: [NQC-Exam Detail :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/NQC/MaintainNQC/MaintainExamination), Login User: Ajit Anupam 
  5. Once a user completed the test and downloads the test result, then in the NDE Method Examination tab, user can upload the results as below: 
     1. User can click on the relevant pin icon for General, specific or practical and upload the certificate 
     2. User will be required to fill below details: 
        1. Test Result (Dropdown, Values: Pass, fail) 
        2. Marks Obtained: User Input, maximum 3 digit, numeric 
        3. Total Marks: User Input, maximum 3 digit, numeric
        4. ~~Certification Date: By default, the scheduled test date should auto populate, but user can also edit it~~
     3. On clicking on save button, the relevant certificate will get displayed in the grid against the line item

  7. User can download the document, by clicking on the download button 
  8. User can use the column sorting functionality 
  9. Pagination to be accessible as per visual 
  10. User can also download the test template is required by clicking on the "Download Test Template" (Please refer attachment for format)


Note: 
All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual  

  1. Now, the status in the main index grid status will remain as "In-progress" and in the pending action, it will change from "Upload NDE Test Certificate" to "Generate Certificate"
  2. All the three certificates viz General, Specific and Practical are mandatory to be uploaded for changing the status of the line items on the index screen and thus moving to the next step

    * User should be able to view "Shop Weld Repair Plan" Page for shown as per visuals.

      * System should show "**Location** " field in view only mode.

          * Base Metal repair
          * Base Metal Built up

        * **Mandatory  ****field** ** to select.**

        * **Mandatory  ****field** ** to select.**
        *  Dropdown options are static- "Groove/Fillet", "Overlay", "T#TS" and "Hardfacing"
          *  "other" option is not required, please ignore this in prototype.
      * User should be able to view "**Generate** " button,  

        * Upon clicking "Generate" button,  

          * System should save/add new row in the Index page as per filled information.
            * System should show row Status as "Draft".  

            * System should show a message - "Saved as Draft".  

            * System should remain in the same page.  

            * System should also show status in the page name as "DRAFT" -  

          * System should enable the generate button only if all mandatory fields are filled else disable it.
        * System should show selected joint type data with different session shown as per visuals.  

        * In "SWRP Details" session, 
          * System should show "Project", "Location" and "Types of Joint" fields in view only mode.
          * In "Select Categories",   

            * **1st flow -** If User select "Minor"/"Major",
              * User are allowed to change between Minor and Major but not able to choose NCR after clicking on generate.
                * System should disable "NCR" option and enable only "Major and "Minor" options.
            * **2nd flow -  **If User select "NCR",
              * System should disable "Select categories" option it will show in view only mode.  

          * User should be able to edit "Description", "Customer", "ASME Stamp" and R Stamp fields.
    * User should be able to view Collapse button to maximize and minimize the header part shown as per visuals.  

      * Initially, user should be able to view maximized view.
      * Upon clicking, user should be able to Maximize and Minimize as per his requirement.
  * All dropdowns have******predictive search**  functionality.

  2. User should be able to view "**Delete " **button under three dots in action column for "Draft" and "Returned" status SWRP No.

## US-13634 — New User - Entering Certification Details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13634 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/13634) |

### Description

As an NDE-2/3, I want to enter all the certification detail, so that I can save it and use for certification generation.

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have completed the training and passed the NDE Exam 
Functional: 
  1. User can click on the preview button of the line item in the main index, and can go to the certification tab. Visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/4ea2cc00-d6e0-431c-af1a-eccc3cdf8bf7)
  2. The below fields should be auto-populated and should be non-editable: 
     1. Name 
     2. Gender 
     3. Age 
     4. Department 
     5. Examination Location 
     6. Revision 
  3. The below details should be editable: 
     1. Method 
  4. User can click on the Create certificate button, to enter details. Clicking on it will open a right side overlay as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/4ea2cc00-d6e0-431c-af1a-eccc3cdf8bf7)
  5. The below fields should come auto populated and in non editable format: 
     1. Marks obtained and Total Marks for General, Specific and Practical respectively 
  6. The below fields are required to be filled by the user: 
     1. Experience Before L&T: User input, numeric, maximum 2 digit 
     2. Experience in L&T: Radio button 
        1. If user Clicks No, then it will get capture without any further requirement to enter information for this line items 
        2. If user Clicks Yes, Then "Number of  Months" text box will appear, where user will be required to enter total past experience in L&T in months 
  7. Next, user will be required to enter below mandatory fields: 
     1. Test Result: Dropdown, Values: Pass/Failed 
     2. Date of Certification: Calendar pick 
     3. Radio button with two values to select for certification validity, values: 3 year, 5 years 
     4. Re-Certification Date: It should automatically be populated by calculating from Date of certification till 3 years or 5 years as selected subtracted by 1 day. But user can also edit it 
     5. Date of Assignment of Work: Calendar pick (By Default, the date of certification should come, but it should be editable) 
     6. TPE-1 Required Date: It should come as from the date of certification till one year subtract 1 day. But user can also edit it 
     7. Clause No: User Input, maximum length 50, alphanumeric 
     8. Written Practice: User Input, maximum length 50 characters, alphanumeric 
     9. NDE III certificate No: User input, maximum length 50 characters, alphanumeric 
  8. Also, for generating certificate, below fields needs to be captured by system: 
     1. Certificate No: Nomenclature: Location Acronym/NDE/ToFD/Year in YYYY format/1 . Eg, If location in AMNHEC , year is 2023 and its the first certificate then the No will be: AMNHEC /NDE/ToFD/2023/1
     2. For the examination details, the marks obtained needs to be appended. The system should calculate the percentage accordingly and append. The passing percentage will be static as per attachment.
     3. Composite grade will be the average of the percentage obtained.


Note: 
All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual

## US-13636 — Continuity Report

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-13636 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Ramadass P |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to submit the continuity report, so that the records as per standards can be maintained for audit purpose

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. User should be able to navigate to Continuity report from the main index screen, by clicking on the preview button 
  2. The basic details of the user should be shown to the user as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/53219dce-cf90-40b5-858d-ed117adebc8b)
  3. User should be able to upload the continuity report, by clicking on the Upload certificate button. Here the user will be asked whether the user is continued of discontinued as per visual 
  4. After the certificate is uploaded, a grid as per visual should be shown to the user 
  5. User can view the PDF by clicking on the PDF icon 
  6. User can download the PDF by clicking on the download icon 


Logic: 
  1. After six months minus one day from the date of certification or after six months minus one day from the date of last continuity report submitted, in the status column it should change from "Active (Certificate Generated)" to "Active" and in the pending it should come as "Upload Continuity Report"
  2. If a user has exceeded the date, then in the status column it should change from "Active" to "Active (Overdue)" and in the pending Action "Upload Continuity Report"


  

Note: 
All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual

## US-14171 — New User - Certificate Generation

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-14171 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Ramadass P |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/14171) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to generate certificate for the user, so that I can keep it in system for reference

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have passed NDE test and also entered relevant details for certification generation 
Functional: 
  1. Once the user enters all the relevant details for certificate generation, then on the click of "Create" button, a certificate should get generated and should be displayed in the grid as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/de78d5ff-a35e-47ee-8ada-c668b14ff9fa)
     1. This certificate will be of two pages
     2. In the first page, above NDE-III Name, system should capture below things:
        1. Name of the logged in NDE user
        2. Below name, the certificate no as mentioned by user should be captured
     3. In the next page the TPE and VE data will be shown
     4. The format of certificate is attached in the attachment section. Please note that the format of the certificate is different as per location. So, system should check the location selected for the user and should generate the certificate accordingly 
     5. In the attached sample certificate in ADO, the highlighted items will be variables, and system should append relevant details as per user input 
  2. In the grid, user can view the certificate by clicking on the pdf icon 
  3. User should be able to download the certification by clicking on the download button 
  4. User should be able to reupload the certificate by clicking on the pin icon 
  5. There will be one more grid will be generated for capturing the Certificate status and under it TPE and VE dates will be captured 
  6. Logic for displaying the TPE and VE dates: 
     1. From the certification generation, we will get the TPE-1 due date. So for TPE-2 due date will be TPE-1 due date plus one year minus one day. And the TPE date will be the date of TPE exam taken 
     2. Similarly, when TPE2 date will come, then accordingly this logic will be followed for subsequent TPE 
     3. For VE-1, the date will come from one year of the VE taken minus one day, similarly for subsequent for other VE as well it will come when the previous date is captured in the system 
     4. Please not that for TPE and VE, if the certificate expiry is 3 years, then TPE-1 and TPE-2 will come and also, VE-1 and VE-2 will come. If the certificate expiry is 5 years then TPE-1, TPE-2, TPE-3, TPE-4 will come and VE-1, VE-2, VE-3, VE-4 will come 
  7. Once a certificate is generated, then in the index page for the selected line item, the status will change from "In-progress" to "Active" and the pending action will change from "Generate Certificate" to "Certificate Generated"
     1. In the index page, the due date for re-certification should be appended for the selected line item under the column name "Valid up to"


Note: 
All the popup and toast messages should be followed as per visual

## US-14175 — Continuity Report Renewal Email and Status

| Field | Value |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to notify the user for upload of Continuity report, so that the report can by uploaded in the system in a timely manner

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should be active user 
Functional: 
  1. An active user has to submit continuity report in every six months from the date of previously submitted report. Or in case of new user, then six moths minus one from the date of becoming Active user 
  2. An email notification needs to be sent to the user as well as to the NDE person who has onboarded the user 
  3. Format of email: 
     1. Subject: Submit Continuity Report 
     2. Dear <Username>,  
Your continuity report is due by <Date>. Please submit your report before the due date.  
This is a system generated email. Please refrain from replying 
  4. Frequency of Email: 
     1. Before 10 days of scheduled date  

     2. Before 3 days of scheduled date 
     3. On the scheduled date 
  5. Before 10 days of the continuity renewal report to be submitted, in the index page, the status will be "Active" and in the Pending Action column, it will be "Upload Continuity Report"
  6. If the continuity report is not uploaded within the scheduled date and one day has passed, then from the next day of the scheduled date, the status will be "Active(Overdue)" and in the pending action, it will be "Upload Continuity Report"

Perquisite: 
User should be Active

  4. On the day of scheduled exam, the status will be "Active" and in the pending action "Upload/Create VE certificate"

  1. Before 10 days of the certification expiry, the status of the user should become "Active (Recertification)" and in the pending action "Schedule Vision Test"
  2. User should schedule the vision test as per previous logic 
  3. Once the test is scheduled, the status will become "Active (Recertification-Scheduled Vision Test)" and in the pending action "-"
  4. On the date of scheduled test, the status will become "Active (Recertification)" and in the pending action "Upload/Create VE certificate"
  5. Now, for conducting and uploading the vision test, user can either click on the pending action or can navigate to the vision tab via preview button: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/48e5c45e-910f-49d0-a2ce-d9f713b9b562)
  6. In this screen all the details will be prepopulated and non-editable except the Revision No, which in this case should be R1 by default in the dropdown values (if the user is getting recertified first time) 
  7. The user can also view the R0 details by clicking on the R0 from dropdown. But, user will not be able to create or upload certificate. He can only view and download it. (Same case for all the previous revisions if exists) 
  8. In the R1, there should not be any gird, and user will be required to follow the same process of uploading the certificate as done previously. 
  9. Once the certificate of vision test is uploaded and saved, then in the index page against the selected line item, the status will remain "Active (Recertification)" and pending action will change from "Upload/Create VE certificate" to "Schedule NDE Test"


Note: 
  1. The confirmation popups, toast messages should be followed as per visual 
  2. If a user is enrolled to multiple NDE methods, then once the vision test is conducted for one method, then the same should get reflected to other methods as well

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to conduct and upload the NDE test result of the candidate as a part of recertification, so that the candidate can continue to be eligible for working with the organization

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should be active and should have passed the vision test for recertification 
Functional: 
  1. Once the user has scheduled NDE test as per previous onboarding process logic, then the status will remain "Active (Recertification)" and the pending action will change from "Schedule NDE Test" to "Upload NDE Test Certificate"
  2. User can take the test of the candidate and upload the NDE test certificate by either clicking from the pending action or by navigating through preview button [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/screen/1f16bc61-59f2-4f97-9280-3b257665fd2c)
  3. Once the user comes to the NDE Method Examination screen, then the user will be able to see all the basic details auto-populated and in non editable mode, except the Revision No dropdown which will now by default be R1 in editable mode (In case the user is recertifying for the first time) 
  4. User can click on the dropdown and select the previous Revision no, but in this case, user will not be able to upload any certificates. User will only be able to view or download the certificate 
  5. Now, in the R1 revision, the flow will happen in the same manner as it happened during the onboarding NDE test for the user 
  6. Once the certificate is uploaded then the status will become "Active Recertification" and the pending action will change from "Upload NDE Test Certificate" to "Generate Certificate"


Note: 
All the popups and toast messages to be shown as per visual

## US-14274 — Downloading Report

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-14274 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Lahu.Kumbhar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/14274) |

### Description

As an NDE-2/3 user, I want to download standard report of the NDE qualified personnel, so that I can use it for future references

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. In the index page, beside export button, there will be three dots which needs to be shown to the user as per visual [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  2. Clicking on the three dots will open a dropdown type options 
  3. The first value will be Download Report 
  4. On click of the Download report, a right side overlay should appear as per visual [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  5. User will be required to fill below details: 
     1. Location Dropdown: Values: AMNHEC, SFU, PEW, VHEW 
     2. Department: QC-P, NDE, PRODUCTION, WE, QA, QC-N 
     3. Discipline/Method: PT,MT,RT,UT,TOFD,PAUT,VT,ECT,LT,
     4. Due Date within (Optional): 1 Month, 2 Month, 3 Month. 
  6. Once the user fills all the mandatory details, then the "Download" button should get activated. In case user wants to abort the process, the user can click on cancel button, which should close the overlay and take the user to the index page 
  7. On the click on Download button, system should generate an excel with the user selected filters. The name of excel should be "NDT Personnel Report" and should contain below columns:  
Please note that the scheduled due dates which are approaching to near dates in next 2 weeks, those line items should be shown in yellow color. The line items whose scheduled dates are exceeded the due dates should be shown in Red Color  
Sr.No   
---  
Name   
Level I/II/III   
Method   
Valid From   
Valid upto (dd/mm/yyyy)   
  
  

  8. Logic for excel Data: 
     1. If a user has selected due date from the dropdown values, then system should check whether any of the vision, NDE, recertification or TPE test is pending, and should accordingly print all the details. The data of all active users will only be captured
     2. If a user has not selected Due date, then system should print all the line items if they have any pending items (Vision/NDE/TPE/recertification) . All the Active personnels data needs to be shown. The data of all active users will only be captured
     3. Please note that here, By Active user means, if a user status is "Active", irrespective of what is there in the status after "Active", we will consider it as active. Also, status as in-progress should also be considered as Active. If a user status is "Inactive", irrespective what is written in the status after Inactive, we will consider that user as Inactive, and that users data should not be considered
