If a user status is "Inactive", irrespective what is written in the status after Inactive, we will consider that user as Inactive, and that users data should not be considered

## US-14277 — Manage Reports

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-14277 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Lahu.Kumbhar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/14277) |

### Description

As a NDE-2/3 user, I want to get reports via email as per set frequency, so that I can quickly act on pending actions

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. In the index page, beside export button, there will be three dots which needs to be shown to the user as per visual [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  2. Clicking on the three dots will open a dropdown type options 
  3. The third value will be Manage Email Reports 
  4. Clicking on Manage Email Reports will open as right side overlay as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)
  5. User will be required to enter below details: 
     1. Email: User input, maximum 320 characters, should mandatorily contain "@"
     2. Report Emailing Frequency: Dropdown: Values- Don't send email reports, 1 Month, 2 Month, 3 Month
     3. Location: AMNHEC, SFU, PEW, VHEW
     4. Department: QC-P, NDE, PRODUCTION, WE, QA, QC-N
     5. Discipline/Method: PT,MT,RT,UT,TOFD,PAUT,VT,ECT,LT,  

     6. Due Date Within(Optional): Dropdown: Values- 1 Month, 2 Month, 3 Month
  6. Logic for activating Save button: 
     1. If a user has entered Email and from "Report Emailing Frequency" selected dropdown value as "Don't send email reports", then the below fields (Location, Department, Discipline/Method, Due Date Within) will disable and the Save button should get activated. Now, clicking on Save, system should capture in DB and should not send email reports to the users mentioned email id 
     2. If a user has entered all the values (Email, Report Emailing Frequency, Location, Department, Discipline/Method, Due Date Within), then the Save button should get activated and the user should be getting email as per set frequency and filter on the mentioned email id 
  7. Format of Email:  
Subject: NDE Qualification Certification - Users Report  
Dear <Users name>,  
PFA report as per set parameters.  

  8. Format of Excel: Attached in ADO Attachment  
Please note that the scheduled due dates which are approaching to near dates in next 2 weeks, those line items should be shown in yellow color. The line items whose scheduled dates are exceeded the due dates should be shown in Red Color  
Download Detailed Report   
---  
Sr.No   
 Name   
Level I/II/III   
Method   
Valid From   
Valid upto (dd/mm/yyyy)   
TPE Due Date   
Vision Due Date   
  

  9. Logic for excel Data: 
     1. If a user has selected due date from the dropdown values, then system should check whether any of the vision, NDE, recertification or TPE test is pending, and should accordingly print all the details. The data of all active users will only be captured
     2. If a user has not selected Due date, then system should print all the line items if they have any pending items (Vision/NDE/TPE/recertification) . All the Active personnels data needs to be shown. The data of all active users will only be captured

Perquisite: 
User should have cleared Vision Test

  1. Once a user clears Vision Test for the first time, then in the index page, under the action buttons one more button for adding new certificate should be visible as per visual: [Flow 3 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/3ff0540c-009b-4a17-bf7f-00aadeaf0191-6aa3/)

### Description

As a FMG-3, PROD3, SHOP, ENGG3, PMG3, QI3, FSP, FS3, PLNG3, AUX3, CR3, WTC3, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC3, MET3, WE3, PUR3, STR3, QA-3, QC-3, NDE-3, MFG3 user, I want to use action buttons for editing, cancel and retracting, so that accurate data can be sent for approval

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. Edit: This button will only be visible and accessible when the status of a line item is Draft/Returned
     1. If a user wants to modify an existing line item, then the user can do so by clicking on the pencil button  

     2. If a user wants to modify a line item with status as "Returned" then after modifying and saving, the status will change to "Draft"
  2. Cancel: 
     1. If a user has started editing a line item and wants to abort it, then user can click on the "x" icon 
     2. User can use the Cancel button present at the bottom of the grid as well, clicking on it will show the popup as per visual: [DPP (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/03a3054d-9a46-4e08-8b42-8f7a1d9f601c-56f0/screen/973dfe17-3f17-4c03-871c-0970498e3c8d)
  3. Retract: 
     1. If the status of a line item is "Sent for Approval", then Retract button should be visible to use, until the status becomes "Approved"
     2. Clicking on Retract will show a confirmation popup, confirming the same will make the current line-item status to "Draft" and will remove the line item from L-2 tray 


Note: 
  1. Please note that all the action button operations can only be applied for current or previous month. It is not allowed for future months. Also, the edit button can only be shown to the user when the status of the line item is Draft/Returned. The timeline button will get enabled once the status of a line items changes to draft. The report button will be visible once the status of a line items becomes draft. 
  2. The logic for performance and the entering of Root Cause/Corrective action should remain intact

|-------|-------|
| ID | US-14584 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Anudeep.Sett |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-UX |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/14584) |

### Description

As a FMG-3, PROD3, SHOP, ENGG3, PMG3, QI3, FSP, FS3, PLNG3, AUX3, CR3, WTC3, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC3, MET3, WE3, PUR3, STR3, QA-3, QC-3, NDE-3, MFG3 user, I want to generate reports, so that I can study it before sending for approval

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. There are two ways in which a user can access reports: 
     1. Type-1: User can select a line items report symbol which will open the report as per visual: [DPP (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/03a3054d-9a46-4e08-8b42-8f7a1d9f601c-56f0/screen/dd6718f6-077a-454d-9357-3ffb36638ffc)
     2. Type-2: User can select checkbox against the line items and click on the "View Report" present on top of the grid which will open the reports 
  2. Please note that these checkboxes will only be visible against a line item when below conditions are met: 
     1. Status of the line item is Draft/Sent for approval/Approved/Returned 
     2. The month should be current or previous months 
  3. Report Format: 
     1. In case of monthly report frequency is selected from Master, then the report needs to be shown for one year from the month of the selected line item. Eg, if the line item of July-2023 month is selected then the report will be from August-2022 till July-2023. Please refer attached excel named "DPP-Data Input and Report", refer tab named "Reports" for report format for all report formats of different frequencies 
     2. If more than one reports are selected for viewing then separate reports for each line items in separate tabs as per visual needs to be shown: [DPP (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/03a3054d-9a46-4e08-8b42-8f7a1d9f601c-56f0/screen/4537cba9-ff95-4d4e-9555-2ed0414856df)
     3. ​The format for showing the reports should be followed as per attachment in ADO (Please refer sheet named "D1-Report", it contains logic to be appended in the report)  

     4. In case for any of the month, there is no data, then it should be shown in the graph as per visual: [DPP (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/03a3054d-9a46-4e08-8b42-8f7a1d9f601c-56f0/screen/4537cba9-ff95-4d4e-9555-2ed0414856df)
     5. In the format number, the value R0 should be taken from master. Eg, if in Master, the revision number is R1, then accordingly it should be displayed in the report 
     6. Also, the values and logic for graph should be followed as per shown in the attachment in excel 
     7. In the report viewer screen, there are two dropdown that will be visible, "From month" and "To month". In the From Month, the selected tabs months will be shown, if user selects any months in the from month and to month, then appropriate tabs should be visible to the user as per above mentioned format  



Note: 
The report should also show a trend line a per the set threshold value in the graph

### Description

As WE3/WE2 User, I want to maintain Shop Weld Repair Plan for the****  Overlay or Hardfacing Type** **so that i can maintain data with different functionalities.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:**  

  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. WE3/WE2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick Links\---> Click "Maintain SWRP " Page----->selected project and Type of Joint "Shop Weld Plan Repair" Page


**Functional:**    

  * System should show load below page data as per selected "Type of Joint" field and "Category" field.  



**2nd flow - Selected "Type of Joint" is - Overlay or Hardfacing Type**  

  * User should be able to be view following session with anchor links tab in the top of the "Overlay" report type page shown as per visuals.  [Flow 18 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/2d744139-38b5-464f-bc44-a4423c2daadc-7827/)
    1. PROJECT DETAIL
    2. SEAM DETAIL 
    3. DEFECT DETAIL 
    4. WELDING PARAMETERS 
    5. RECTIFICATION STEPS 
    6. ATTACHMENT 
  * Upon selecting on Anchor links, 
    * Systems should scroll down the page directly to selected session. 
  * User should be able to view toggle button for "SEAM DETAIL", "DEFECT DETAIL", "WELDING PARAMETERS", "RECTIFICATION STEPS", "ATTACHMENT" Session to toggle between "Applicable" and "Not Applicable",
    * Upon toggle to "Not Applicable"
      * System should disable the respective Session shown as per visuals. 
    * Upon Clicking "Applicable" (Initially toggle to "Applicable")
      * System should enable the respective Session shown as per visuals.


********1. "PROJECT DETAIL" session, **********  
******
  * User should be able to view **" SL. No" **and **"****Rev. No. "** field in view only mode,   

    * Functionality covered in [#13618](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13618) 
  * User should be able to view "Seam Type", "Drawing No.", "Job Description", and "Welder Stamp" fields.  

  * User should be able to enter and select **" Drawing No."** from multiselect Dropdown field shown as per visuals.  

    * In dropdown menu, System should also show a static option "NA",
      * "NA" option is single select selection option. 
  * User should be able to enter and select "**Seam Type** " from Multi-select static dropdown menu. 
    * Options are -"NA", "Long", "CIRC", "NOZ", "BM" and "OTHER".
  * Systems should fetch **" Job Description"** field automatically as per the selected "Project".  

    * User should be able to enter and edit "Job Description" fields (User specific).
  * User should be able to enter and select "**Welder Stamp** " from single select static dropdown menu.  

    * Options are -"NA", "HYX", "HRF" and "HQZ".
  * All fields are **Mandatory,**** ** and all dropdowns have** ****predictive search  ****functionality****.  **  



**2. "SEAM DETAIL" session,** 
> >   * Seam functionality already covered in [#13619](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13619) 
    * with some minor changes in column names are functionality. -  "Excavated. Depth (mm)" only this field is different 
  * **1st flow** - If selected Categories are "Major" and "Minor"
    * User should be able to view "Seam Detail "Grid with blank row shown as per visuals,
    * User should be able to view "Seam No.", "Type of Defect/Abnormality", "Length(mm)", "Excavated. Depth (mm)", "Spot No.", "Repair No.", "Date" and Action button column shown as per visuals.
    * User should be able to enter and select "Seam No." from single select Dropdown field shown as per visuals.
      * Initially, System should show Seam No dropdown filed editable. -  

      * Upon selecting of "Seam No" system will fetch "Stage" data,
        * User can edit "Stage" from dropdown,
        *  System will fetch respective stage description in editable mode.
      * After selecting of Stage, System should fetch "Type of Defect", "Length", "Excavated. Depth (mm)", "Spot No." and "Date" fields data automatically.  

        * System should show "Type of Defect", "Length", ""Excavated. Depth (mm)"", " "Spot No.", "Repair No." and "Date" fields in editable mode
          * Table **locations -QMS070 - Seam/spot Details and QMS02 -Stage Description**  

          * For "Type of Defect" and "Spot No." fields - if there are multiple values, System will fetch all values separated with comma
            * Type of Defect is multiselect dropdown, User can still select/deselect from dropdown.
          * For "Length" and "Excavated. Depth (mm)" fields, - System will fetch and automatically add all values.  

            * System will show added values in the field in editable mode.
          * For "Date" field,
            * System will fetch Maximum Inspection date and User should be able to view Calendar button to change/edit date. 
          * System will not fetch "Repair No." and its user specific field.  

        * User can change Seam No from dropdown before saving, 
          * System will clear the field and show selected Seam No fetched values in the fields. 
    * In Action column, User should be able to view Save and cancel button (Initially),  

      * Upon clicking Cancel button, 
        * System should not save any changes/edited data. 
      * Upon clicking Save button, 
        * System should save all edited data. 
      * System should show row data in view only mode. 
    * After save, In Action column, User should be able to view "Edit" and "Delete" button for previously added rows. 
      * Upon clicking "Edit" button,  

        * User should be able view "Seam No", "Type of Defect/Abnormality", "Length (mm)", "Excavated. Depth (mm)", "Spot No.", "Repair No.", "Date" fields in editable mode.  

      * Upon clicking "Delete" button, 
        * System should show a pop-up window of "Delete confirmation" message with "Yes" and "No" button. 
        * Message -"Are you sure want to delete the seam".
        * Upon clicking "Yes" button, 
          * System should delete the respective selected row. 
        * Upon clicking "No" button 
          * System should close pop-up window of "Delete confirmation". 
      * User should be able to view "Add Seam" button shown as per visuals,  

      * Upon clicking "Add Seam" button, 
        * System should add a new blank row in the grid. 
    * All fields are **Mandatory,**** ** and all dropdowns have** ****predictive search  ****functionality****.    
**  
  

  * **2nd flow** \- If selected Categories are "NCR".  

    * Initially, A Single editable row should be shown in the Grid of seam details shown as per visuals. 
    * User should be able to view "Seam No.", "Type of Defect/Abnormality", "Length (mm)", "Excavated. Depth (mm)", "Spot No.", "Repair No.", "Date" and Action button column shown as per visuals.  

    * All column of a single row should be merge to a single column with save and cancel button.  

    * User should be able to enter/edit data in the row (User specific field). 
    * In Action column, User should be able to view "Edit" and "Delete" button, 
    * Upon clicking "Edit" button, System should show merged row in editable mode. 
    * Upon clicking "Delete" button, 
      * System should show a pop-up window of "Delete confirmation" message with "Yes" and "No" button. 
      * Message -"Are you sure want to delete the seam". 
      * Upon clicking "Yes" button, 
        * System should delete the respective selected row. 
      * Upon clicking "No" button 
        * System should close pop-up window of "Delete confirmation". 
    * User should be able to view "Add Seam" button shown as per visuals, 
      * Upon clicking "Add Seam" button, 
      * System should add a new blank row in the grid as per given merged format. 


Usability:
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

  2. **" Welding Parameter" **session,  

     * Initially User should be able to view Option A field with User specific field.  [Flow 18 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/2d744139-38b5-464f-bc44-a4423c2daadc-7827/)
       * User should be able to view "WPS No." field shown as per visual,
       * In dropdown Menu, System will fetch and show only project wise Approved** ** "WPS No." data.
         * User should be able to enter and select** ** "WPS No." from single select dropdown menu,
       * System will fetch selected WPS No Grid data shown as per visuals  

       *  if user change the WPS no,
         * System would regenerate grid as per WPS No changed by the user.
       * User should be able to view + icon shown as per visual. 
         * In hover user will be able to view "Add WPS" field name shown as per visuals.
         * System will generate new grid under respective option Grid. 
           * User again select WPS No there and system will fetch WPS No wise grid data.
         * Example -Under option A if user click add option 3 times 
           *  System will generate 3 grid with blank WPS No 
           * User can select WPS No there and system will fetch WPS No wise grid data.  

       * User should be able to view "X" cross icon shown as per visual, 
         * Upon clicking cross icon "X", 
         * System should delete the respective selected cross icon grid. 
           * If there is only one WPS No and only one option i.e. A grid is remained, 
             * System should disable the cross icon, 
           * For example, there is only one option A and under that there is only one grid 
             * System should disable the cross icon,
       * User should be able to view "Add Option" button shown as per visuals,  

         * Upon clicking Add Option,  

         * System should add new grid with option B,C,D..... sequence follow.  

           * New option grid with User specific field.
     * User should be able to view below columns under each WPS grid with fetched data as per selected WPS No shown as per visuals.
       * "Pass No", "Welding Process", 
          * Read only fields.
       *  "Position "
         * Single select dropdown menu.
       * **" Electrode/Filler Wire**" (Read only fields).
          *  "Type" 
          *  "Size"
       * "Flux", "Shield Gas" (Read only fields)
       *  "Welding Parameter"
          1. "Amps (A)" {(i) icon} (min and max value fields) -
          2. "Volt (V)" {(i) icon} (min and max value fields), 
          3. "Bead Length" (mm)"
          4.  "Min. Travel Speed(mm/min.) {(i) icon} 
          5. "Max. Heat Input (Kj / mm)"
          6. "Polarity"
          7. "Pre- Heat Temp ⁰C Min." 
          8. "Inter Pass Temp ⁰C Max."
     * System should fetch grid data automatically and filled in their respective columns.
       * User should be able to enter/edit fields.  

         * For first time, System should show all fetched rows fields which are not define as read only in editable mode.  

           * same for edit button functionality.  

         * For "Amps (A)" {(i) icon} ,Volt (V)" {(i) icon} and "Min. Travel Speed(mm/min.) {(i) icon}   

           * On clicking of "i" icon, User should be able to view Possible range - "{X}" (Min) to {Y}" (Max)"  

             * System should check and show min and max range as per selected WPS No.  

             * Example -possible range is 50(min) to 700(max).  

             * User should be able to enter/edit between min and max value range of respective fields as per selected WPS NO.  

               * System should show fetched value, if user enter other than specified range value.  

       * In Action column, User should be able to view Save and cancel button,   

         * Upon clicking Cancel button,   

           * System should not save any changes/edited data in the respective row.  

           * System should save the fetched data only.  

           * System should show row data in view only mode.  

         * Upon clicking Save button,   

           * System should save all edited data.  

           * System should show row data in view only mode.
         * If User didn't Click on save button Upon clicking Save button,   

           * System will automatically save fetched data/previously save data not edited one.
       * In Action column, User should be able to view "Edit" and "Delete" button for previously saved rows.  

         * Upon clicking "Edit" button,   

           * User should be able to view fields which are not define as read only in editable mode with action column "Save" and "Cancel" button.  

         * Upon clicking "Delete" button,  

           * System should show a pop-up window of "Delete confirmation" message with "Yes" and "No" button.  

           * Message -"Are you sure want to delete?".  

           * Upon clicking "Yes" button,  

             * System should delete the respective row.  

           * Upon clicking "No" button  

             * System should close pop-up window of "Delete confirmation".  

     * User should be able to view and enter in "Remark field" at the end of all WPS No grid shown as per visuals.  

       * User specific fields.  



  

**Usability:**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

FMG2, MFG-2, PROD2, SHOP, ENGG2, PMG2, QI2, FSP, FS2, PLNG2, AUX2, CR2, WTC2, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC2, MET2, WE2, PUR2, STR2, QA-2, QC-2, NDE-2
user, I want to add details to the master DPP details

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. User should be able to add a new line item by clicking on the "Add New" button: [Master Data (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/97e0b16e-0c06-4567-8b1d-cce9e6956a09-c2b3/screen/1a1e4f9a-c103-4a27-bf50-dabd86dc7172)
  2. Clicking on Add new, should open a right side overlay as per visual: [Master Data (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/97e0b16e-0c06-4567-8b1d-cce9e6956a09-c2b3/screen/8a23e9da-9ee5-4cc4-8bc6-7bffc602176d)
  3. Below will be the values: 
     1. Name: User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 75 characters, mandatory 
     2. Target: Dropdown selection, one selection possible, values: <=, >=, <, >, = 
     3. Enter Target Value: User Input, Numeric, maximum 3 characters, decimal allowed up to one place, mandatory 
     4. Target Description: User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 75 characters, mandatory
     5. Radio Button for Percentage and Number
     6. Area: Dropdown, multiselect select (for shop)
     7. Doc. Format No: User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 15 characters, mandatory
     8. Doc Rev No: User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 3 characters, mandatory
     9. Report Frequency: Values: Monthly, Quarterly, Half Yearly, Yearly
     10. Audit Data Frequency: Values: Monthly, Quarterly, Half Yearly, Yearly

  5. Clicking on Add, will add a new line item in the index page along with a success toast message "Added Successfully"
     1. Before adding, system should check unique combination of Function, Area and Parameter, if it is unique then a new record should be added, otherwise, new record should not be added and a error message should be displayed "Duplicate Data, please enter unique values"
  6. System should capture the users Name and PS No, who is adding or modifying the details in the DB 
  7. Clicking on Cancel will abort the operation 
  8. Once a line item is added, then the values should get reflected for Maintain DPP as well

     1. If a user wants to edit a line item, then the user can do so by clicking on the pencil icon. 
     2. Clicking on this icon will open a right side overlay, where the user can make the desired modifications and click on Update, upon which, the line item will get modified 
     3. Before saving, system should check unique combination of Function, Area and Parameter, if it is unique then the record should be updated, otherwise, the existing record should not be updated and a error message should be displayed "Duplicate Data, please enter unique values"  

     4. Please note that the user will not be able to edit "Target" and "Audit Data Frequency" fields and they will be visible in read only mode 
  3.  Copy: 
     1. Each line item will have a copy button 
     2. Clicking on copy will copy the data of the line item, and populate in the right side overlay 
     3. Now, the Add button in the overly will only be activated, once the user enters unique data from the copied line item 
        1. System should check unique combinations of Function, Area and Parameter 
  4. Delete**:**
     1. User should be able to delete using the delete icon, clicking on it should show a confirmation and confirming the same should remove the line item from the index as well as DB 


  * Please note that in addition to the columns displayed in the visual, two more columns needs to be added as below 
    * Prepared By 
    * Approved 
  * Here, the user will maintain the designation of the all the DPP's to be shown as well as printed in the report

Functional:  

  1. Once a user clicks on view of a line item with status as "In-progress", or "Returned" the user will be able to see the details page as per visual: [RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/46d6cd38-44bd-40b9-8ae4-6a62abd34b79?fullscreen)

Reference Image:  
  

  3. The rest of the page will be in read only mode as per visual 
  4. The user will be allowed to edit the line items under the corrective action area, for which the user is appointed as "Responsible person". Rest of the line items will be in read only mode

Reference Image:  
  
  
  

  6. Once any document is uploaded, then the pin color should change from grey to green

Reference Image:  

  8. Once a user is satisfied with the uploaded documents, then the user can click on the in line "Submit" button, post which user will receive a confirmation popup and after confirming the same, it will be sent to the QA tray. Also, the line item will move from Pending tray to All tray and the status will change from "In-progress" to "Submitted to QA"
  9. If there are more then one line items, for which the user is responsible, then the status will change when, all the line items are acted upon 
  10. If there are any remarks sent from QA, then the user can view them by clicking on the QA remarks button

## US-14757 — CR: Test Plan Link and delink button functionality 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-14757 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Mandigiri Krishna Kumar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 3 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 14 |
| Tags | CR |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/14757) |

### Description

As a WE3 user, I want to create the test plan, so Inspector can prepare ICL for seam.

### Acceptance Criteria

222Pre-requisite: 
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 


**Navigation:  **
  1. WE3 User -->Select favorite project-->Click "Quick Links"\--> Click "Maintain Quality ID**/Test Plan** / Shop Weld Plan" page. 
  2. WE3 User -->Mega Menu---> Click "Maintain Quality ID/**Test Plan** / Shop Weld Plan" page.   

  3. WE3 User -->Select favorite project-->Notification --> Click on Quality Project specific Notification--> Open Maintain Quality ID/**Test Plan** / Shop Weld Plan" page (respective quality project should be selected selected)


**Functional -**
  

**  
**
**1) User should be able to link QID in Test plan through two flows -**  

  * **1st Flow -  Continuous of [#7490](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/7490) point no 6.**
    * Through Dropdown menu -User should be able to link QID by selecting QID in test plan session. 
    * If User selected identical project in  Quality Project 
      * User should be able to view main QID Approved Stages where its define as identical project also Manually added QID in the Quality ID Sessions
  * **2nd flow -  **Continuous of User Story [#13414](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13414) 
    * Through link button - User should be able to link QID by selecting single QID from Quality ID session and single/Multiple Seams in test plan session.  

  * For both Flow,  

    * User should be able to link only Approved QID to a Seam in Test Plan session.
       1. System should show only Approve QID in dropdown of Quality Id column of Test Plan session.  

       2. System should Disable the link button if user select any other status of QID in Quality ID session. 
    * After selecting/linking through link button, 
      * System should copy all the stages of selected QID to that linked seam number. 
        * Upon Clicking Stages button, User should be able to view linked QID stages and previously added stages in the respective seam "Stages-{Seam number}" overlay window.
      * System should show copy stages in the respective seam "Stages-{Seam number}" overlay window. 

**2) User should be able to delink QID in Test plan through two flows -  
**
  * **1st Flow -  Continuous of [#7490](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/7490) point no 6.**
    * Through delink button under three dots  -
    * User should be able to delink QID in Test Plan session -[#8070](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/8070)  
      * Refer 2nd point
  * **2nd flow -  **Continuous of User Story [#14555](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/14555) 
    * Through link button - User should be able to link QID by selecting single QID from Quality ID session and single/Multiple Seams in test plan session
For both Flow,  
User should be able to link only Approved QID to a Seam in Test Plan session.  
System should show only Approve QID in dropdown of Quality Id column of Test Plan session.  
System should Disable the link button if user select any other status of QID in Quality ID session. 
  

  * For both Flow,  

    * Will delink only the QID from the test plan and delete attached/added stages from particular seams. (not Seam only filled detailed)  

      * Also delete all the stages added by the user manually .
    * ~~System should be able to delete all the linked QID stages  in the respective seam "Stages-{Seam number}" overlay window.~~
      * ~~Not manually added stages only linked QID stages should be deleted.~~
    * Not applicable for approved and sent for approval status seams
      * confirm and follow old business logic, validation and integration for more validation for linking and delinking.
      * disable the Delink button, if user selected approved and sent for approval status seams.
    * While Replacing the QID with new QID 
      * Also delete all the stages added by the user manually and Added by the linking QID
    * While replacing and Delinking 
      * System should delete all the stage of particular seams and Add newly linked QID stages. 


Usability: 
The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have assigned the line documents from maintain index 
Functional: 
  1. User should be able to view the send email notification button as per visual under the three dots: [Flow 5 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/88db56bf-98c6-4fad-bfbe-d353c52762cb-dd88/screen/8893fd74-0b43-428a-8608-e3749a0b5fb6)

**FORMAT** :
__Email recipient_ _– To – Assignee (Unique names from table) and CC – QA3 (who has prepared Index)
__Email subject_ _– Submission of final documentation

Dear User,
Kindly submit final documents before expected date of completion as per below requirement in system.
 
Table 
Sr No  |  Name of document  |  Assigned to  |  Expected Completion Date   
---|---|---|---  
  |    |    |     
  |    |    |     
  |    |    |

FMG2, MFG-2, PROD2, SHOP, ENGG2, PMG2, QI2, FSP, FS2, PLNG2, AUX2, CR2, WTC2, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC2, MET2, WE2, PUR2, STR2, QA-2, QC-2, NDE-2
user, I want to get notified via email for approving the DPP came to my tray, so that I can approve the reports in a timely manner

### Acceptance Criteria

~~Perquisite: One approval cycle should be completed in system for sending email notifications~~  

Functional: 
  1. The person who is approving the DPP, should be notified via email for approving the DPP if not already done

     1. To: DPP Approver (L-2)

  5. Email Subject: Approve DPP Data  

  6. Email Body:   

Dear User,
Kindly review DPP in system.
Link: (Webpage link for DPP Approve)

### Description

As a QI2 user, I want to maintain CTQ identified in project so that I can Approve and close identified CTQ in project.

### Acceptance Criteria

User should be able to view "CTQ Detail" session in "Critical To Quality Detail **Draft** " Page  

​**Pre-requisite:**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


Navigation - 
  1. QI2 User \-->Mega Menu/Quick links---> Click ""Approve/Close Critical to Quality" Page---"({"CTQ Doc. No."} {"**STATUS "}**)" page 


**Functional  **
**  
**
**Continuous****  of **[#13397](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/13397) 
  * Approved/In progress Status ({"CTQ Doc. No."} {"**STATUS "}**)" page grid [Approve/Close Critical To Quality_QI2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/e21608ee-250f-4df6-9fa2-7e5a8503ed79-b745/screen/84c126ce-8d00-4efd-a8f5-0e0f63645d06)
  * In Action column of "Approved", "Implemented", "Returned", "Verified" status row, (Delete button is Not available in prototype)
    * User should be able to view "**Delete "** icon button directly. 
    * Upon clicking of "Delete" button, 
      * System should show a Pop-Up window of Delete Confirmation with "Yes" and "No" buttons. 
      *   

      * Message in popup window - "Deleting record will revise the {"CTQ Doc. No."}, Do you want to Delete the record?"
      * Upon clicking of "Yes" button,  

        * System should change the status of the record to the "Deleted" status,
        * System should move the record to end row of the Grid.
        * System should change respective Critical to Quality Details page status to Deleted.  

        * System should change the {"CTQ Doc. No."} page back to Draft Staus. (page 48)
          * In Header part System should update the next Revision of {"CTQ Doc. No."},
            * For example,
            * if Previously Revision no is R0 it should change to R1 and similarly R1 to R2, R2 to R3.......
          * {"CTQ Doc. No."} Draft Page Functionality already covered previously in different user stories.  

      *       * Upon clicking of No button,
        * System should close the Pop-Up window of "Delete Confirmation". 
  * Upon clicking of respective "Deleted" Status record for all IEMQS user in there respective Approve/Close Critical to Quality page and Maintain to Critical to Quality page
    * System should show respective "Critical to Quality Details **DELETED** " page. 
    * System should freeze the Critical to Quality Details page (show in view only mode)
    * Upon clicking "**Close** " button,
      * System should revert back to "{"CTQ Doc. No."} **IN-PROGRESS** " page.


**Usability:**
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-15156 — (US 10) TC review - (Temper Embrittlement)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-15156 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Amarjeet Sahoo |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\NLP Team |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/15156) |

### Description

As a WE2/WE3 user, I want to view the comparative analysis data Impact test Grid, so that I can view for any discrepancies and act on it

### Acceptance Criteria

## Prerequisites -  

## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * User should have uploaded the certificate and the data scanned and extraction analysis has been done on the same.
  * User should be shown only relevant Grid as per uploaded TC.


### Functional -
  
**For Impact Test -**  

User should be able to view Impact Test (Temper Embrittlement) grid as per visuals. -[TC Review (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/f2f11170-dac5-4337-ad6d-c032a8445f84-a7a2/screen/773480a1-5e70-427d-b424-cce7d558df16/?fullscreen)
  * User should be able to view "PWHT Condition, "Test Temp {UNIT}" and "Impact Energy (Single) {UNIT}" columns in the grid in view only mode as shown as per visuals.
    * In a "Test Temp {UNIT}" column, this UNIT need to be fetched from WBMS. for example, ℃ or °F.
    * In "Impact Energy (Single) {UNIT}", This UNIT need to be fetched from WBMS. for example, (J)
    * Use this image only for the Unit purposes   
   

  *   

  * System should fetch data automatically for all the above fields.
  * For all Test Details, if respective PWHT Condition is "MIN & MIN+SC",  

    * System will fetch all rows defined as per uploaded TC for "MIN" and for "MIN+SC" in the grid.
    * Format - 
       1. MIN - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS), Example -MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr, 
       2. MIN - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS)+SC, Example -MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr+SC, 


For example refer below image, for 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr we can see 8 rows and for MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr +SC we can also see 8 rows. System should fetch and show 16 rows in the Impact Test (Temper Embrittlement) grid.
  
  

**Special Notes-  **  

  1. The data should be fetched from ERP LN through Middleware to IEMQS. 
  2. Table structures, table schema, mandatory, primary index, the complete details need to be taken for ERP LN 
  3. All table are dynamic to data available in uploaded TC 


  

Usability:
  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

### Description

As a PLNG2/3, I want to get notified while saving a data with same inputs wrt existing data, so that I can avoid duplicate data entries in the system

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  

For (Lifting Lug, Lifting Trunnion, Ovality Ring, LSR/ISR) planning calculations, when user is trying to save the data, then system should compare all the entered inputs with the inputs from the line items present in the system with status as "Completed". If the user inputs match completely with an already existing completed entry, then system should show an error message "Data already exist, please enter different input combination", and should not store the data in the system, unless user provides a unique input combination which is not present in the system.

## US-15347 — "Raw Material" and "Welding Material"

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-15347 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Bhagyashree.Ghatapandi |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |

| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/15347) |

### Description

As a IEMQS User, I want to maintain project wise Cost of Poor Quality plan and fill given filled so that system should calculate total cost occur due to not maintaining of standard quality.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_Pre-requisite:_**  

  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:**    

  * User should be able to view "COPQ" Page shown as per visuals. 
  * User should be able to view "Cost Header" column shown as per visuals - [COPQ-latest (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a127ebd7-0e9c-4c2a-b36e-e81bb9a98114-f474/)
  * Under the Cost header column, User should be able to view following sections as shown as per visuals.  

    1. Raw material
    2. Welding Material
    3. Man-Hours  

    4. Engineering-Hours
    5. Sub-Contracting Cost  

    6. Fixturing Cost  

    7. Service Cost
    8. Misc. Expenses (i)
  * For all these sections, system will create a master data in backend and fetch dropdown data as per section wise from there.
  



  1. **" Raw Material" **and "**Welding Material " **sections**,  **[COPQ-latest (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a127ebd7-0e9c-4c2a-b36e-e81bb9a98114-f474/screen/37cb691c-c823-484f-baee-1615230d6197/)
     * User should be able to view "**Material Grade** " **multiselect dropdown** field as shown as per visuals,
     * System should fetch dropdown data from newly created master table and shown data here.
       * As per selection of dropdown, system should show number of User specific Integer only editable fields in their respective section. 
         * Name of header - "Weight of Material Grade used (in Kg)"
         * Name of editable fields as per selection in the dropdown, 
           * User can select and deselect items in dropdown anytime, System should show/hide/update fields as per selections. 
           * For Example - if user selected four items - Carbon Steel, Alloy Steel, Stainless steel, Clad plate 
             * Under the Weight of Material Grade used (in Kg)" Fields Name will be - "Carbon Steel", "Alloy Steel", "Stainless steel" and "Clad plate" fields.
     * System should calculate "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" by multiplying ("Weight(kg.)"and "Cost/Kg.") and divide by 100000.
     * System should fetch cost/Kg from the Global Master Table.
       * Example - For ="Weight(kg.) 8000, "Cost/Kg."=100,
       * "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)"= ("Weight(kg.)" X "Cost/Kg.")/100000 = (8000X100)/100000 = 8
     * System should calculate Total Cost (₹ In Lac)" by adding all fields "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" column field value and shown here.
     * All calculated value should be up to 2 decimal places.  

     * Example - In backend system should calculate Total Cost (Rs.Lac) of respective section.
     * Sl. No. | Selection in Dropdown Material Grade | enter as per selection Weight(kg.) | fetch automatically Cost/Kg in backend | **Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)** | **Total Cost (Rs.Lac)**  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
1 | Carbon Steel | 50.56 | 68 | 0.03 | 0.40   
2 | Alloy Steel  | 80.76 | 136 | 0.11   
3 | Stainless steel | 100 | 255 | 0.26   
  

     * Mandatory to be select at least a single option from the "Material Grade" dropdown in both the sections.  

     * ******In backend, System need to fetch data from Newley created  **Master  ****Table  **as per below showed Mapped data.**
          * Category - **" Raw Material" and **" Welding Material"****  

          * Particulars **\- Material Grade**
          * Cost**-  Cost/Kg.  
  
**


**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

## US-15348 — "Man-Hours" and "Engineering-Hours" 

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-15348 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | M.Selvakumar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/15348) |

### Description

As IEMQS User, I want to maintain project wise Cost of Poor Quality plan and fill given filled so that system should calculate total cost occur due to not maintaining of standard quality.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:  
**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:**  
  1. **" Man-Hours" **section**,**  

     * User should be able to view "**Type of Workmen Used** " **multiselect dropdown**  field as shown as per visuals, [COPQ-latest (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a127ebd7-0e9c-4c2a-b36e-e81bb9a98114-f474/screen/37cb691c-c823-484f-baee-1615230d6197/)
     * System should fetch dropdown data from newly created master table and shown values here.  

       * As per selection of dropdown, system should show number of User specific Integer only editable fields in their respective section. 
         * Name of header - No. of hours spent
         * Name of editable fields as per selection in the dropdown, 
           * For Example - if user selected these Three items (Permanant WM, Temporary WM, Apprentice) 
             * Fields Name will be - "Permanant WM", "Temporary WM", "Apprentice fields".
       * System should calculate "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" by multiplying "No. of Hours" and "Rate/ Hour" and divide by 100000.  

         * Example - For ="No. of Hours"= 60 and "Rate/ Hour=1000,  

         * "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)"= ("No. of Hours" X "Rate/ Hour")/100000 = (60X1000)/100000 = 0.6  

       * System should calculate "Total Cost (₹ In Lac)" by adding all rows values present under "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" column field value and shown here.  

       * All calculated value should be up to 2 decimal places.  

       * Type of Workmen Used (as per dropdown selection)  |  No. of hours spent (user specific integer field) | Rate/ Hour (Fetch automatically)  | Sub Total Cost (Rs. Lacs) | Total Cost (Rs. Lac)   
---|---|---|---|---  
Permanant WM  | 5  | 850  | 0.04  | 0.13   
Temporary WM  | 6  | 680  | 0.04   
Apprentice  | 7  | 680  | 0.05   
       * Mandatory to be select at least a single option from the "No. of hours spent" dropdown.  

       * In backend, System need to fetch data from Newley created Master Table as per below showed Mapped data.
            * Category - **" Man-Hours" **  

            * Particulars **- "Type of Workmen"**
            * Cost - "Rate/ Hour"  
  

  2. **" Engineering-Hours" **section**,**  

     * User should be able to view "**Select applicable department involved in the NCR** " **multiselect dropdown**  field as shown as per visuals, [COPQ-latest (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/a127ebd7-0e9c-4c2a-b36e-e81bb9a98114-f474/screen/37cb691c-c823-484f-baee-1615230d6197/)
     * System should fetch dropdown data from department list available in Global master - location required  

       * As per selection of dropdown, system should show number of User specific Integer only editable fields in their respective section. 
         * Name of header - "Investigation/inspection hours spent."
         * Name of editable fields as per selection in the dropdown, 
           * For Example - if user selected these two items "Welding", "Manufacturing". 
             * Fields Name will be - "Welding", "Manufacturing".
       * System should calculate "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" by multiplying "Investigation/inspection hours spent" and "Rate/ Hour" and divide by 100000.  

         * Example - For ="No. of Hours"= 60 and "Rate/ Hour=1000,  

         * "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)"= ("No. of Hours" X "Rate/ Hour")/100000 = (60X1000)/100000 = 0.6  

       * System should calculate "Total Cost (₹ In Lac)" by adding all rows values present under "Sub Total Cost (₹ In Lacs)" column field value and shown here.  

       * All calculated value should be up to 2 decimal places.

---|---|---|---|---  
Welding | 5 | 850 | 0.04 | 0.13   
Manufacturing | 6 | 680 | 0.04   
Quality | 7 | 680 | 0.05

       * **Mapping from Master  ****COPQ:**  

            * Category - **" Engineering Hours" **

### Description

As **IEMQS**** ** User, I want to maintain project wise Cost of Poor Quality plan and fill given filled so that system should calculate total cost occur due to not maintaining of standard quality.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:  
**
  1. User should be able to logged in the system. 
  2. As per PS No, 
     * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
     * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Functional:**    

  

  1. ​Upon Clicking on "**Cancel "** button, 
     * System should show a pop-up "Confirmation" window with "Yes" and "No" button,
       * Message in the Pop-up window - Are you sure, you want to leave this page?  

       * Upon clicking "Yes" button,
         * System should revert back to the old IEMQS legacy respective selected NCR page.
         * System should automatically save all the entered data.
       * Upon clicking "No" button,  

         * System should close the pop-up "Confirmation" window.  
  

  2. Upon Clicking on **" Add"** button,
     * Flow 1- All Mandatory fields are not filled.
       * System should highlight all the mandatory fields which are blank.
     * Flow 2- All Mandatory fields are filled,  

       * Message in the Pop-up window - Are you sure, you want to save entered information?"
       * Upon clicking "Yes" button,
         * System should save all the entered/edited information.
         * System should show Message - "COPQ detailed saved successfully."
         * System should revert back to the old IEMQS legacy respective selected NCR page.
         * System should calculate COPQ value by adding all the "Total Cost (₹ In Lac)" in backend.
         * For example - COPQ = adding all section "Total Cost (₹ In Lac)" = "Raw material" \+ "Welding Material" \+ "Man-Hours" \+ "Engineering-Hours" \+ "Sub-Contracting Cost" \+ "Fixturing Cost" \+ "Service Cost" \+ "Misc. Expenses (i)"
         * System should show calculated value in COPQ field of NCR page shown as per visuals.
         * User can modify the value by clicking on "(+)" Add COPQ button again, 
           * System should disable the COPQ session and its fields after submitting the NCR and CFAR.
           * Page functionality to disabling the fields will remain same as per old logic and validations.
     * Upon clicking "No" button,  

       * System should close the "Submit" confirmation pop up of window.


**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/15427) |

### Description

As a FMG-3, PROD3, SHOP, ENGG3, PMG3, QI3, FSP, FS3, PLNG3, AUX3, CR3, WTC3, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC3, MET3, WE3, PUR3, STR3, QA-3, QC-3, NDE-3, MFG3 user, I want to add attachments and save the selected row per requirement, so that I can send them for approval to the supervisor

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
US# 15439 
Functional: 
  

User should be able to perform below mentioned functionalities in the grid  

     1. Attachments: Maximum 10 files can be attached, allowed formats: pdf, ms word, ppt, excel, png, jpeg, If more than one file is attached, then the rest of the files will be shown in number format as per visual. This number value will increase or decrease depending on the number of files attached. The attached file will be downloaded by clicking on it. Maximum file size 500MB per file. In case user tries to upload more then 10 files, then an error message needs to be displayed "File uploading limit exceeded, please delete previously uploaded file to upload more". Please note that user can upload the files in "Draft" and "Returned" status only
     2. Once a user enters all the relevant inputs, then the user can click on the green tick button, which will save the data and show a toast message as per visual. Please note that the green tick button can only be clicked once the Root Cause and Corrective action is entered provided performance value is less than threshold value
     3. Status:
        1. Draft: When the user has saved the data but not yet submitted for approval
        2. Sent for Approval: When the user has saved the data and sent for approval
        3. Returned: When the supervisor has returned the data
        4. Approved: When the supervisor has approved the sent data

### Description

As a FMG-3, PROD3, SHOP, ENGG3, PMG3, QI3, FSP, FS3, PLNG3, AUX3, CR3, WTC3, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC3, MET3, WE3, PUR3, STR3, QA-3, QC-3, NDE-3, MFG3 user, I want to add Root cause and Corrective action  inputs for the selected tabs per requirement, so that I can send them for approval to the supervisor

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: US# 14580 
  

Functional: 
  1. Input Parameters: 
     1. Root Cause: 
        1. User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 250 characters per line, 
        2. User can create new line by clicking on the plus icon as per visual 
        3. Once the user writes the root cause and corrective action, then he can save it by clicking on the tick option 
        4. If a user clicks on the cancel button, then it will clear any data entered in the Root cause/corrective action 
     2. Corrective Action: 
        1. User Input, Alphanumeric, maximum 250 characters per line, 
        2. User can create new line by clicking on the plus icon as per visual 
        3. Once the user writes the  root cause and corrective action, then he can save it by clicking on the tick option 
        4. If a user clicks on the cancel button, then it will clear any data entered in the Root cause/corrective action  

     3. Please NOTE: 
        1. Root Cause and Corrective Action fields are mandatory if the input parameter of Performance is less or more than threshold value as set in Master DPP. The system should compare the entered "Performance" value along with the arithmetic operator set with the standard value in Master and should accordingly make the Root cause and Corrective action fields mandatory. 
        2. If the entered performance value is within the accepted limit set by DPP master, then the "Root Cause" and "Corrective Action" fields will be disabled and user will not be allowed to enter anything here 
        3. If a user want to add a new line item, then the user can click on Add New which will create a new line items for entering Root Cause, and corrective action

## US-15445 — Maintain DPP - #2 Action Buttons

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-15445 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Aritram Ghosh |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-UX |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/15445) |

### Description

As a FMG-3, PROD3, SHOP, ENGG3, PMG3, QI3, FSP, FS3, PLNG3, AUX3, CR3, WTC3, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC3, MET3, WE3, PUR3, STR3, QA-3, QC-3, NDE-3, MFG3 user, I want to use action buttons for timeline, search and filter, so that accurate data can be sent for approval

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. Timeline: This will contain four statuses and will update as per the specific item is completed. This can be expanded by clicking on timeline button and can be collapsed by clicking on the "X" button. (This button will only be visible and accessible with the status of a line item is draft/sent for approval/approved) 
     1. Created: This status will capture the User's name, Date and Time when the particular line item gets created and the status becomes draft. Please note that once created, it will remain same forever 
     2. Last Modified: Once a line item comes in draft status, then whenever it is modified, then the latest user's name, date and time will come in this status 
     3. Returned: If a line item is returned by the supervisor, then the supervisors name, as well as the date & time of returning will come here 
     4. Approved: Once a line item is Approved by the supervisor, then the supervisor's name, date and time will come in this status 
  2. Search: User should be able to search from the grid by entering any relevant keyword. If the keyword entered is not relevant, then a placeholder image as per visual needs to be shown 
  3. Filters: Applying the below filter should filter the grid accordingly 
     1. Status: (Multiselect dropdown) Values: Draft, Sent for Approval, Approved, Returned 
     2. Month (Multiselect dropdown): Values, All the available months 


Note: Please note that all the action button operations can only be applied for current or previous month. It is not allowed for future months. Also, the edit button can only be shown to the user when the status of the line item is Draft/Returned. The timeline button will get enabled once the status of a line items changes to draft. The report button will be visible once the status of a line items becomes draft.

### Description

As a
QA-1/2/3 
user, I want to act on the RCA came under my tray, so that I can quickly revert it

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. The QA person, who has been assigned RCA, should be able to see the Submitted RCA's under the pending tray: [RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/6116e55f-80ff-4ed1-9e03-0534d7fd2ddd)
  2. These RCA's are the one's which are assigned and send from the initiator 
  3. In the Pending Tray, user can select any RCA's detail screen icon, review the RCA and perform Approve or Return: [RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/8570e882-fa7b-4e1d-a3af-0c0973e01292)  
Reference Image:  
  

  4. Clicking on Approve will show a confirmation popup and on confirming the same, will change the status of the line item from "Submitted to QA" to "Approved"  
Reference Image:  
  

  5. The selected line item will now move from Pending tray to All tray 
  6. If a user wants to return the line item, then the user can click on Return, upon which the user has to mandatorily write the return remarks. Here as well, the line item will move to All tray  
Reference Image:  
  

  7. The return remarks should be accessible for future references beside the status column  
Reference Image:  
  

  8. In the All Tab, the QA will also be able to see other RCA's with all the possible statuses. The assigned QA, can only act on the RCA if it is assigned to them 
  9. In Pending Tab, the QA will be able to see line items, which are 
     1. Created by them (Status- In-progress) 
     2. Came for their approval (Status- Submitted to QA)

As a
QA2, QC2, NDE2 , AUX2, Logistics2, DE2, WE2,  PMG2 FMG2, PROD2, SHOP, ENGG2, PMG2, QI2, FS2,PLNG2, CR2, WTC2, JOBPLNG,JP, OVLPROD, MCC2, MET2,  WE2, PUR2,STR2, 
User, I want to submit the RCA data for approval for NCR incidence type, so that it can get properly captured in the system

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: US# 16052 
Functional: 
  1. If a user want to save the data, then the user can do so by clicking on Save button, the status in this case will be In-Progress in the index screen 
  2. Once the user gets the digital sign on the RCA then the Submit button will get activated 
  3.  When the user uploads signed RCA from the index page, the RCA will be submitted to QA as per visual [RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/27aa351a-6d12-4448-a481-45bcda1e4241/)
  4. Once the user click on Submit after filling the RCA details for the Incidence Type "NCR", then for that line item following things will happen 
     1. For that line item, on its index screen, the status will change to "Submitted" 
     2. In the Index Page, the action button will now have View, Download and Timeline buttons 
     3. For the RCA No column in the index screen, the nomenclature in this case will be RCA/<Project No>/<NCR No>/<S.No>. For eg, if Project No is S010427, NCR No is 12322-NCR-1, and serial number is 1, then the RCA No will become "**RCA/S010427/ 12322-NCR-1/1**"
  5. After clicking on the submit button, the user needs to be redirected to the CAPA submission page of the legacy portal  
Reference Image:

  * If there is any miss in any parameter an appropriate error message will be displayed. 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **Given  **the mandatory input parameters like: 'ContractStatus, StartDate, EndDate' from FMS application.  

  * **Then  **Integration inflow API will call ERPLN application to fetch the information details related to cash inflow.
  * **Then  **the received information will be shared to FMS on batches upto 300 records until the field value "MoreRecordExists" is set to 'NO' by integration API.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

## US-16111 — Corrective Action Implementation \|#1 QA Screen

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16111 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Bhagyashree.Ghatapandi |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 17 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16111) |

### Description

As a assigned QA user, I want to view the line items assigned for my action, so that I can quickly act on it

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: The US for Corrective Action Implementation for Responsible Person 
Functional: 
  1. User should be able to view the line items, assigned for their action as per visual :[RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/002bf416-ed60-404a-9311-d2810ddb6042)
  2. The Logic for Pending and All 
     1. The pending Tray will have line items with status as "Submitted to QA"
     2. The All tray, will have line items with status as "Returned", "Submitted to QA" and "Verified"
  3. The action button functionalities will be the same as corrective action implementation for the responsible person 
  4. The user can view the detail screen after clicking on the view button 
  5. Once the user enter the detail screen for the status of the line item as "In-progress" or "Returned", then the user should be directly navigated to the "Corrective Action" area 
  6. Here, the user will be able to view the uploaded files uploaded by the responsible person by clicking on the pin icon, which will open the MVC upload/view controller in a new tab 
  7. The user will also be able to view the Responsible persons remarks, by clicking on the remarks 
  8. The user can also add remarks by clicking on the inline QA remarks 
  9. Once the user is satisfied with the corrective action implementation done by the responsible person, then the user can click on the Approve button, which will show a confirmation popup, and upon confirming the same, will approve the line item and change the status of the line item from "Submitted to QA" to "Verified". This will also be visible to the Responsible person  
Reference Image: Please note that, the color of the action button will change accordingly, after any action is triggered as per visual  
  

  10. Also, once the QA verifies the corrective action, in the RCA screen, then status should change from "Approved" to "Completed": Reference Link: [RCA (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/8a9b0489-3eb2-4e68-b0f0-11426bd6a864-dfc8/screen/1a6eed5b-f6f8-4ed7-8291-d49ef84d05f9?fullscreen)  
Reference Image of RCA for showing the status:  
  

  11. The user can also return any line item upon clicking on the "Return" button, in this case the user need to mandatorily fill remarks and then the line item will get returned. This will change the status from "In progress" to "Returned" and the Responsible person will get this line items in their pending tray to act upon. For the QA, this line item will get moved from the Pending Tray to All Tray 
  12. If there are more than one corrective action to be verified by the QA, then if all the line items are approved, then the status will change in the index screen of Corrective action implementation as well as RCA. If in case, user has returned any line item, then the status will immediately change from "Submitted to QA" to "Returned"
  13. Once the user has acted upon the corrective actions, then the user will be able to see the detail page, in read only mode, and user will not be allowed to act upon the corrective actions 
  14. At the bottom of the detail screen, there will be a close button, clicking on it will close the window and take the user to the index screen 


Note: This screen is user specific, the QA person who is assigned to verify and approve, only those line items will be visible to the user, rest RCA's, will not be visible to the user in this screen

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|

| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |

| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16307) |

### Description

As an IEMQS user, I need the ability to access contract associated data from the ERPLN application within the PAM portal. In the Portal I will be performing below functionalities and associated data is expected: 
  1. **View Contract Data** : In the PAM portal, I want to view relevant data associated with contracts from the ERPLN application. This includes details such as ContractNo, ContractDesc, CustomerCode,  CustomerName, LOINo,  LOIDate, CDD, Prospect, CustomerOrderNo, CustomerOrderDate, Zeordate. 
  2. **Control Display:** To manage the data effectively, I want the option to enter an index value that determines the number of contract records displayed on a single page within the portal. 
  3. **Apply Filters:** I require the ability to apply filters to columns within the displayed contract list. 
  4. **Perform Partial Text Search:** In addition to filtering, I need to perform a partial text search within the displayed contract data. This search function should include a search field where I can input keywords, and the portal should return results that match the entered text across relevant contract attributes.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Functional Requirements:**
  * **Given** I am logged into the Project Alignment Meeting (PAM) portal as an IEMQS user with access to the ERPLN integration and there is contract-associated data available in the ERPLN application. 
  * **When** I access the Contracts section in the PAM portal. 
  * **Then** I should see a list of contract records displayed in the portal, including contract numbers, descriptions, start and end dates, and other relevant information. 
  * **Given** the contract data is displayed. 
  * **When** I have the option to input an index value to control the number of contract records shown on a single page. 
  * **Then** I should be able to adjust the index value, and the portal should display the appropriate number of records based on my input. 
  * **Given** the displayed contract list. 
  * **When** I apply filters to columns based on specific criteria, such as contract status, project manager, or contract type. 
  * **Then** the portal should refine the displayed data according to the selected filters. 
  * **Given** the filtered contract data. 
  * **When** I enter keywords into the search field for partial text search. 
  * **Then** the portal should return results that match the entered text across relevant contract attributes, updating the displayed data accordingly. 


  

**_Input Parameter conditions_**
**_  
_**
The input combination that is expected by the API is the following. 
  

**Given**   StartIndex and EndIndex with filter values **Then**  API need to provide list of contract records in JSON format based on StartIndex , EndIndex and Filter values.
  

**Given**   StartIndex and EndIndex without filter values **Then**  API need to provide list of  contract records in JSON format based on StartIndex , EndIndex and there is no filter.
  
**Given**   StartIndex, EndIndex, sort values and with filter values **Then**  API need to  provide list of  contract records in JSON format based on StartIndex , EndIndex and the filter values. The JSON value need to sort based on the sort value.  

  

**Given**   no values is provided in the input parameter **Then**  API need to provide error messages.  

  

**Non-Functional Requirements:**  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

## US-16355 — Email Notification

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16355 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Sathish Kumar M |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\QA_QC_NDE\Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 17 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16355) |

### Description

As a responsible person for the corrective action implementation, I want to receive notification emails in my mailbox, so that I can quickly act on it

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: The RCA should have been approved by the responsible QA. 
Functional: 
  1. The Responsible person of the corrective action implementation should receive an email as per below frequency 
     1. On the day of RCA approval from QA 
     2. 15 days before the target date 
     3. 7 days before the target date 
     4. Once the target date is passed, and the corrective action implementation is not acted and sent for approval, then system should send email daily to the person, till the corrective action implementation is not sent 
     5. Please note that once the user has acted on the corrective action implementation, then the system should not send email 
  2. The Email recipient To: Corrective Action Implementor, CC: The responsible QA, IS of Corrective Action Implementor, IS of responsible QA 
  3. Email Subject: RCA No - <RCA No.> - Corrective Action Implementation pending  
  4. Email Body:   
Dear <Responsible Person>,  
Corrective action implementation is pending for RCA.   
Kindly complete corrective action implementation.  
  
  

Regards, 
Name of Responsible QA3 


Note: 
Please note that, in case of NCR, CFAR, one the QA approves from MVC, then the system should trigger Email.

### Description

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: 
User should have created a Maintain Assessment Request and generated a line item. The status should be either "Draft" or "Returned"
Functional:
  1. User can go to the details page of a line item by clicking on the View icon. On hovering this icon, the text should be displayed as per visual: [Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/9b032036-82c4-469d-82b9-4d3c33cd61d3)  
Reference Image: Please note that on hover of this image, a text needs to be shown as per visual  
  

  2. The detail screen in the "Draft" mode status, should be shown as per visual 
  3. The Heading, breadcrumbs and basic details (In read only mode) should be visible as per visual: [Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/ace8f752-5cd1-4d4f-a849-e9f870e52ce2)  
Reference Image:  
  

  4. Below the basic details, user should be able to see list of a grid with columns as below:  

     1. Sr. No. 
     2. Name of Document 
     3. Applicable 
  5. In this gird, under the "Name of Document" column, below 15 documents names should be always visible 
     1. Organization Chart  

     2. Copy of Certificates & accreditations  

     3. Quality System Manual & Procedures  

     4. Last Internal Audit Schedule & List of Internal Auditors  

     5. Procedure for Selection of Supplier, Approved Supplier List  

     6. List of Instruments for Inspection with Calibration Status (2 Sample Calibration report of M&TE)  

     7. Training Plan & Training Record  

     8. List of Qualified NDE Personnel  

     9. Procedure for Document Control, Material Traceability, Storage & Preservation of Raw Material/Finished Components  

     10. Process Flow from Receipt of Material to Dispatch of Finished item  

     11. Material Testing Facility  

     12. Procedure for Non-conformance & sample report (Filled)  

     13. Information on current defect occurrences & analysis  

     14. Sample Inspection Reports & Material Test Certificates  

     15. Procedure for Handling Customer complaint & evidence of satisfactory closure of Customer Complaint 
  6. The Sr. No against the Document name should progressively increase 
  7. Under the column named "Applicable", there will be a toggle switch, on every line item, which will be by-default in "On state"
  8. At the last, there will be a upload icon against all the line items as per visual. 
  9. At the top of the grid, there will be a "Add New" icon, clicking on it should generate a new line item in an editable mode as per visual, it should automatically generate the Sr.No as per current grid numbering sequence  
Reference Image:  
  

     1. The user can enter the name and check the toggle switch if required (By default the toggle switch will be in on state) and once the user is satisfied, the user can click on the tick icon, which will save the data in system 
     2. Clicking on the X button will not save any data, and will remove the created line item 
  10. Please note that the text present below grid "Total XX Documents", here the XX will get replaced by the total count of the line items, By default the count will be 15, but it may increase if the user add new line items. Please note that the count is the total count of the documents irrespective of the toggle switch status or uploaded documents 
  11. User should be able to user the search functionality, by clicking on the filter icon, clicking on it will open the search bar  
Reference Image:  
  

  12. User should be able to export the data by clicking on the export button 
     1. The data will be exported to excel with name as "Maintain Assessment Documents" and in the "Applicable" column, the values will be Yes/No. "Yes" will come if the toggle button is switched-on and "No" will come when the toggle button is switched-off 
  13. User should be able to use the column sorting functionality

## US-16393 — Retrieve welder availability (ContractStaff) and Validity from CLMS

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16393 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IEMQS |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 8 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16393) |

### Description

As an IEMQS user, I need the ability to access and retrieve information regarding contract or external welders' availability and their validity status from the CLMS (Contract Labor Management System). This includes ensuring that the welders are not in a hibernation state and that their validity extends up to a certain date.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Functional Requirements:**  

**  
**
  * **Finding Available Welders**
    *  **Given** that I am an IEMQS user
    *  **When** I initiate a request through the IEMQS API to find available welders, 
    *  **Then** the API communicates with CLMS. 
    *  **And** the API retrieves a list of contract or external welders who are currently available for deployment.  
  
** **
  * **Validity Status**
    * Given that I am an IEMQS user,
    * **When** I request information about a specific welder's validity, 
    * **Then** the API contacts CLMS to verify the welder's status. 
    * **And** the API ensures that the welder is not in a hibernation state. 
    * **And** the API provides the date until which the welder's validity is confirmed. 


  

**Non-Functional Requirements:**  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

     1. In this section, there will two components: [Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/560e9820-69eb-4e27-8c9b-c31ea9e80995) (Refer Page#15 of xd)

        3. Post, this, the "Email to Initiator" button will get activated. Clicking on it will show a success toast message as per visual and will trigger an email to the initiator, who has created this request.**(For Email format, please refer ADO attachment)**
        4. Please note that on click of Email to initiator, the system should also save the values  in system, since there is no intermediary save button
  2. ​The next section will be named "Auditor for Assessment"  
Reference Image:  
  

     1. Here there will be following components 
        1. Auditor: User can search and select relevant Auditor, multi select is possible (System to fetch and show all IEMQS users)
