Reference Image:  
  
  
  

        3. Once the user has selected the Auditor/Auditor's and attached the documents, then the "Email to Auditor" button will get enabled 
        4. Clicking on that button will do the following 
           1. Firstly, a confirmation popup should be shown with content "Are you sure you have attached all the relevant documents to be sent to the Auditor/s" along with "Yes" and "No" button, clicking on Yes will trigger an E-mail request and show a success toast message as per visual :[Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/560e9820-69eb-4e27-8c9b-c31ea9e80995)

           2. Please note that on click of Email to Auditor, the system should also save the values in system, since there is no intermediary save button  

           3. Clicking on "No", will close the popup

Reference Image:  
  

     1. Here there will be a pin button (View/Attach Document): Clicking on this will open the legacy MVC, upload/download controller, where the user can upload/save/delete the documents
  4. The last section will be named as "Assessment Result", which will have below components: 
     1. Recommended For: Single select dropdown, Values
        1. Acceptable 
        2. Conditionally Acceptable 
        3. Rejected 
     2. Scope Recommended: User Input, text area, maximum 200 characters, alphanumeric. 
  5. The "Complete" button will be enabled once the user has uploaded file in the "Upload Assessment Report" section and selected the "Recommended For" dropdown value and filled the "Scope Recommended"
  6. Clicking on "Complete" will show a confirmation popup, and confirming the same will show a success toast message and do the following things:   
Reference Image:  
  

     1. It will change the status of the line item from the index page of "Assessment Request Review" to "Assessment Completed", [Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/b3312a23-e362-46d1-b439-ab54550558ac). Also, in its details screen, the "Complete" button will now get hidden [Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/9221c55d-7f06-4eb0-a117-6e5e2a7c4148), (Refer Page#18 of xd)

Also, from the index page of "Maintain Assessment Request" module ([Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/9b032036-82c4-469d-82b9-4d3c33cd61d3)),  the status for that line item will change to "Assessment Completed". Also a line item in the timeline will get populated with the status, name and date/timestamp. Also, the "Approver" and "Approver Date" will be populated
     3. In the index page of "Maintain Assessment Request" module, for that line item in the action button, a pin icon will now be shown, clicking on it open the MVC controller for upload/view files, where the user will only be able to view and download the files. These files needs to be fetched from the "Upload Assessment Report" section ([Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/9221c55d-7f06-4eb0-a117-6e5e2a7c4148))
     4. The "Scope Recommended" which is filled in the "Assessment Details" sessiond, should be visible in the index page of "Maintain Assessment Request" module, under the "Scope Recommended" column  

     5. In the "Maintain Assessment Request" index page, under the "Audit Result" column, the value selected from the "Recommended For" under the "Assessment Result" section of "Assessment Details" screen should be visible
  7. Once the item is completed, the action button at the bottom of the grid in the detail section "Assessment Details" will now only have one button, which will be "Close" ([Vendor assessment (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/593f662e-642d-4ebd-9549-afeb4a23ce80-0c6c/screen/9221c55d-7f06-4eb0-a117-6e5e2a7c4148))

## US-16455 — Production - Identification marking need to enter at each set-up stage.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16455 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16455) |

### Description

* **_Identification Marking_** data shall be copied from _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol036_**) to _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol037_**)
  * This changes will be done in _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol037_**) web page. 
  * Trigger point of fetch this data, while user come first time on _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol037_**)

### Acceptance Criteria

* System will fetch data based on part/position associate with the seam.
    * E.g. for project S040911, if require data of Identification Marking for CW1002 then for _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol037_**), system will fetch data from associate part/position (1001,1002)
    * System will fetch seams which is associate with position 1001,1002. Like 
      * LW1001 - 1001,1001
      * LW1003 - 1002,1002
    * Now system will fetch Identification Marking data from setup protocol for LW1001 and LW1003.
    * All identification marking will be added in _SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM_ (**_Protocol037_**)

## US-16508 — Get Project list for PAM portal and Weld Consumable Receipt from ERPLN

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16508 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IEMQS |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 8 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16508) |

### Description

As a Welding Engineer using the Weld Consumable Receipt (WCR) application, I want to access a list of Projects from ERPLN by initiating a search based on a partial "ProjectID". This search should occur when I input at least two characters into the "ProjectID" field in the WCR interface.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Functional Requirements:**
  * **  Searching for Projects **
    * **Given  **that I am a Welding Engineer in the WCR application
    * **When  **I enter at least two characters into the "ProjectID" fields,
    * **Then**  the "getProjectList" API is triggered.
    * **And**  the API uses the input characters to query ERPLN's database for matching projects.
    * **And**  the API returns a list of projects in response to my search.
    *  A Project ID is mandatory to obtain the project list.
  * **Receiving Project List**
    *  **Given**  that I am a Welding Engineer in the WCR application,
    *  **When**  the "getProjectList" API is invoked,
    *  **Then**  I can select from the list of projects displayed in a dropdown in the WCR interface.
    *  **And**  the selected project is set as the "ProjectID" in WCR application for further actions.


  

**Non-Functional Requirements:**  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

  * **When** the user enters a valid contract number in the specified input field and initiates the search. 
  * **Then** the PAM portal should trigger a request to ERPLN to fetch project list associated with the entered contract number.

## US-16608 — Navigation To Capture Protocol button and page functionality

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16608 |
| State | Refined |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | M.Selvakumar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 2 |

| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16608) |

### Description

As a PROD3, MFG3 User, I want to upload handwritten protocol data so that system will automatically read the protocol by performing OCR and fill data in web based protocol fields which previously I was filling manually.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:**  

  * User should be able to logged in the system.


**Navigation-  **
  1. As a PROD3 and MFG3 users->In Process Inspection\--->Offer/Re-Offer Inspection-Seam---->Index Page---->Action button column--->"**View Protocol Detail** " icon--->Respective form Page---->"Capture Protocol" button 
     1. \---->
     2. Index Page icon link - [SeamList Inspection :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/IPI/MaintainSeamListOfferInspection/Index#Pending)
  2. As a PROD3and MFG3 users-\-->In Process Inspection\--->Offer/Re-Offer Inspection-Seam---->Index Page---->Action button column--->"**View Detail** " icon--->Detail Page---->Under "Protocol" Section---->"Click to Open" button--->Respective form Page--->"Capture Protocol" button 
     1. \----->\----> and 
     2. Detail Page icon link -[Seam List Offer Inspection :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/IPI/MaintainSeamListOfferInspection/SeamListOfferInspection/4897082?from=offer)


**Functional -**
**  
**
**Protocol Details page functionality,**
  1. System will open respective selected seam and stage combination record wise "**P****rotocol Details "** page format with** "****Capture Protocol "** button shown as per visual.  

     * we are not changing any old validation or logic or format, only filling data in previously added format in their respective field automatically through API.
     * System will fetch data of respective format and will fill in their respective fields.  

     * If any data is not fetched from NLP then user can input the data in editable fields (GREEN CLOR). 
     * User can modify data fetched from NLP, available in editable fields (GREEN COLOR). 
     * Upon clicking "Save Draft" data modified data and data fetched from NLP shall be saved in form. 
  2. "Protocol Details" page "**Submit** " button and "**Save Draft** " function will remain same as per old validation and logic.  

     * System will show view only mode "**P****rotocol  Details" **page when "submitted" as per old page Logic and validation. 
       * View only mode page "Protocol Details" page functionality will remain same.
       * System will also **D****isable  ****"****Capture Protocol "** button in view only mode "Protocol Details" page.
  3. System will only work with the attached single format -**VISUAL & DIMENISON FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM**
  4. System will only cover 4/5 tables under this format as per mapping user story.


**Usability:**  

  * The design should be compatible with Laptop/ Desktop chrome browsers.

## US-16663 — E-Sign Dropdown \| UT Reports

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-16663 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Kishore Kumar C C |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags | CR |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/16663) |

### Description

As a NDE-1/2/3, I want to get the e-sign on the document, so that I can submit the same for further processes

### Acceptance Criteria

Perquisite: US#16653 
Functional: 
  1. In the e-signature screen, under the "Sign & Approve documents", in the field "Witnesses/Approved By", a new dropdown value needs to be added named "L&T". 
  2. Please note that this will be applicable only to Reports type "UT". 
  3. Reference Images:  
  
  
  

  4. After selecting "L&T" value from the dropdown, the e-sign should get appended in the second box as shown above. 
     1. If user is selecting "L&T" value, then the fields named "Agency Name", "Intervention Stage" and "TPI Name" should get hide. System should check user PS No is qualified for NDE Type UT for Level II/III from NDEMaster Table. In case the user is not assigned for UT, then system should show popup and should not allow that user to approve the report
     2. When user "Approve" the report, system shall upend "LEVEL" from "NDEMaster" next to "L&T" Label in "Reviewed and Approved By" signature box. System shall get "LEVEL" using "PS Number" of user. 
     3. After upending "LEVEL", PDF of report shall be re-generated. 
     4. ~~e-sign shall be applied on re-generated report.   ~~
     5. User name shall be appended above "initials" row.
  5. Sample report is attached in ADO for reference  

  6. In order to submit PT, MT, RT & UT report for e-sign updating TPI result in MVC page is not mandatory.
  7.   

  8. When e-sign report is returned by TPI then system shall allow L&T user to update spot result in MVC page.
  9. After updating spot result as per TPI comments, revised report will be generated and send to e-sign by clicking on "Resubmit" button. 
  10. When user clicks on "Submit to QA" button, system shall check status of all spots of seam in system as "Cleared". If status of all spots is "Cleared" and all iteration reports are signed and available in e-sign module then "Submit to QA" button will send combined PDF to NDE file folder. Reports shall be compiled in order of iteration. e.g iteration 1, iteration 2, iteration 3, iteration 4\. In case of parallel stage unless result of all stages is cleared then only "Submit to QA' button get active.
  11. ~~User shall be allowed to download signed report from e-sign module to share with TPI. "Download" button shall be provided in each row of record. "Download" button shall be provided in Before "Cancel" button so user can multiselect all reports and download compiled file. Downloaded file shall contain e-sign if present. ~~
  12.

  * User should be able to logged in the system. 
  * As per PS No, 
  * System should show favourite Projects on landing page. 
  * System should show Notification and related project link on the landing page. 


**Navigation:  
**
  * WE3/WE2 User -->Mega Menu/Quick Links---> Click "Maintain SWRP " Page----->selected project and Type of Joint "Shop Weld plan Repair" Page


**Functional:**  

**  
**
****1\. Seam Detail Session****  
****
  * ** ** If selected Categories are **" Major" and "Minor", **No changes required in **NCR  **flow  

    * User should be able to enter and select** ****" Seam No."** from single select Dropdown field shown as per visuals.  

      * Initially, System should show Seam No dropdown field editable. -
      * Upon selecting of "Seam No" system will fetch "Stage Code" single select dropdown data   

      * Example -
      * Seam | stage code | defect | spot | length | depth | Repair  | date   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
CW103 | MT | Slag ,crack | 1-2,3-4,5-6 | 50,60,80 | 20,20,31 | user field | fetch   
CW103 | RT | Crack | 1-2,3-4,5-7 | 51,61,81 | 20,21,32 | user field | fetch   
  

      * After selecting of Stage Code, System should fetch "Type of Defect" **multiselect**  dropdown data, 
        * System should fetch only those "Type of Defect" which are define against rejected spot of selected stage code. 
      * As per selection of Type of Defect, system will fetch "Length", "Est. Depth (mm)", "Spot No." and "Date" fields data automatically.
        * Type of Defect is multiselect dropdown, User can still select/deselect from dropdown.
          * initially automatically select all the fetch type of defect as per stage code.
        * System should show "Type of Defect", "Length", "Est. Depth (mm)", " "Spot No.", "Repair No." and "Date" fields in **editable  **mode.
          * Table **locations -QMS070 - Seam/spot Details and QMS02 -Stage Description**  

          1. For "Spot No." fields - if there are multiple values, System will fetch all values separated with comma separator.
          2. For "Length" and "East. Depth (mm)" fields, 
             * System will update length as per selected "Spot no".  

             * if there are multiple values, System will fetch all values separated with comma separator.
             * system should show same sequence as per selected spot No, for Example use above table.
             * System will show values in the field in editable mode.
             * If fetched data is blank, System will show value in fields as default value "NA"  

          3. System will not fetch "Repair No." and its user specific field.  

          4. For "Date" field,
             * System will fetch Maximum Inspection date and User should be able to view Calendar button to change/edit date. 
             * Functionality will remain same.
        * **If user change " ****Type of Defect, Stage Code, Spot No ",****  system will reset all next fields values and update again will ****fetched****  data.**
    * Need to change table under the Seam detail section if user select **Not applicable.**  

      * User should be able to view Seam Details session with table column "Seam" and merged single column  

      * Seam | stage | defect | spot | length | depth | Repair  | date   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
CW103 - single select dropdown |  user specific editable field (text aligned to center )   
      * Seam -Single select dropdown field  

      * merged field of all remaining column- User specific editable field alignment to center as shown in above table.  

      * **Mandatory to add a single seam for Not applicable.**
        * User should be able to view "Add Seam" button shown as per visuals,
          * Upon clicking "Add Seam" button,
            * System should add a new blank row in the grid.  
  
  



> **While Print,  **System should show  **table of Seam detail section as shown below - **
    * For **Applicable  **Seam Details print,
      * Change column as per below table and show same seam no in merged row as shown below table.
      * Seam | defect | length | depth | spot | Repair  | date   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
CW103 | Slag | 50,60,80 | 20,20,31 | 1-2,3-4,5-6 | user field | fetch   
Crack | 51,61,81 | 20,21,32 | 1-2,3-4,5-7 | user field | fetch   
  
  

    * For**  Not- Applicable** seam Details print,
      * Seam | defect | length | depth | spot | Repair  | date   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
CW103 | User specific editable field (text aligned to center)  
CW105 | User specific editable field (text aligned to center)  


**2\. User should be able to view "Submit" button directly in action column of** Approved **status row in  ****Maintain****  SWRP page shown as per visual,**  

  * Functionalities need to remain same with changed filter data as per selection option.
  * In pop up, 
    * User should be able to view and Single select radio button with the statics option, 
      * PMG/Design 
      * QC/Shop 
      * System should able only the below field after selection of one of the radio button
    * User should be able to view "Share With" field with "CC fields" [SWRP (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/2d744139-38b5-464f-bc44-a4423c2daadc-7827/)  

      * Format - "PSNO-Employee's name"  

      * User should be able to enter and select from multiselect dropdown menu with predictive search functionality.  

      * In dropdown menu behave as per selection of radio button for both "Share With" field with "CC fields,  

        * PMG/Design - PMG/Design/Welding department employee should be shown in dropdown.  

        * QC/Shop - QC/Shop/Welding department employee should be shown in dropdown.  

      * System will allow to repeat the above flow again,
        *  After revising, user can submit again new revised SWRP to PMG/Design and QC/Shop
    * Upon clicking "Submit" button,  

      * System should send mail to the selected user in "Share With" field and CC field.
        * System should add "CC" field selected person in "CC" option of mail (carbon copy) while sending the mail.
        * System should show message - Sent to PMG/Design
          * Only if User select PMG/Design option.
        * System should show message - sent to QC/Shop
          * Only if User select QC/Shop option.
        * Upon clicking "Cancel" button,  

          * System should close "Submit Confirmation" popup window.  



  

**3\. Display Session required to  ****Changes as per user logins,**
  * Display session in mega menu can view only to these departments and as per login page functionality and data will be filter. 
    * **PMG**
    * **Design**
    * **QC**
    * **Shop**
    * **Welding department  
**
  * User can view only Approved SWRP records in Display SWRP session,
    * System will not show other than approved status records. 
  * **Flow 1  ****Login person Welding  ****Department -**  User should be able to view "Customer feedback", "Preview", Print, Timeline, History, AI reviewed copy buttons.
    * System should not show **" Add customer feedback"** button.  

    * User can view all approved records.  
  

  * ********Flow 2  **Login person **QC/Shop - User should be able to view "Preview", Print, Timeline, History, AI reviewed copy buttons.
    * System should not show "**Add customer feedback " **button.
    * User can view only records which submitted to QC/Shop from Maintain SWRP page.
  

  * **Flow 3  **Login person PMG/Design  **- User should be able to view **" Add Customer feedback", **"Customer feedback", "Preview", Print, Timeline and History buttons.**
    * System should not show "AI reviewed copy" button.
    * **User can view only records which submitted to PMG/Design from Maintain SWRP page.**
    * **Any PMG/Design department can add customer feedback.  
  
**
  * All other page functionalities and its button functionalities will remain same as per Display SWRP US - [#14635](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/14635)

## US-17023 — Through Capture Fetching data

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-17023 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Rajeshwari Ariappan |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 2 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/17023) |

### Description

As a PROD3, MFG3 User, I want to upload handwritten protocol data so that system will automatically read the form by performing OCR and filled all required fields which previously I was filling manually in IEMQS.

### Acceptance Criteria

**Pre-requisite:**  

  * User should be able to logged in the system.


**Navigation-  **
  1. As a PROD3 and MFG3 users->In Process Inspection\--->Offer/Re-Offer Inspection-Seam---->Index Page---->Action button column--->"**View Protocol Detail** " icon--->Respective form Page---->"Capture Protocol" button 
     1. \---->
     2. Index Page icon link - [SeamList Inspection :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/IPI/MaintainSeamListOfferInspection/Index#Pending)
  2. As a PROD3 and MFG3 users-\-->In Process Inspection\--->Offer/Re-Offer Inspection-Seam---->Index Page---->Action button column--->"**View Detail** " icon--->Detail Page---->Under "Protocol" Section---->"Click to Open" button--->Respective form Page--->"Capture Protocol" button 
     1. \----->\---->
     2. Detail Page icon link -[Seam List Offer Inspection :: IEMQS (lthed.com)](https://vhziemqsstg1.lthed.com/IPI/MaintainSeamListOfferInspection/SeamListOfferInspection/4897082?from=offer)


**Functional -**  

  1. User should be able to view ****"**Capture Protocol** " button in the given formats of "Protocol detail" page as shown as per visual, [Flow 6 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/6a4a6757-648c-4d21-b0c3-47521f501844-3f19/screen/18592d92-5888-4dce-b931-78ede15a6958)  

     * if User click the "Capture Protocol" from Desktop/Laptop or different devices other than Tablet
        * System will show "Device Not Compatible" error Pop-up window with "Ok" button,
          * Message in pop-up window -"Capture Protocol option is only available in Tablets device."
          * Upon Clicikng Ok button,
            * System should close the "Device Not Compatible" error Pop-up window.
  2. Upon clicking on ****"**Capture Protocol** " button,
     * System will open the Back camera initially in full page with "**Capture** " button, "**Flashlight** " button, "**Back** " button and "**Reverse Camera** " button shown as per visuals,
       * Upon clicking "**Flashlight** " button,
         * System will on/off the flashlight if available and shown relative icons shown as per visuals 
       * Upon clicking "**Reverse Camera " **button 
         * System will reverse the camera and open the front or back camera as per sequences. 
        * Upon clicking on **Capture** button,
          * System will capture single photo and will not degrade or upgrade the photo resolution and quality of images.
          * After capturing will show the captured images with "**Keep  Image" **and "**Retake " **options shown as per visuals,
          * Upon clicking "**Retake " **option,  

            * System will delete respective capture image and revert back to previous screen and open camera to capture photo again.
          * Upon clicking "**K****eep Image " **option,  

            * System will save the photo and shown to the user as shown as per visuals.
            * System will open the camera again to capture another photo.
            * System should show "**Submit " **button after capturing single image and show also the count in the bracket as shown as per visuals.
            * Example- if user capture 4 photos it should show Submit (4) 
          * After capturing Single/multiple photos, User can view those photos by clicking on it or sliding the images left or right to select
            * User can switch images by sliding the images left or right or after opening it also slide images left to right, 
          * After selecting or clicking on the selected image,
            * System will open the photos as shown as per visuals **(Prototype Page 7)**
              * User can View "**Retake ", "Delete" **and "**Done " **options for selected image as shown as per visuals,
                * Upon clicking "**Retake " **option,
                  * System will delete respective capture image and revert back to previous screen and open camera to capture photo again.
                * Upon clicking "**Delete " **option,
                  * For more than one images, System will show Delete option.
                  * System will delete the capture image and revert back to previous image.
                    * For single images Delete option will not requires as Retake option is there and will open camera to capture photo again.
                * Upon clicking "**Done " **option,
                  * System will revert back to previous screen and open camera to capture photo again.
        * Upon Clicking "**Submit** " button,  

          * System should show the pop-up "**Confirmation** " window with "**Yes " **and "**No " **buttons,
            * Message in Pop-up confirmation - Submitting this will replace the existing input values entered in protocol, Are you sure you want to continue ?"
            * Upon Clicking "**Yes ",**
              * System will show Data extraction in progress screen as shown as per visuals, 
              * After completion of Data extraction system will show message - "Protocol details Captured Successfully" as shown as per visuals. 
              * System will show error response - If there is no data fetch through NLP.  

                * **Error message - " " (Please add appropriate technical massage so user will take necessary action)**
            * Upon Clicking of "No" button, 
              * System should close pop-up "Confirmation" window.  
  

  3. If User want to repeat the process by clicking the Capture protocol, [Flow 6 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/6a4a6757-648c-4d21-b0c3-47521f501844-3f19/screen/18592d92-5888-4dce-b931-78ede15a6958)
     * User can repeat the process by clicking on the "**Capture Protocol "**button.
       * Process will remain same 
       * System will not show previously captured images in the pop-up window. 
       * User can capture images again,
         * System will show successful message every time - "Protocol details Captured Successfully"
       * System will first reset the whole page by clearing all the fields and then filled new data as per new captured images in their respective position.  
  
  

       * ~~OR System will only update/change/delete data of the Tables only for which data fetched from NLP. ~~
         * ~~All other fields data will remain same~~
         * ~~For example, if user uploaded single photo of table B only~~
           * ~~System will only update data of that table and all other tables fields data will remain same.~~
           * ~~System will reset the data of whole table B and update with newly fetched data  **(whole table not fields)**~~



****Usability:******  

  * The design should be compatible with only Tablets chrome browsers.
  * Capture images and open camera through Desktop/Laptop is Not Applicable/ Not Under the scope.

## US-17065 — (US 8-2) TC Review -Mechanical Properties -2

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-17065 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | komal.ranaware |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\NLP Team |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 15 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/17065) |

### Description

As a WE2/WE3 user, I want to view the comparative analysis data for Mechanical Properties, so that I can view for any discrepancies and act on it.

### Acceptance Criteria

## Prerequisites -  

## 
## 
## 
  * Users should be logged in.
  * User should have uploaded the certificate and the data scanned and extraction analysis has been done on the same.
  * User should be shown only relevant Grid as per uploaded TC.
  * System should automatically fetched data from WBMS and uploaded Test certificate.  



### Functional -
continuous of US [#10212](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/10212) 
  

For "**MECHANICAL PROPERTIES** " Grid-
  * **FOR PWHT Condition**  

  * **Flow 1 and Flow 2 covered previously for PWHT condition.**  

  * **Flow 3**  \- For all Test Details, if respective PWHT Condition is "MIN, MAX",  

    1. System will add two rows in the one for "MIN" and one for "MAX" in the grid.  

  * For above flow Format   

    1. MIN - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS), Example - MIN - 705+/-10 ℃ / 8 Hr,   

    2. MAX - PWHT SOAKING TEMP UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS) / SOAKING TIME FOR MIN UNIT (to be fetched from WBMS), Example - MAX - 705+/-10 ℃ / 34 Hr,   

       *   
  
  


**For UTS/YS Acceptance Value (WBMS**) –   

  * Mechanical properties | UTS (MPa, RT) | UltimateTensileStreng_Accep: "NA/Blank",   
---|---|---  
Mechanical properties | YS (MPa, RT) | YieldStrengh_Accep: "NA/Blank",   
  * If Acceptance value is Blank or not available, System will consider Acceptance value **Min automatically**.  

    * When single Value is Min. If, enter/fetched value is greater than required minimum value.
      * System should consider this matched and show "Green" color in fields shown as per visuals.
        * for example - required as per WBMS is >=100, Actual value from TC is 122, then system should show consider this matched and show in Green Color.
      * If enter/fetched value is less than required minimum value, consider this mismatched and show "Red" color in fields shown as per visuals.
        * Example - required as per WBMS is >=100, Actual value from TC is 99, then system should show consider this Mismatched and show in Red Color.


Usability:  

The design should be compatible with Laptop, Tablets (iPad and Android) chrome browsers.

  * **When  **the ERERNumber is generated, marketing team may make certain modifications (based on the Business requirements) in the enquiry data and Saves the changes in CRM.

## US-17242 — Annexure \| RCA - CA

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-17242 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/17242) |

### Description

As a IEMQS user, I want to view all the RCA and the corresponding CA for the reports, for which they are present, so that I can quickly review it

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. In the reports web page below the signature, there will be an additional page for which user needs to scroll down 
  2. The main heading will be ANNEXURE - ROOT CAUSE & CORRECTIVE ACTION - <DPP NAME> 
  3. A table should be made as per below format:   
  

  4. The frequency columns will contain values from the Month column "Frequency" shall be "Report Frequency". For eg, if the DPP report is quarterly, then in the Frequency, it should come as Jan-March and likewise
  5. The Root cause and corrective action should be fetched and shown accordingly which are maintained in the Maintain DPP screen. 
  6. In case of quarterly/yearly/half yearly monitored DPP, root cause and corrective action of all months shall be shown in separate row against same quarter/half year/year
  7. This annexure will be shown in the report page for Maintain DPP and Approved DPP session, user will scroll down to see the Annexure 
  8. In the printout also, this annexure should be present along with the report in next pages 
     1. In case of annexure, in the footer, right side, page number should come in the format, Page 1 of 2, Page 2 of 2 and like wise 
  9. The Root Cause(RC) and Corrective Action(CA) should be shown as follows: 
     1. Please note that, when the DPP is monthly to monthly, then in this case, the RC and CA should be displayed while checking the character counts, if it is more than one line item, then annexure should be made
     2. If the DPP is monthly to quarter, then always the RCA and CA should be shown in Annexure
  10. Also, if Annexure is coming, then below the report, in the RCA and CA, a placeholder text should come "Please refer Annexure for Root Cause" in Root Cause and "Please refer Annexure for Corrective Action" in Corrective Action.

Logic: 
  * Edited by and Edited On field shall be updated while "Create SIN" from approved DIS 
  * Add new "DocumentStatus" column in SIN document list. Value shall be as per below: 
    * If any change in EditedOn column of SIN documents, then Document Status shall be "Revised"
    * if add new document. then Document Status shall be "Added"
    * if no change with previous SIN, then Document Status shall be "\-->"
  * Add new column in SIN report for display "Document Status".

2) new documents shall be added last in the list of documents.

  * **When  **the IIoT user calls Integration API with Input parameters

### Acceptance Criteria

**Perquisite:** US#17682 
  

**Functional:**
**
  1. If a user wants to add a new record, then the user can do so by clicking on the "Add New" button 
  2. Clicking on the "Add New" button should add a new line item in the grid at the top as per visual: [Flow 2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/67c87a39-350a-4c79-9af5-d2f778cc401f-329b/screen/e6b39b21-1bc7-403e-9c19-c5edfe9d0643)
  3. The validations will be as below 
     1. Production Center: Search and select. single selection allowed 
        1. Refer DB for fetching values:
     2. Stage Code: Search and select. single selection allowed 
        1. Refer DB for fetching values:
     3. Repair Cost (INR): User Input. No decimal allowed. Value range- from y or x till xxxxx digits (Please note that the value of y can be 0 and value of x can range from 0-9) 
     4. No. of Man Hours: User Input. No decimal allowed. Value range- from y or x till xx digits (Please note that the value of y can be 0 and value of x can range from 0-9)
     5. Opportunity Cost: User Input. No decimal allowed. Value range- from y or x till xxxxx digits (Please note that the value of y can be 0 and value of x can range from 0-9)
  4. Once the user enters all the above-mentioned values, then the Save button (green tick) should get activated. 
     1. Clicking on save will show a success toast message as per visual and a new line item will get populated in the grid as well as DB 
     2. Once the line items is saved, then the "Updated By" and "Updated On" should be updated as per logged in user details and the current date  

     3. Also, once a line item is saved, then beside that line item, two action buttons should be visible. 
        1. Edit: Clicking on it will make the selected line item editable, in which the user can modify the details and again click on the save button. Please note that in this case, the "Updated By" and "Updated On" will also get updated accordingly 
        2. Delete: Clicking in this will open a confirmation popup as per visual ([Flow 2 (adobe.com)](https://xd.adobe.com/view/67c87a39-350a-4c79-9af5-d2f778cc401f-329b/screen/65f38a78-8d70-4901-b10c-43cfce9ec849)), and confirming the same will show a success toast message and delete the selected line item. (Please note that it will be a hard delete and from DB as well the data should ger removed) 
  5. If a user wants to delete the line before saving it, then the user can click on the red X button 
  6. The gird should have pagination functionality as per visual

## US-17714 — Production - Dashboard to be made in I-Rudra that shows Total seams/Before-After PWHT/Hydro/ Pending or approved seam count.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-17714 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/17714) |

### Description

Telerik Chart URL:  <https://demos.telerik.com/aspnet-core/bar-charts/stacked-bar> 
                
  * <https://vhzdigiiemqsqa1.lthed.com:447/IPI/MaintainSeamListOfferInspection/Index> 


  

  

  

 
  * Require Section/Assembly selection option, so user can filter data. Default all option will select and data will populate based on selection. 
  * Display count on bar. 


 
  1. By default, two chart shall be displayed as per selection of Project and Assembly. 
     1. Milestone Chart 
     2. Inspection Status Chart 
  2. Clicking upon any horizontal bar of Milestone Chart, “Inspection Status Chart” shall be refreshed and displayed based on selection of Project, Assembly and Milestone.  
  3. Clicking upon any horizontal bar of Inspection Status Chart, system will open respective tab as per selection area(Color) 
     1. If clicking upon Red (Rejected) color bar, system will open respective tab based on stage type 
        1. If stage type belongs to QC, then “Re-Offer” tab will appear with selected filters. 
        2. If stage type belongs to NDE, then “Regenerate Request” tab will appear with selected filters. 
     2. If clicking upon Pink (Returned) color bar, system will open respective tab based on stage type 
        1. If stage type belongs to QC, then “Re-Offer” tab will appear with selected filters. 
        2. If stage type belongs to NDE, then “Return NDE Request” tab will appear with selected filters. 
     3. If clicking upon Yellow (Ready to Offer) color bar, then “Offer” tab will appear with selected filters. 
     4. If clicking upon Green (Cleared), Orange (Under Inspection) and Balance (Gray) color bar, then “All” tab will appear with selected filters. 


 
 
                
 
**Chart1:  **
<div class="demo-section wide"> 
    @(Html.Kendo().Chart() 
        .Name("chart") 
        .Title("") 
        .Legend(legend => legend 
            .Position(ChartLegendPosition.Right) 
        ) 
        .SeriesDefaults(seriesDefaults => 
            seriesDefaults.Bar().Stack(true) 
        ) 
        .Series(series => { 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 900, 200, 0 }).Name("Cleared").Color("#AED581"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 0, 200, 300 }).Name("Inprogress").Color("#FFCC80"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 0, 100, 500 }).Name("Balance").Color("#CFD8DC"); 
        }) 
        .CategoryAxis(axis => axis 
            .Categories("Before PWHT", "After PWHT", "After Hydro") 
            .MajorGridLines(lines => lines.Visible(false)) 
        ) 
        .ValueAxis(axis => axis 
            .Numeric() 
            .Labels(labels => labels.Format("{0}")) 
            .Max(500) 
            .Line(line => line.Visible(false)) 
            .MajorGridLines(lines => lines.Visible(false)) 
        ) 
        .Tooltip(tooltip => tooltip 
            .Visible(true) 
            .Template("#= series.name #: #= value #") 
        ) 
    )  
</div> 
 
 
Chart2: 
<div class="demo-section wide"> 
    @(Html.Kendo().Chart() 
        .Name("chart") 
        .Title("") 
        .Legend(legend => legend 
            .Position(ChartLegendPosition.Bottom) 
        ) 
        .SeriesDefaults(seriesDefaults => 
            seriesDefaults.Bar().Stack(true) 
        ) 
        .Series(series => { 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 500, 450, 0, 200, 500, 450, 0, 200, 0, 200  }).Name("Cleared").Color("#AED581"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 300, 50, 300, 400, 300, 50, 300, 400, 100, 20 }).Name("Under Inspection").Color("#FFCC80"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 0, 0, 10, 25, 25, 60, 0, 0, 70, 50 }).Name("Returned").Color("#F8BBD0"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 0, 0, 0, 15, 0, 60, 100, 50, 70, 50}).Name("Rejected").Color("#E57373"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 200, 500, 500, 100, 200, 500, 500, 100, 50, 70 }).Name("Ready to Offer").Color("#ffff9d"); 
            series.Bar(new double[] { 200, 500, 500, 100, 200, 500, 500, 100, 50, 75 }).Name("Balance").Color("#CFD8DC"); 
        }) 
        .CategoryAxis(axis => axis 
            .Categories("Setup", "Weld Visual", "Ferrite", "Checmical", "PMI", "Hardness", "PT", "MT", "RT", "UT") 
            .MajorGridLines(lines => lines.Visible(false)) 
        ) 
        .ValueAxis(axis => axis 
            .Numeric() 
            .Labels(labels => labels.Format("{0}")) 
            .Max(1000) 
            .Line(line => line.Visible(false)) 
            .MajorGridLines(lines => lines.Visible(false)) 
        ) 
        .Tooltip(tooltip => tooltip 
            .Visible(true) 
            .Template("#= series.name #: #= value #") 
        ) 
    )  
</div>

### Description

As a UKG user, I want to access only the active projects and their associated tasks from Concerto on a daily basis, based on specific date range provided in the input.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * UKG application will call integration API 'getProjectPlanningData'. 
  * Input Parameters: StartDate,EndDate 
  * Output parameters: Location,BusinessUnit,ProductionCenter,TaskManager/Taskparticipant,ProjectID,ProjectNumber,NA,TaskUID,TaskDesc,SubTaskUID,SubTaskDesc,Job,StartDate,EndDate,EffectiveDate_Project,ExpirationDate_Project,EffectiveDate_Task,ExpirationDate_Task,EffectiveDate_Subtask,ExpirationDate_Subtask 


**_Search combination:_**
  * StartDate,EndDate is Mandatory 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the UKG user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API is expected to connect to Concerto database.
  * **Then**** ** based on the shared query parameter StartDate,EndDate associated Location,BusinessUnit,ProductionCenter,TaskManager/Taskparticipant,ProjectID,ProjectNumber,NA,TaskUID,TaskDesc,SubTaskUID,SubTaskDesc,Job,StartDate,EndDate,EffectiveDate_Project,ExpirationDate_Project,EffectiveDate_Task,ExpirationDate_Task,EffectiveDate_Subtask,ExpirationDate_Subtask Concerto database and to be shared with UKG
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if not data is available at Concerto database, suitable error message will be given to UKG user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's

NA

NA

  * API Contract is applied

_**
  

  * VYN application will hit integration API  **createPermanentEmployee   **on need basis approx. 6PM

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **Given:  ** As a VYN user, Employee details are created at VYN application** **  

  * **Then**** ** VYN applciation will hit Integration API
  * **Then  **Integration API will utilize PSNumber as unique identifier; upon submission from VYN, integration API will search for matching PSNumber in ERPLN database.
  * **If** a matching PSNumber is found:

  * **If** a no matching PSNumber is found:

### Description

RCA redirection in case of NCR/CFAR

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  

For creation of RCA in case of category is NCR and CFAR, below logic needs to be implemented: 
  1. Once the user comes to the MVC page of "CAPA submission" and clicks on "Maintain RCA" button, 
     1. User creates RCA in angular screen and save the record. When the user again visits the MVC page, then he should be able to see the RCA page linked with NCR/CFAR. 
     2. If the user again the clicks on the "Maintain RCA" button, and the RCA is "In-progress" status in Angular screen, then the user should be redirected to the same RCA page (Duplicate entry should not happen) 
  2. When user clicks on "Maintain RCA" on MVC page system shall open RCA angular page in new tab.

## US-18023 — CR: TPE Dates Display

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18023 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 19 |
| Tags | CR |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18023) |

### Description

TPE Dates

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  1. Once the certificate of a user is generated for the first time, then in the "Certification" Tab, under the "Certification Status" section, the logic for desplaying the TPE related data needs to be as per below logic 
     1. If the certificate validity is selected for 3 years, then three columns viz TPE1, TPE2, TPE3 should be displayed. Similarly, if the certification if selected for 5 years, then five columns will be displayed viz: TPE1,TPE2, TPE3, TPE4, TPE5
     2. When the certificate is freshly generated for the first time, then for TPE1 in the Date Row, "-" will come and in the Due Date, the Date TPE1 due date needs to be displayed (The logic for TPE1 date will be one year from the date of certification generation minus 1 day). Please note that in this scenario all other TPE column values will remain blank. Also, the same will also be displayed in the PDF generated for Certificate 
     3. Now, when the user upload TPE1 certificate next year by going to the "Technical Performance Evaluation" tab, then while uploading certificate, The "TPE Date" which the user selects, should be appended in the "TPE1"column's "Date" Row. And the "TPE Due Date" which is selected/entered by the user the same should be displayed in the "TPE2" columns "Due Date" row. Here the "Date" value for "TPE2" will remain as "-". This same logic will be carry forwarded. 


Note: ​Refer Attached doc for logic

## US-18026 — CR: Certificate Format

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18026 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | nithish.yenugu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\Common-Feature Team 1 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 19 |
| Tags | CR |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18026) |

### Description

Certificate Format: User Feedback

### Acceptance Criteria

Functional: 
  

In the certificate format below modification needs to be made: 
  1. The header of the first page should also come in the second page:  
Reference Image:  
  

  2. In the certificate number follow the nomenclature as: <LocationAcronym>/NDE/<DiscliplineMethod>/<YearInYYYY Format>. Here the values inside <> are dynamic. Eg, if Location is Ranoli, Disclipline/Methd is RT and Year of certificate generation in 2023, then the format will be RNW/NDE/RT/2023 
  3. In the field named "Experience Before Joining L&T", if the value for years is more than 1, then use the plural form "years" and when the value of year is 1, then user singular form "year". For eg, if a user has 1.3 years of experience, then we need the value to be "1 year and 3 months", similarly, if users experience is 2.5 years, then the value shown should be "2 years and 5 months"
     1. Also, is a user has less then 12 months of experience, then we should not show "year" in the value (like 0 year). It should only show month value (This will be applicable for "Experience before joining L&T" and "Experience in L&T")  
Reference Image:  
  

  4. In the below text after SNT-TC-1A, a space will come and then the value user has entered in Edition while generating certificate needs to be appended. Refer [#18092](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/18092)   
Reference Image:  

  5. In the pages, add page number in footer on the right side corner, as per format "Page <Page No> of <No of Pages>".e.g. If there are 2 pages, then first page will have Page 1 of 2, and second page will have Page 2 of 2. 
  6. Format for Authorized signature should be followed as below:  
  

  7. If a user has selected "Discipline/Method" as "PT" or "MT" while onboarding, then after "Test Method" in the certificate format, in the next line a new label named "Technique" needs to be shown, and the values user has selected from the "Technique" dropdown (Refer [#18092](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/18092) ) needs to be appended. If a user has selected, more than one values from that dropdown, then the values needs to be shown comma separated. 
  8. Please note that for test methods other than "PT", "MT", "Technique" row will not be added in the report.
  9.   

  10. In the "Test Method" row in the Certifcate, after "LEVEL: X", a space will come and below hardcoded value need to be mentioned
     1. **_SECTOR:_** _MANUFACTURING_
  11. Below "Test Method" a new row need to be generated, with label name as "Product Form" and the value needs to be shown as per user selection from "Certificate generation" session (Refer US [#18092](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_workitems/edit/18092) ). For "PT" & "MT" method "Product Form" row will appear after "Technique". 
  12. Remove the below row named "Written Examination" and move the content accordingly

      * system will not perform any action, just close the confirmation popup.

### Description

As a developer, I want load data from concerto,EMS,DFS,ERPLN for Actual load and NTP load for project planning and firm forecasting

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * Mendix application will call integration API 'getWorkForceLoad'. 
  * Input Parameters: productioncentername, status : <<project status>>, <<enquiry_status>>(Optional) 
  * Output  Production center   
---  
ProjectNumber   
status   
Equipment Name   
CustomerName   
Mktg Group   
orderBookingDate   
contractualDeliveryDate   
prjectedDeliveryDate   
TotalEstimatedHours   
bookedHour   
month-year wise Distributed data   
month-year wise Distributed data.Project   
month-year wise Distributed data.Name   
month-year wise Distributed data.RespectiveResourcesUnit   
month-year wise Distributed data.startDate   
month-year wise Distributed data.endDate   
Duration   
durationWithBuffer   
Task Status   
FirmForecastDetails   
FirmForecast.ERERNumber   
FirmForecast.Forecast   
FirmForecast.status   
FirmForecast. EnquiryTitle   
FirmForecast. EquipmentName   
FirmForecast.CustomerName   
FirmForecast.OBD   
FirmForecast.CDD   
FirmForecast.Mktg Group   
FirmForecast.PBU (Production Business Unit)   
FirmForecast.Probaility   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.ProductionCentre   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.AlternateExecutionCentre   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.Quantity   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.ManufacturingStartDate   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.PDD   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.HourRemaining(or MandaysRemaining)   
FirmForecast.Equipment Name.AlternateProductionCentreHoursRemaining   
  



**_Search combination:_**
  * Productioncenter is Mandatory 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the Load Vs Capacity user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API is expected to connect to ERPLN, EMS, DFS and concerto database.
  * **Then**** ** based on the shared query parameter productioncentername,startdateinDD-MM-YYYY, enddateinDD-MM-YYYY, ProjectStatus associated output parameters to be fetched from oncerto,EMS,DFS,ERPLN databases and to be shared with Load Vs Capacity
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if not data is available at Concerto database, suitable error message will be given to Load vs Capacity user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied

NA

### Description

As a FMS user, I want to view cash inflow invoice details for the financial year from ERPLN application.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical requirements:_**  
_**
  

  * FMS application will hit integration API to fetch these data on need basis. 


**_Input, Output Parameters and Search combination:_**
  *  All the input parameters :  StatDate,EndDate  as **mandatory**
  * All the output  parameters: ExpectedPaymentReceiptDate,ActualMSCompletionDate,InvoiceAmount,ExpectedMsCompletionDate,ContractNumber,AssignedAmount
  * If there is any miss in any parameter an appropriate error message will be displayed. 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **Given  **the mandatory input parameters like: 'StartDate, EndDate' from FMS application.  

  * **Then  **Integration **getCashInflowInvoice** API will call ERPLN application to fetch the information details related to cash inflow Invoice
  * **Then  **the retrieved information will be shared to FMS on batches upto 300 records until the field value "MoreRecordExists" is set to 'NO' by integration API.

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day

Ref Image: 
     1. Export Options in PDF and Word Formats: 
     2. Steps: 
        1. Click on Export Button will open a popup with two radio buttons named PDF and Word
        2. User will select one of the options to export   
file into specific format and the relevant format file should get downloaded in the system  

        3. If the record is approved, then on clicking of Export to PDF option, system should download the merged file (SWRP Doc and Annexure's if any)
        4. If the record is yet to be approved, then on clicking of Export to PDF option, system should download the SWRP Doc only
        5. Please note that the same functionality will also happen on click of Print button from the Index Page line item
        6. Export option should be available in all status of SWRP document.  
Ref Image  
  

  2. Merger
     1. In the Approve SWRP session  
Ref Image:  
  

     2. On click of Approve Button, system should merge SWRP and WE3 uploaded annexure
        1. Here firstly the SWRP doc will come followed by Annexure documents 
        2. The merged (binder) file will be in PDF. Please note that the Annexure documents in PDF format will only be considered for Merger
        3. This file need to be saved on server


Note: In the merged file, pagination will not be possible
  

3\. In the Maintain SWRP session, on clicking of Submit button, system should send the Merged SWRP document (binder), to their inbox (Display SWRP session). When the user click on the Print Button from index or detail page of the Display SWRP session, the merged file should be downloaded.

  * **When**  UKG will call Integration API getWeldersPerformanceDetails

## US-18343 — getWelderDetails

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18343 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IOT |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 14 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18343) |

### Description

As a IIoT user, I want welder details like welder ID, name and welder stamp number for Permanent and contract employees from IEMQS application.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * IIoT application will call integration API 'getWelderDetails'. 
  * Input Parameters: PSNumber[],starDate 
  * Output parameters: welderPSNo,Name,WelderStamp 


**_Search combination:_**
  * Either PSNumber[] or StartDate (anyone is mandatory) 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the IIoT user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API is expected to connect to IEMQS database.
  * **Then**** ** based on the shared query parameter PSNumber / StartDate, from startDate with respect to permanent / contract employees, integration API will connect to required database and table, will determine endDate by applying SQL 'currentDate' logic.
  * **Then** API retrieves welderPSnumber, name and stamp number of the employees filtered by input start date.
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if not data is available at IEMQS database, suitable error message will be given to IIoT user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

## US-18623 — Retrieving Active Project and Seam list items from IIoT \|\| getActiveWDSProjectSeamList

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18623 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IOT |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18623) |

### Description

As an IEMQS user, I want to see real time welding parameter of Project and Seam, which are active for last 48 hours.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * IEMQS application will call integration API 'getActiveWDSProjectSeamList'. 
  * Input Parameters: StartDate, EndDate 
  * Output parameters: assetCode,lastReportedOn,projectNumber,seamNumber 


**_Search combination:_**
  * All input parameters are mandatory 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the IEMQS user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API will in turn call 'getWDSActiveProjectSeamDetails ' an IIoT API  along with the input parameters 
  * **Then**** ** IIoT API will send an response for the shared query, the same received response will be shared with IEMQS application.
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if there are no inputs then a suitable error message will be given to IEMQS user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * IEMQS application will call integration API 'getWDSData'. 
  * Input Parameters: ProjectNumber, SeamNumber, duration, frequency 
  * Output parameters:  assetCode,lastReportedOn,projectNumber,seamNumber,wpsno,operatorId,stampNumber,assetName,location,productionCenter,shopName,subCategory,process,operatorName,minSpeed,speed,maxSpeed,minCurrent,current,maxCurrent,minVoltage,voltage,maxVoltage,minTemp,temp,maxTemp,timestamp 


**_Search combination:_**
  * ProjectNumber, SeamNumber are mandatory 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the IEMQS user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API will in turn call 'getWDSReport' an IIoT API  along with the input parameters 
  * **Then**** ** IIoT API will send an response for the shared query, the same received response will be shared with IEMQS application.
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if there are no inputs then a suitable error message will be given to IEMQS user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:

| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18660) |

### Description

1\. The contract employees details are entered in VYN.  

2\. Integration API will be triggered.  

3\. This API will check  CLMS database for entries matching the keyed-in 'Employee Name' and 'Date of Birth' in the  'BLK_FLAG' field; If the value is 'Y', API will return 'Blacklisted', along with 'BLK_TYPE', 'BLK_FROM_DT','BLK_TO_DT'  

4\. Internal Movement; If the Contract employee is moving from one department to another, API will check 'WRKR_LIVE'; if the value is 'Y', API will return 'This Workmen currently working in L&T and his <WRKR_CODE>.   

5\. New EPN fields are added; Default values to be passed from Integration API.

## US-18722 — Seamlessly Integrate Employee Events into ERPLN \|\| createPermanentEmployeeEvents

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18722 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-WFM |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18722) |

### Description

As a  VYN user, I want to integrate permanent employees job events like probation state changes promotions, and transfers into ERPLN application. This helps in keeping track of employee progress and transitions within organization.

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical requirements:_**  
_**
  

  * VYN application will hit integration API  **createPermanentEmployeeEvents  **on need basis. 


**_Search combination:_**
  * NA 


**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **Given:  ** As a VYN user, Employee's event details are created in VYN application** **  

  * **Then**** ** VYN application will hit Integration API
  * **Then  **Integration API will utilize PSNumber as unique identifier; upon submission from VYN, integration API will search for matching PSNumber in ERPLN database.
  * **If**  a matching PSNumber is found:
    * The data shared by VYN (employeeDetails,Dept,Function,Basic,effDate,event,fromcadre,tocadre,points,TransactionDate) will be updated in ERPLN database
  * **If  **a no matching PSNumber is found: 
    * An appropriate error message will be sent to Initiator application . 


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

## US-18735 — Enhancement: Access date from Target application based on Flag values \|\| getPermanentWorkmenPunchingData

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18735 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-WFM |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 17 |
| Tags | Change Request |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18735) |

### Description

**As-Is:**  

As a UKG user, I want to access Permanent workmen's punching details like IN and OUT for respective date and time from TRT (solus) on a daily basis, based on specific date range provided in the input.  

  

**To-Be:**
As a UKG user, I want to access Permanent workmen's punching details like IN and OUT for respective date and time from TRT,**Infocomm** on a daily basis, based on specific date range provided in the input.
  

There is an inclusion of Input query parameter 'CardPunchInFlag'; 
This API will fetch required data based on the 'cardPunchInFlag' staus; If  "Yes" data would be retrieved from "TRT" . If 'No'  "Yes" data would be retrieved from Infocomm

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * UKG application will call integration API 'getPermanentWorkmenPunchingData'. 
  * Input Parameters: StartDate,EndDate,CardPunchInFlag
  * Output parameters: psnumber,punchDateTime,punchtype 


**_Search combination:_**
  * StartDate,EndDate is Mandatory 
  *  CardPunchInFlag is optional  



  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the UKG user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API is expected to connect to TRT, Infocomm database.
  * **Then**** ** based on the shared query parameter StartDate,EndDate & CardPunchInFlag:
    *  If "CardPunchInFlag" flag value is "Yes" data would be retrieved from "TRT" else from Infocomm  

  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if not data is available at Concerto database, suitable error message will be given to UKG user.  



Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:

## US-18796 — Enhancement: getWDSData

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18796 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IOT |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 18 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18796) |

### Description

As an IEMQS user, I want to see real time welding parameters like Temperature, Current, voltage, speed, etc for a particular Project and Seam, which are active for last 48 hours.  

  

Below are the Enhancement details:  

1\. Field 'OperatorName' & 'StampNumber'; to be In the Welding parameters section (line Items)  

2\. New fields are added; Field name: 'balanceDepth' & 'ArcingFlag'(if its On/Off)         
3\. The Seams to be shown, should be the ones on which welding is started. The seams on which welding is never started in IIOT should not be shown  

4\. Values for Balance depth to be shown, also null to be passed if values are not avaibale currently in the system  

5\. Data to be fethced fro intervals: 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour and 2 hour  

6\. Need WPS No in API for fetching Current Type

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * IEMQS application will call integration API 'getWDSData'. 
  * Input Parameters: ProjectNumber, SeamNumber, duration, frequency 
  * Output parameters:  assetCode,lastReportedOn,projectNumber,seamNumber,wpsno,operatorId,stampNumber,assetName,location,productionCenter,shopName,subCategory,process,operatorName,minSpeed,speed,maxSpeed,minCurrent,current,maxCurrent,minVoltage,voltage,maxVoltage,minTemp,temp,maxTemp,timestamp 


**_Search combination:_**
  * ProjectNumber, SeamNumber are mandatory 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the IEMQS user calls Integration API with Input parameters
  * **Then**** ** Integration API will in turn call 'getWDSReport' an IIoT API  along with the input parameters 
  * **Then**** ** IIoT API will send an response for the shared query, the same received response will be shared with IEMQS application.
  * **Then  **if there are any wrong inputs or if there are no inputs then a suitable error message will be given to IEMQS user.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA

NA

  * API Contract is applied

## US-18889 — getTokenMetadata

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-18889 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Gautam.Mandal |
| Area Path | Data Integration\Int-IOT |
| Iteration Path | Data Integration\Sprint 19 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/18889) |

### Description

As a IIoT user I Need Project, Seam and other WPS related details from Active Token whenever there is call from IIoT application for the given PSNumber,TokenNumber,createdOn,EU

### Acceptance Criteria

**_**_Technical Details:_**_**  

  

  * IIoT application will be calling integration API 'getTokenMetadata'. 


**_Search combination:_**
  * Input parameters: psNumber,TokenNumber,createdOn,EU 
  * Mandatory : psNumber,TokenNumber,createdOn 
  * Output:{Project Number, Seam Number, Welding Process, Welder Stamp, Welder Name, BU, WPS No, Joint type, Layer, AWS, Size, Flux, Machine Number } 


  

**_**_Functional requirements:  
_**_**
  * **When  **the IIoT user calls Integration API, it will connect with IEMQS database
  * **Then**** ** Integration API, will look for {Project Number, Seam Number, Welding Process, Welder Stamp, Welder Name, BU, WPS No, Joint type, Layer, AWS, Size, Flux, Machine Number }  details and retrieves the data to IIoT.


Non-Functional Requirements:  

  

• Performance requirements:  

  * Once requested, data should be available within 30 seconds 
  * API should be available 24X7 
  * User may request multiple times in a day 
  * Payload size will be KB's 


  

• Compatibility requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Usability requirements:  

  

NA 
  

• Security requirements:  

  

  * API Contract is applied 


  

• Documentation requirements:  

  

• Documentation for the APIs are updated to reflect the changes accurately in Interface Specification document and Field Mapping documents.
  

• Maintenance requirements:  

  

NA

### Description

As a Security Admin, I want to manage the Color Master:

### Acceptance Criteria

User find the master name on the left-top side of the body.  

  

User click the “Search” button to find existing records.  

  

User use the “New” button to add new master records.  

  

User edit existing masters by selecting them and clicking the “Edit” button.  

  

To delete an existing master, I select the record and click the “Delete” button.  

  

Note: User remember that each day of the week corresponds to a different color, and I shouldn’t use the same color for two days."

### Description

S.NO  | Role  | Module  | Submodule  | User Stories  | Acceptance Criteria  | Remarks   
---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
1  | Viewer  |  Login  | SSO Login  
(Internal)  | As a Viewer, I should Login to the application using my Azure AD credentials  | Internal Log-In  
Viewer should be able to access the application's login page.  
  
Viewer should view "Login with Azure AD" link to log in with their Azure AD account.  
  
Viewer should be redirected to the Azure AD login page when they choose the "Login with Azure AD" option.  
  
Viewer should be able to enter their Azure AD credentials and authenticate successfully.  
  
Upon successful authentication, Viewer should be navigated to the EHS Video Portal application's home page.  
  
Note:  
  
The application will log out after 15 to 20 minutes if no action is performed or idle.  
  
On entering an incorrect username or password for 3 or more times - Account will be locked -Message “Account has been locked due to incorrect entries for 3 or more times, Contact Super Admin for further assistance to unlock the account”.  
| Upon successful authentication, Viewer should be navigated to the EHS Video Portal application's home page.  
Viewer should able to see all the relevant modules of EHS Video Portal. Example - Home, View Video.  
Viewer should be able to access the require module on clicking.  
In Home menu where Viewer can see five category (Environment, Health, Safety, TBT, Other) video, All video , last watch video, Recently Added video, Video you watched category box.  
In View Video menu where Viewer can see all video Category wise.  
Note :  
Upon entering the wrong password system will show error message.  
Message : Wrong credentials. Account will get lock after 3 entries.  
  
Query :  
  
How Viewer account will be unlock by  Viewer?   
2  | Admin  |  Login  | SSO Login  
(Internal)  | As a Admin, I should Login to the application using my Azure AD credentials  | Internal Log-In  
Admin should be able to access the application's login page.  
  
Admin should view "Login with Azure AD" link to log in with their Azure AD account.  
  
Admin  should be redirected to the Azure AD login page when they choose the "Login with Azure AD" option.  
  
Admin should be able to enter their Azure AD credentials and authenticate successfully.  
  
Upon successful authentication, Admin should be navigated to the EHS Video Portal application's home page.  
  
Note:  
  
The application will log out after 15 to 20 minutes if no action is performed or idle.  
  
On entering an incorrect username or password for 3 or more times - Account will be locked -Message “Account has been locked due to incorrect entries for 3 or more times, Contact Super Admin for further assistance to unlock the account”.  
| Upon successful authentication, Admin should be navigated to the EHS Video Portal application's home page.  
Admin should able to see all the relevant modules of EHS Video Portal Example - Home, View Video, Role Master, Category Master, Subcategory Master, Add Video.  
Admin should be able to access the require module on clicking.  
In Home menu where Admin can see and add five category (Environment, Health, Safety, TBT, Other) video, All video , last watch video, Recently Added video, Video you watched, category box.  
In View video menu where Admin can see all video of category wise.  
In Role master menu where Admin can CRUD operation on Role Master.  
In Category master menu where Admin can CRUD operation on Category Master.  
In Subcategory master menu where Admin can CRUD operation on Subcategory Master.  
In Add video master menu where Admin can CRUD operation on Category Master.  
  
Note :  
Upon entering the wrong password system will show error message.  
Message : Wrong credentials .Account will get lock after 3 entries.  
  
Query :  
  
How Admin account will be unlock by Admin?

### Description

We require to develop this type of popup where user can provide their consent for store cookie in local system.

### Acceptance Criteria

Below screenshot is the sample. Actual design will prepare on later stage. 
  1. User consent will save in database and available to view for admin user. 
  2. This popup shall be displayed on login page as our default page is login. 
  3. User shall not be able to login into system without provide cookie consent as we are creating a cookie after authenticating the user into system for store user details. 
  4. If user already provided the consent, then popup will not appear on the screen for that user. 
  5. Need to develop a new static web page where user can see/read the cookie policy which release by HEIC for IEMQS. 
  6. Also make sure all critical information of user will be stored in encrypted mode in cookie.

Ownership Id  
Ownership  | The system should prevent the entry of duplicate masters; if an attempt is made to enter a duplicate, an error message should display: "The entered master already exists. Please enter a different one."

The system should prohibit the deletion of any master data if there are existing transactions associated with that master record in the system.

Add new ownership information.  
Edit existing ownership information.  
Delete ownership information if necessary.
