## US-19530 — UI for Maintain Customer

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19530 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19530) |

### Description

Create UI for maintain Customer data for eliminate the ERP dependency. 
  

Use COM006 table for storing customer data. 
Add new field in COM006 like below 
  * CreatedFrom (NVARCHAR(50)) 


  

We require Listing/Index page for customer to see all customers. Fields to be displayed in listing page as below: 
1) Customer Code 
2) Customer Name 
3) Action (this columns have below icons to perform actions against each record). 
  * Edit (allow for CreatedFrom "IEMQS") 
  * Delete (allow only if there is not any contract(COM004) exists for that customer also CreatedFrom "IEMQS")

### Acceptance Criteria

1) Data shall be saved on COM006 table and rest of fields shall be blank or default values. 
2) Duplicate customer code shall not be allowed. 
3) Customer code shall be in capital letters only. 
4) Customer code and name both fields are mandatory. 
5) if Customer created from IEMQS, then field "CreatedFrom" shall have a value "IEMQS"
6) Only those customer allow to edit/update which are Created from IEMQS. 
7) Customer created from daily schedular via EPR shall have value in field "CreatedFrom" is "ERPLN"
8) Customer who created from ERPLN, those are not allow to edit/update in IEMQS using above screen.

## US-19532 — UI For Maintain Contract/Projects

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19532 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19532) |

### Description

Create new UI for maintain contract and project data for eliminate ERP dependency. 
  

User COM001, COM004, COM005 and COM008 table to store date. 
  

Add new field in COM004 and COM001 like below: 
  * CreatedFrom - NVARCHAR(50) 


Add new field in COM001 like below: 
  * IEMQS_Status - NVARCHAR(50) -  Default value is "Draft"


  

  

Require listing/index page for display all contracts. fields to be displayed on listing page as below:  

  * Contract No
  * Contract Description
  * Customer
  * BU
  * Location
  * Action 
    * Edit
    * Delete

### Acceptance Criteria

1) Index page action icon(Edit and Delete) shall be applicable to those contract/projects which are created from IEMQS application UI. 
2) Customer shall have selection option and need to be fetched from COM006. Only those customer will appear who created from IEMQS application UI. 
3) Contract number shall not be duplicate. 
4) Order Category shall have selection option and options are fetched from global category. 
5) Product Type shall have selection option and options are fetched from global category. 
6) Owner shall have selection option and data to be fetched from Employee master table (COM003).
7) PO date, Zero date, Warranty expiry date and Contractual Delivery date shall have date picker and non-mandatory.
8) BU shall have selection option and data to be fetched from master table (COM002) and mandatory selection.
9) Location shall have selection option and data to be fetched from master table (COM002) and mandatory selection. Default location shall be user location.
10) Company no shall be ready only and default value shall be 175 (HEIC).
11) Project No shall be unique and system will check from COM001 table.
12) Project Mansger shall have selection option and data to be fetched from Employee master table (COM003).

Create new SQL schedular for sync data on daily basis from ERP to this new db table. 
  

New table needs to be created in DES (Design System). 
  

Table Name: DES012 (Item Group Master) 
Fields: 
  1. **Id** \- INT - Primary key 
  2. **GroupName** \- NVARCHAR(50) 
  3. **GroupDescription** \- NVARCHAR(500) 
  4. **UOM** \- NVARCHAR(50) 
  5. **CPCCode** \- NVARCHAR(50) 
  6. **BuyCode** - NVARCHAR(50)
  7. **CreatedBy** \- NVARCHAR(10) 
  8. **CreatedOn** \- DATETIME 
  9. **EditedBy** \- NVARCHAR(10) 
  10. **Edited On** \- DATETIME 
  11. **CreatedFrom** \- NVARCHAR(50) 


**NOTE: Existing UI shall be used.**

### Acceptance Criteria

* Currently data is fetching from ERPLN using linked server. We require to remove connection with ERPLN and data shall be displayed from IEMQS db table only. 
  * System shall have provision to add new group in IEMQS. Whenever data entered from IEMQS then field CreatedFrom shall have value "IEMQS"
  * System shall have provision to Edit and Delete those group which will be generated from IEMQS. 
  * Data which are fetch from ERPLN shall not have any options for Edit and Delete. 
  * No Duplicate group shall be allowed.

Description  | IsTopPart  | ItemGroup  | Owner  | PartName  | PartType  | Policy  | UOM  | RelatedProjectName

S040912-EQUIPMENT  | 0  | MMFG00  |  | FLARE KNOCK OUT DRUM  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |   
S040912-CRS  | 0  | CWIP00  |  | CRS Item  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |   
S040912-DEV  | 0  | CWIP00  |  | Development Item  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |   
S040912-EXTRA  | 0  | CWIP00  |  | EXTRA Item  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |   
S040912-JIGFIX  | 0  | CMTL00  |  | JIGS and FISTURE  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |   
S040912-TEMPLATE  | 0  | MMFG00  |  | TEMPLATE  | Part  | CRR  | nos  |

S040912-SPARE  | 0  | MMFG02  |  | SPARES  | Part  | CRR  | lot  |   
S040912-SPRCM  | 0  | CWIP00  |  | Commissioning Spares  | Part  | CRR  | lot  |

  5. After generating the deliverables, system will show the inline editable listing from where user can update existing deliverable (only Description and Part Name shall be editable field) or add new deliverable.

Put new button "Issue History" for view issues against token generated from IEMQS on below page. 
<https://vhzdigiiemqsqa2.lthed.com:447/IPI/WelderPSlipCopy/ConsumableSlipDetail>  

  

  

  

System will display list of issue history from DB table **WPS027  **
  

Below sample design needs to be followed for maintain issue history for KSA project.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. New button shall be applicable for all token, but button shall be displayed after actual token generated. it will not display for Draft token. 
  2. clicking on this new button system will open popup where user can see existing issue history if already have against this token. 
  3. Add token section shall be visible for those projects which are created from IEMQS.

  11. Issue date shall have default date of Today, user can change if require. 
  12. Issue by have PS number of logged in user, user can change if require.

## US-19722 — UI for Maintain Vendor

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19722 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19722) |

### Description

Create UI for maintain Vendor data for eliminate the ERP dependency. 
  

Use **COM006** table for storing vendor data. 
Mantain **t_bprl** field "3" for Vendor 
  

We require Listing/Index page for user to see all vendors. Fields to be displayed in listing page as below: 
1) Vendor Code 
2) Vendor Name 
3) Action (this columns have below icons to perform actions against each record). 
  * Edit (allow for CreatedFrom "IEMQS") 
  * Delete (allow only if field CreatedFrom is "IEMQS")

### Acceptance Criteria

1) Data shall be saved on COM006 table and rest of fields shall be blank or default values. 
2) Duplicate vendor code shall not be allowed. 
3) Vendor code shall be in capital letters only. 
4) Vendor code and name both fields are mandatory. 
5) if Vendor created from IEMQS, then field "CreatedFrom" shall have a value "IEMQS"
6) Only those Vendor allow to edit/update which are Created from IEMQS. 
7) Vendor created from daily schedular via EPR shall have value in field "CreatedFrom" is "ERPLN"
8) Vendor who created from ERPLN, those are not allow to edit/update in IEMQS using above screen.

## US-19867 — Stuff Items Popup

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19867 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19867) |

### Description

Below popup needs to be implemented for stuff items into package. 
  

First user will select or scan package QR code to get package information as below.  This package information will display in read only mode. 
User will scan QR code of items or select from part no from supply list and add into package. 
User can add comment if required. 
User can upload/capture photos.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Package details will fetch using manual selection of package number or scan QR code. all package details shall be displayed in read only mode. 
  2. Item shall be added using manual select part no or scan item QR code. Part description shall be auto fetched and display in read only mode. Quantity field shall be manual enter, mandatory, only numeric value and more than 0 quantity allowed. Quantity shall not be more than defined quantity of packing list. 
  3. Clicking upon QR code image, system will open the camera and allow to scan any QR code. After scanning QR code system will fetch data from system. 
  4. While scanning QR code or manual entry system will check the part is applicable to stuff in this package or not based on packing list. 
  5. Comment field shall be non-mandatory and no more than 500 characters allow. 
  6. User shall be able to attach files or capture photo using camera attached.  Photos shall be non-mandatory. 
  7. Clicking upon "STUFF" action button, confirmation message shall be displayed "Are you sure want to stuff items into package?" with Yes/No option. 
     1. if yes, data shall be captured in system and display success or failure message. 
     2. if no, confirmation message shall hide and stay on "Stuff Items" popup. 
  8. Clicking upon "CANCEL" action button, hide "Stuff Items" popup without any action perform.

### Description

Control – Create folder by level 2 user of same department. Other department user can View and download documents. System shall highlight folder departmentwise and should show all child items (files & folders) at the right side in list view.
User should be allowed to upload or drag single file or multiple files of type and size as per FCS server settings. Loader shall be shown when uploading starts.
Index Field – “Name”, “Remark”, “Uploaded By”, “Uploaded On”, “Action”. In “Action” column following buttons will be shown for file - “Delete”, “Universal Viewer”, “Download”. In “Action” column following buttons will be shown for folder - “Delete”, “Download”. Folder shall be downloaded as .zip file.  “Delete” button[JT1] [UP2] [JT3] [UP4] [JT5] [UP6]  shall be[JT7] [UP8]  applicable for same department users. “Icon” for file shall be shown.
Search – Functionality shall work on “Name”, “Remark”, “Uploaded By”, “Uploaded On”. System shall search files as ‘contain’ search. Search shall work based on folder selected. E.g. If project is selected then system should search files in all folders else if folder is selected then system should search file [JT9] [UP10] [JT11] [UP12] in that specific[JT13] [UP14]  folder.

## US-19931 — User story for Report Creation

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19931 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Pralhadsinh Rajpurohit |
| Area Path | ECOM\Customer Project Progress Report Team |
| Iteration Path | ECOM |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19931) |

### Description

As a PMG user, I should be able to generate a monthly progress report for a contract by filling up the necessary details so that I should be able to share the auto generated report to the customer to help them progress of the projects.

### Acceptance Criteria

System should fetch contract details in the system.
An option should be able to mark weather the reports are required or not.
An option should be available to identify, weather the reports are to be created Monthly, By-Weekly (15 days) or Weekly.
Users (PMG3) should be able to create or upload report based on the selected contract number.
System should fetch the Contract > Project (Equipment) specific details and same should be auto populated in the respective fields.
Monthly versions should be available.
Users should be able to Modify the created report.
Provision to download the created report and option to save the report draft should be available.

## US-19939 — Paint ARM initiation

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-19939 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Pralhadsinh Rajpurohit |
| Area Path | ECOM\Paint ARM Flow Team |
| Iteration Path | ECOM |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/19939) |

### Description

As a DCC user, I should be able to initiate the Paint ARM flow preperation so that other departments can prepare their dependent procedure and CRS and finish the procurement.

### Acceptance Criteria

An option should be available to initiate the paint ARM. 
Users should be able to select the project number. 
System should fetch the respective project number from the IEMQS system. 
**DCC** : Users should be able to upload the initial paint ARM. 
**MCC** : Users should be able to validate the paint ARM uploaded by DCC and provide appropriate comments as "Accepted" or "Commented" along with document upload. 
**Surface treatment:** Prepare and upload Paint Procedure in the system. 
**MCC:**  Users should be able to validate the paint procedure uploaded by surface treatment and provide appropriate comments as "Accepted" or "Commented" along with document upload.
**Surface Treatment** : Maintain and upload CRS 
**MCC** : Accept or comment and then Initiate procurement request to production.
**PMG** : Users can have access to all the module of the application.
Once the Flow is created then it should be displayed and maintained at the display gri of the same screen.
Export facility as well as filter activity should be vilable.

## US-20067 — Changes to generate Quality Project for KSA location.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-20067 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | TRISHUL TANDEL |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0\Sprint 16 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/20067) |

### Description

Quality project will generate based on selection provided in below screen: 
  1. **Quality Tag** (Default Selected) 
  2. **Project + Quality Tag**


This option will not be visible for other than KSA location. 
  

  

If **Quality Tag** option is selected, then system will generate quality project with Quality Tag only. 
  * Character limits of quality tag shall be 15
  * No special character allowed in Quality Tag input text


e.g.  
**Project:  **50032/1
**Quality Tag:** 772D5842 
**Quality Project:  **772D5842
  

\-------------------------------------------------------------------
  

If **Project + Quality Tag** option is selected, then system will generate quality project with combination of Project and Quality Tag. 
  * Character limits of quality tag shall be 5


e.g.  
**Project:  **50032/1
**Quality Tag:  **5842 
**Quality Project:  50032/1/5**842

## US-22230 — E-sign on Milestone Activity Report

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-22230 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | CHANDRASHEKHAR VENKANNA |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/22230) |

### Description

**As a** user responsible for preparing and submitting Milestone Activity Reports (MAL),  
**I want** the ability to upload supporting documents at the time of report preparation and submission,  
**So that** all relevant evidence and documentation are attached to the report before it enters the approval workflow, ensuring compliance, traceability, and efficient review by signatories.

### Acceptance Criteria

* * **Upload Option Availability**
  * The system provides an “Upload Supporting Documents” feature during MAL preparation and submission stages.  
  



* **File Type Restriction**
  * Only **PDF files** can be uploaded. 
  * System rejects any other file format with an appropriate error message. 


* **Document Linking**
  * Uploaded PDFs are linked to the specific MAL and remain accessible during e-signature review. 


* **Validation**
  * System validates file size and ensures the file is a valid PDF before upload. 


* **Visibility**
  * Signatories can view all attached PDFs during the approval process.

## US-22929 — Auto include in transmittal after revision of procedure

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-22929 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Harsh Adadhiyawala |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/22929) |

### Description

Currently system will auto populate revised document to transmittal after approval of respective department for other than L&T procedure documents. 
  

But same will not reflect while approval of L&T procedure documents from newly created "maintain/approve procedure" module. 
  

below steps needs to be follow for resolve this issue: 
  1. Create at least two types of documents as below in JEP by design engineer (20005475). JEP approval is not required if already in approved state, otherwise design engineer needs to submit JEP and get approval from design manager (122910). 
     1. L&T Procedure 
     2. Other than L&T Procedure 
  2. Create document from assigned department user (Other than L&T procedure document type) <https://vhzdigiiemqsqa2.lthed.com:447/DES/DOC/add>[](https://vhzdigiiemqsqa2.lthed.com:447/DES/DOC/add)
  3. Submit this document R0 revision and get approval. 
  4. Maintain procedure document from assigned department QC user (20001746) - For L&T Procedure document type
  5. Submit this document R0 revision and get approval from approve procedure session.  

  6. After get approval of both documents, create a transmittal from design engineer and add those newly created documents in transmittal. 
  7. Now generate a transmittal  
  8. Now revise those both documents and get approval for R1 documents. 
  9. System shall auto add those newly R1 revision documents in same transmittal which we created before.

### Acceptance Criteria

Revised document R1 or greeter revision shall be auto added in transmittal which was created for R0. no manual extra effort requires from design engineer.

## US-22969 — Create generic template for maintain LW category seam protocol data for setup and visual

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-22969 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | CHANDRASHEKHAR VENKANNA |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/22969) |

### Description

**Refer below attachments**
[Maintain Protocol Template for LW_Reviewed and Accepted.docx](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_apis/wit/attachments/28e8bcb5-795a-4361-9b6c-3af4c13a992f?fileName=Maintain%20Protocol%20Template%20for%20LW_Reviewed%20and%20Accepted.docx&download=true)  
[LW Seam Template.xlsx](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_apis/wit/attachments/dca115db-3d9f-4adb-8d44-1a81348a574d?fileName=LW%20Seam%20Template.xlsx&download=true)
  

  

  

**Field Label**
  * Change label from **‘PROTOCOL TYPE’** to **‘PROTOCOL FOR’**. 


**Field Conversion**
  * Convert **‘DIMENSION OF EXTERNAL/INTERNAL ATTACHMENT’** from static to **mandatory dropdown** and value as below: 
    * SHELL LONG SEAM
    * CIRC SEAM 
    * NOZZLE SEAM 
    * PIPE/FLANGE/ELBOW SEAM 
    * EXTERNAL/INTERNAL ATTACHMENT 


**Conditional Field Visibility**
  * Hide the following fields if value selected other than **EXTERNAL/INTERNAL ATTACHMENT** : 
    * ACTUAL OD CF 
    * REF LINE ELEVATION 
    * CALIBRATION DUE DATE 
    * ELEVATION FROM 
    * MEASURING AND TESTING 
  * Hide “Add New Column” button if value selected other than **EXTERNAL/INTERNAL ATTACHMENT**


  * Seams of following seam category shall be listed in grid based on PROTOCOL FOR value. Protocol columns in grid shall be mapped as per protocol column. 


 
**PROTOCOL FOR** |  **Seam Category** |  **Protocol / Stage Code**  
---|---|---  
  |    |  **N1RSETUP** |  **N5AVISCW**  
SHELL LONG SEAM |  LW |  PROTOCOL036 |  PROTOCOL043  
CIRC SEAM  |  CW  |  PROTOCOL037  |  PROTOCOL044   
NOZZLE SEAM  |  NW  |  PROTOCOL042  |  PROTOCOL047   
PIPE/FLANGE/ELBOW SEAM  |  PW  |  PROTOCOL052  |  PROTOCOL053   
EXTERNAL/INTERNAL ATTACHMENT  |  AW, NP  |  PROTOCOL137  |  PROTOCOL137   
 
  * Refer **GRID COLUMN** detail excel for protocol columns. Based on selection of ‘PROTOCOL FOR’ value grid should show columns for user input. 


**Submit Button Logic as below**
**a) if ICL in Draft state**
  * Generate protocol for inspection stage. 
  * Link protocol with ICL. 
  * Allow user to submit ICL. 
  * Require provision to select multiple seam number against one row. 


**b) if ICL Approved & Stage is not offered**
  * Show pop-up: 
    1. List of ICL approved seams will be displayed with below message and ask confirmation for revise. 
    2. Message: “System will update the values in protocol linked with stage. Do you want to continue?” 
    3. Buttons: **Yes** / **No**
       * **Yes** → Update protocol, set ICL status to **Draft** and revision shall be increased. 
       * **No** → No update, ICL remains **Approved**. 


**c) if ICL Approved & Stage is already offered**
  * Show pop-up: 
    1. List of ICL approved seams will be displayed with below message. 
    2. Message: “Protocol data is not updated in below ICL approved seams as protocol linked with stage is offered.” 
    3. Button: **Ok** (to close pop-up). 


**After submission, Protocol Data shall be sync as below:**
**Protocol036 Sync**
  * Update SEAM NO values into: 
    * W.E.P. DIMENSIONS 
    * PROFILE MEASUREMENT 
    * CLAD STRIPING DETAILS 
    * RECORD FOR TEMPORARY ATTACHMENTS LOCATION 


**Protocol043 Sync**
Below data needs to fetch from Protocol036: 
    * REQUIRED I.D. AS PER DRG → A = OUT OF ROUNDNESS (REQUIRED I.D.: ) 
    * INSIDE AS PER DRG → B = CIRCUMFERENCE MEASUREMENT REQ. ID CF. : 
    * OUTSIDE AS PER DRG → B = CIRCUMFERENCE MEASUREMENT REQ. OD CF. : 


 
 
1.      Protocol036

## US-23172 — Balance Activity List (BAL)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23172 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Basil Babu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23172) |

### Description

The Live Balance Activity List (BAL) module streamlines the creation, maintenance, and generation of project-specific activity lists by integrating live data from LTFPS sources. It enables users to design reusable templates, generate real-time BAL outputs with inspection statuses, and append pending NCR lists for comprehensive project tracking. The module enforces data accuracy, integrity, and role-based access, while providing a user-friendly interface for efficient quality management and decision-making.

### Acceptance Criteria

## Acceptance Criteria for Live Balance Activity List (BAL) Solution 
### 1\. **BAL Template Creation**
  * The system must allow QI-1 and QI-2 users to create BAL templates; QI-3 users must not have access to this feature. 
  * The “Create BAL Template” screen must include:
    * Project No. dropdown (showing only valid Quality projects). 
    * Sub Assembly No. input (mandatory, after Project No.). 
    * BAL Description input (must be unique; used as template identifier). 
    * LTFPS No. dropdown (sourced from ‘Maintain LTFPS’), with manual entry option for QI-1/QI-2. 
    * Operation No. selection with From/To range and “+ Add” button. 
    * Dynamic table displaying added entries with Edit/Delete/Save per row. 
    * Manual Entry tab for LTFPS and Operation numbers. 
  * The system must:
    * Enforce uniqueness of BAL Description. 
    * Prevent duplicate or overlapping LTFPS/OPN combinations (across ranges and manual lines). 
    * Exclude operations where both L&T and Customer inspection stages are ‘X’ or ‘–’. 
    * Auto-capture Created By (Name & PS) and live date-time on save. 
    * Validate OPNFrom ≤ OPNTo and both exist for the selected LTFPS. 


### 2\. **BAL Template Maintenance**
  * All templates must be stored in a central repository (“Maintain BAL Template”). 
  * Only QI-1 and QI-2 users can access and maintain templates. 
  * Each template row must have Edit, Delete, and Info buttons:
    * Edit opens the template in edit mode (same as creation UI). 
    * Delete prompts for confirmation. 
    * Info displays template details. 
  * All edits, deletes, and saves must be logged with user, timestamp, and before/after data. 


### 3\. **Generate BAL**
  * The “Generate BAL” screen must allow users to:
    * Select Project and BAL Template (with search and Fetch button). 
    * View generated BAL output grid with columns: LTFPS No., OPN No., Operation Description, Inspection Status, Action By, Remarks. 
    * Edit all cells for manual LTFPS lines except LTFPS No. 
    * Enter Remarks (max 150 characters); Remarks freeze after QI-3 saves and are editable only by QI-2/QI-1. 
    * Save (stamps Name, PS, live timestamp) and Print the BAL. 
  * The system must:
    * Expand OPN ranges into atomic operations and deduplicate (LTFPS, OPN). 
    * Fetch live states from ‘Display LTFPS Status’ and ‘LTFPS Updation’ modules. 
    * Exclude operations where both L&T and TPI columns are ‘x’ or ‘–’. 
    * Derive Inspection Status and Action By as per defined rules. 
    * Print Description only for non-Closed operations; if all ops for an LTFPS are Closed, show “—”. 
    * Remove Quality Project column and Delete action from output grid. 
    * Highlight errors in the output grid if data fetch or mapping fails. 
    * Display a confirmation pop-up after successful data fetch. 


### 4\. **Pending NCR List**
  * The system must append a live list of pending NCRs for the selected project and all related projects in the same series (configurable range). 
  * NCR list must include columns: NCR No., NCR Description, Current Status, Action By, Remarks. 
  * Always fetch live NCR status when generating BAL. 
  * Allow users to edit Action By and Remarks for each NCR. 
  * Print the NCR list below the BAL output. 


### 5\. **Validation & Error Handling**
  * Block duplicate BAL Descriptions. 
  * Prevent duplicate/overlapping (LTFPS, OPN) entries. 
  * Highlight errors in the BAL output grid for any data fetch/mapping issues. 
  * If upstream services (Display/Updation/NCR) are unavailable, show a blocking banner, disable Save, and provide Retry. 
  * After successful data fetch, display a confirmation pop-up. 


### 6\. **Non-Functional Requirements**
  * Performance: 95th percentile response time < 5 seconds for typical templates. 
  * Availability: 99.5% monthly uptime for BAL module. 
  * Security: Enforce role-based access controls; protect user identifiers (Name, PS). 
  * Auditability: Log all Edit/Delete/Save actions with user, timestamp, and before/after data. 
  * Data Freshness: Always fetch live data; block Save if upstream services are down. 


### 7\. **UI/UX Requirements**
  * All screens and flows must match the described wireframes and field behaviors. 
  * Manual LTFPS entries must merge with template data on save. 
  * Output grid must not display Quality Project column or Delete action. 
  * Remarks field must be limited to 150 characters and freeze as per role rules. 
  * Save and Print options must be available as described. 


### 8\. **Assumptions & Dependencies**
  * API endpoints/DB objects for LTFPS, Display Status, Updation, and NCR will be provided during design. 
  * Role definitions (QI-1/2/3) and user directory for Name & PS are available. 
  * NDE tray status is exposed by the Display LTFPS Status module.

### Description

### Acceptance Criteria

### **1\. Fast OTP Delivery**
  * **OTP Delivery Speed:**  
The system must deliver OTPs to users via both SMS and email within 5 seconds for at least 95% of requests.  
_Test:_ Simulate multiple OTP requests and measure delivery time; 95% must be ≤ 5 seconds. 
  * **Resend Option:**  
Users must be able to request a resend of the OTP, but only after a 30-second cooldown period from the previous request.  
_Test:_ Attempt to resend OTP before 30 seconds; system should prevent it. 
  * **OTP Validity:**  
Each OTP must remain valid and reusable for 5 minutes after generation.  
_Test:_ Use the same OTP within 5 minutes; system should accept it. After 5 minutes, OTP should expire. 


* * *
### **2\. Flexible Multi-Selection for E-Sign Submission**
  * **Multi-Report Selection:**  
Users must be able to select multiple reports (e.g., ferrite, PMI, chemical, hardness) for e-signing in a single action, rather than only by range.  
_Test:_ Select multiple reports and submit for e-sign; system should process all selected reports. 
  * **Seam Selection Interface:**  
The system must provide seam selection by category and stage code, similar to the AI Horizontal checklist interface.  
_Test:_ Interface should allow selection by seam category and stage code; verify selections are reflected in submission. 


* * *
### **3\. Direct Report Sharing & Download Options**
  * **Direct Email to TPI:**  
Users must be able to send signed reports directly from the system to the Third Party Inspector’s (TPI) registered email address.  
_Test:_ Select signed reports and send to TPI; TPI should receive the email with the reports attached. 
  * **Share Option in Digital Compilation:**  
The Digital Compilation module must provide a “Share” option, allowing users to send compiled reports directly from the system to intended recipients (TPI or internal stakeholders).  
_Test:_ Use the share option to send compiled reports; recipients should receive the reports. 
  * **Download Option in Digital Compilation:**  
The Digital Compilation module must provide a “Download” option, enabling users to download compiled reports for offline use or record-keeping.  
_Test:_ Download compiled reports; verify file integrity and completeness.

## US-23177 — L&T Certificate e-sign

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23177 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Harsh Adadhiyawala |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23177) |

### Description

Only certain authorized users (those with the QI-1 role) can electronically sign certificates, and the option to sign is hidden for everyone else. When printing a certificate, images are left out to keep things simple. The electronic signature is only added to the second page of certificates—if there’s only one page, signing isn’t allowed. The signing screen shows only the necessary fields, and the signature itself includes the date and the name of the person signing. This setup helps make the signing process secure, clear, and easy for everyone to use.

### Acceptance Criteria

* **Role-Based Access:**  
Only users with the QI-1 role can electronically sign the L&T Certificate. For all other users, the “Sign & Approve” button is hidden, and any attempt to sign via direct API or backend calls is blocked with an unauthorized error. 
* **Print Functionality:**  
Any user can print certificates from both the Index (list) and Detail (single certificate) pages. The printed version must exclude all images and only show text and data. 
* **e-Sign Window Display:**  
When a QI-1 user initiates signing, the e-sign window must not display the following fields: Witnessed/Approved by, Agency Name, TPI Name, and Intervention Stage. Only the essential fields required for signing should be visible. 
* **Page Requirement for Signing:**  
The system must allow e-signing only if the certificate has at least two pages. If a certificate has only one page, the system must prevent signing and display a clear error message explaining that single-page certificates cannot be signed. 
* **Signature Placement:**  
The electronic signature and any related text must appear only on Page 2 of the certificate. Page 1 and any other pages must not contain any signature marks or related text. 
* **Signature Format:**  
The signature must follow this exact format: “e-Signed on [system date] by [display name]”. The date must use the system’s configured format (for example, DD-MM-YYYY), and the name must match the logged-in user’s display name.

## US-23223 — Hydrostatic Test Report

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23223 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Basil Babu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23223) |

### Description

Hydrostatic Test Report system to support simultaneous and stacked hydrostatic tests, so that team can accurately document, manage, and report complex testing scenarios with improved efficiency and compliance.

### Acceptance Criteria

### Hydrostatic Test Report Enhancement 
* * *
#### **User Story 1: Simultaneous Hydro Test Toggle**
**Title:**  
Add Simultaneous Hydro Test toggle to Hydrostatic Test Report UI 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want a toggle for Simultaneous Hydro Test (Yes/No) in the Hydrostatic Test Report UI so I can document the test type accurately. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * Toggle appears in UI, default value is No. 
  * When Yes is selected, additional fields for simultaneous testing are displayed. 
  * Toggle value is reflected in the report output. 


* * *
#### **User Story 2: Test Pressure Fields Update**
**Title:**  
Update Test Pressure fields for Hydrostatic Test Report 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want MIN and MAX fields for Test Pressure at Top, and grouped fields for simultaneous tests, so I can record pressure values accurately. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * For non-simultaneous tests, display MIN and MAX fields for Test Pressure at Top (100 chars, alphanumeric + special, non-mandatory). 
  * For simultaneous tests, display grouped fields for Shell Side, Tube Side, Differential Pressure, and Holding Time (MIN, MAX, ACTUAL, REQUIRED, all 100 chars, non-mandatory). 
  * Fields are conditionally visible based on toggle value. 


* * *
#### **User Story 3: Stack Job Hydrotest Provision**
**Title:**  
Enable Stack Job Hydrotest entry in Hydrostatic Test Report 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want to add multiple Equipment/Job Names and Numbers for stack job hydrotests, so I can document all jobs tested together. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * UI allows entry of multiple job names and numbers. 
  * “Add” button to include more jobs. 
  * Entries are editable and removable before submission. 
  * Report lists all jobs tested in a stack hydrotest with results. 


* * *
#### **User Story 4: Editable Test Medium Field**
**Title:**  
Make Test Medium field editable in Hydrostatic Test Report 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want the Test Medium field to default to “Water” but be editable, so I can specify the actual medium used. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * Test Medium defaults to “Water”. 
  * Field is editable (100 chars, alphanumeric + special). 
  * Value appears in the report. 


* * *
#### **User Story 5: Pressure Gauge Details Auto-Fetch and Edit**
**Title:**  
Auto-fetch and allow manual edit of Pressure Gauge details 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want Pressure Gauge details to be auto-fetched and manually editable, so I can ensure accurate gauge information. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * Auto-fetch Pressure Gauge Number, Range, Calibration Due Date from Pressure Gauge Issue session. 
  * Manual edits are allowed and logged. 
  * All details included in the report. 
  * Manual entry allowed if auto-fetch fails. 


* * *
#### **User Story 6: Pressure Gauge Calibration Certificate Attachment**
**Title:**  
Attach Pressure Gauge Calibration Certificate to Hydrostatic Test Report 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want to attach, view, download, upload, or delete Pressure Gauge Calibration Certificates, so I can ensure compliance and documentation. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * UI provides attachment pin for certificate. 
  * Certificate can be fetched, viewed, downloaded, uploaded, or deleted. 
  * At least one valid certificate required before submission. 
  * Multiple certificates supported. 
  * Certificates sent with report for e-signature. 


* * *
#### **User Story 7: Default Remark in Report**
**Title:**  
Include and allow edit of default remark in Hydrostatic Test Report 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want the default remark “NO LEAKAGE, PRESSURE DROP AND NO PERMANENT DEFORMATION OBSERVED” included and editable in the report. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * Remark is auto-included (editable, 1,000 chars). 
  * Changes to remark are logged. 


* * *
#### **User Story 8: NB Registration Workflow Fields**
**Title:**  
Add NB Registration workflow fields to Hydrostatic Test Report UI 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want NB Registration and QA submission fields in the UI for tracking, without including them in the report output. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * NB Registration (Yes/No, mandatory, default NULL) always visible. 
  * Signed hydrostatic test report submitted to QA (Yes/No, non-mandatory, default No) visible only when NB Registration = Yes. 
  * Editable by QI2/QI3 only when report status is Approved. 
  * Changes logged for audit. 


* * *
#### **User Story 9: Automated Email Notification for NB Registration**
**Title:**  
Automate email notifications for NB Registration workflow 
**Description:**  
As a QC Engineer, I want automated email notifications for AI signed hydrostatic test report submission to QA, based on NB Registration workflow. 
**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * Popup appears when NB Registration = Yes and report is approved. 
  * If final hydrostatic test, email sent to relevant users and daily reminders for 7 days. 
  * Notifications stop when “Signed hydrostatic test report submitted to QA” is updated to Yes. 
  * All notification actions logged.  



### **Acceptance Criteria**
  1. The field **STACKED HYDROSTATIC TEST** should be added to the checklist template. 
  2. The field should be a **drop-down** with the following options: 
     * Yes 
     * No 
     * NA 
  3. The **default value** should be **NA**. 
  4. The field should be **mandatory**

    * **Last Modified By**
    * **Last Modified On**
    * **Action** (Edit/Delete icons) 


  

#### **Detailed Page Layout**
**  
**
  * **Checklist Header Section** : 
    * **Header Id** : Auto-generated, numeric, incremented. 
    * **Project** : Dropdown selection from project master data. 
    * **Product** : Dropdown selection from global master data filtered by "Product Category". 
    * **Customer** : Auto-fetched based on selected project, read-only. 
    * **Planner** : Auto-fetched PS number and name of logged-in user, read-only. 
    * **LOI Date** : Auto-fetched from project master data, read-only. 
    * **Integration Date** : User-selectable date. 
    * **CDD** : Auto-fetched from project master data, read-only. 
    * **Production Centre** : Dropdown selection from master data. 
  * **Checklist Line Items** : 
    * Upon clicking **Create** , system fetches master checklist based on selected product and maps it to the selected project. 
    * Auto-maintained line table includes: 
      * **Line Id** : Auto-generated, numeric, incremented. 
      * **Header Id** : Reference to header. 
      * **Phase No**
      * **Sr. No.**
      * **Activity**
      * **Outcome**
      * **Planned Completion Date** : 
        * Calculated based on LOI date for Phase 1 & 2\. 
        * Calculated based on Integration date for Phase 3. 
      * **Actual Completion Date**
      * **Remarks**
      * **Status** : Dropdown with values: 
        * NS (Not Started) 
        * IP (In Progress) 
        * CO (Completed) 
      * **Action** : 
        * **Edit** : Allowed only if status is NS. 
        * **Delete** : Allowed only if status is NS. 
      * **Timeline** : Captures all user actions on the specific activity.

## US-23322 — Digitize ASME Inspection Checklist for Authorized Inspector Signature

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23322 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23322) |

### Description

#### **Title:  **Digitize ASME Inspection Checklist for Authorized Inspector Signature 
* * *
#### **As a:**
Quality Control Engineer (L&T QC)  
Authorized Inspector (ASME AI) 
* * *
#### **I want to:**
Prepare, update, and manage ASME inspection checklists digitally, and offer them to the Authorized Inspector for electronic signature after completion of inspection activities. 
* * *
#### **So that I can:**
  * Eliminate manual paperwork and physical signatures. 
  * Ensure compliance with ASME standards. 
  * Reduce delays caused by in-person approvals. 
  * Maintain accurate, traceable records for audits and regulatory requirements. 


* * *
### **Detailed Description**
Currently, ASME inspection checklists are prepared in Excel and signed physically by the Authorized Inspector after inspection activities. This process is time-consuming, repetitive, and dependent on physical presence. The new digital solution will: 
  * Provide a **web-based interface** under **Menu → Quality Control → Advance Quality Planning**. 
  * Introduce two new sections: 
    1. **Maintain ASME Inspection Checklist** – Create and edit checklists. 
    2. **ASME Inspection Master List** – View all checklists with filters and search. 


* * *
### **Acceptance Criteria**
  1. **Checklist Creation**
     * User can create a new checklist using a predefined template. 
     * Checklist includes fields: 
       * Sr. No. 
       * Section/Assembly 
       * Description 
       * AI Check Point Type (Dropdown: H, W, RW, R, NA) 
       * Description of Check Points 
       * Acceptance Criteria / Code Reference 
       * L&T QC Status (Pending/Complete) 
       * L&T QC Sign & Date (Auto-filled on sign) 
       * ASME AI Status (Pending/Complete) 
       * ASME AI Sign & Date (Auto-filled on sign) 
       * Comments/Remarks 
       * Attachments (File upload) 
  2. **Dynamic Row Management**
     * Ability to add, edit, and delete rows dynamically. 
     * Auto-renumber Sr. No. when rows are added or deleted. 
  3. **Digital Signature**
     * Clicking “Sign” auto-fills username and timestamp. 
     * Separate sign buttons for L&T QC and ASME AI. 
  4. **Status Tracking**
     * Dropdown for Pending/Complete for both L&T QC and AI. 
     * Visual indicators for status. 
  5. **Attachments**
     * Upload supporting documents per checklist item. 
  6. **Master List**
     * View all checklists with filters (Project, Equipment, Status, Date). 
     * Search functionality. 
  7. **Notifications**
     * Email alerts to AI when L&T QC completes stages. 
     * Reminders for pending actions. 


* * *
### **Benefits**
  * **Efficiency:** Faster turnaround for inspection approvals. 
  * **Compliance:** Adherence to ASME standards with digital traceability. 
  * **Transparency:** Real-time status updates for all stakeholders. 
  * **Data Security:** Secure storage of signed documents and attachments.

### Acceptance Criteria

#### **1\. Checklist Creation**
  * User can create a new checklist under **Menu → Quality Control → Advance Quality Planning → Maintain ASME Inspection Checklist**. 
  * Checklist includes the following fields: 
    * **Sr. No.** (Auto-generated and re-sequenced when rows are added/deleted) 
    * **Section/Assembly** (Text input) 
    * **Description** (Text input) 
    * **AI Check Point Type** (Dropdown: H – Hold, W – Witness, RW – Random Witness, R – Review, NA – Not Applicable) 
    * **Description of Check Points** (Text input) 
    * **Acceptance Criteria / Code Reference** (Text input) 
    * **L &T QC Status** (Dropdown: Pending/Complete) 
    * **L &T QC Sign & Date** (Auto-filled when “Sign” button clicked) 
    * **ASME AI Status** (Dropdown: Pending/Complete) 
    * **ASME AI Sign & Date** (Auto-filled when “Sign” button clicked) 
    * **Comments/Remarks** (Textarea) 
    * **Attachments** (File upload) 


* * *
#### **2\. Dynamic Row Management**
  * Ability to **Add Row** dynamically with all fields editable. 
  * Ability to **Delete Selected Rows** using checkboxes. 
  * Auto-renumber **Sr. No.** after deletion or addition. 


* * *
#### **3\. Digital Signature**
  * Clicking **Sign** button auto-fills: 
    * Logged-in username. 
    * Current system date and time. 
  * Signature button disappears after signing to prevent duplicate signing. 


* * *
#### **4\. Status Tracking**
  * Dropdown for **Pending/Complete** for both L&T QC and ASME AI. 
  * Visual indicator (color or icon) for status changes. 


* * *
#### **5\. Attachments**
  * File upload supported for each checklist row. 
  * Multiple file types allowed (PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX). 
  * Preview or download option for uploaded files. 


* * *
#### **6\. Comments**
  * Free-text field for remarks per checklist item. 
  * Minimum 200 characters allowed for detailed notes. 


* * *
#### **7\. Master List**
  * Displays all created checklists in a tabular view. 
  * Filters available for: 
    * Project Name 
    * Equipment 
    * Status (Pending/Complete) 
    * Date Range 
  * Search functionality by keyword. 


* * *
#### **8\. Notifications**
  * Email notification sent to AI when L&T QC completes all stages and submits checklist. 
  * Reminder notifications for pending signatures. 


* * *
#### **9\. Security & Access**
  * Role-based access: 
    * **L &T QC:** Create, edit, sign, submit. 
    * **ASME AI:** Review, sign only. 
    * **Admin:** Full access. 
  * All actions logged for audit trail. 


* * *
#### **10\. Performance**
  * System should support at least **100 concurrent users** without performance degradation. 
  * Checklist load time should be **< 3 seconds**.

### Description

As a **QC2 user** , I want the ability to add a new stage to multiple Position Numbers at the same time so that I don’t have to update each Position Number individually.

### Acceptance Criteria

*   

  * A new button **“Add Stages”** should be available next to the **Export** button. 
  * On clicking **“Add Stages”** , a popup window should open. 
  * The popup must allow: 
    * Selecting multiple Position Numbers. 
    * Selecting a stage to add. 
  * On clicking **Add** , the selected stage should be added to **all selected Position Numbers**. 
  * The system must show a confirmation or success message after completion.

## US-23427 — 2.	Option required to copy part ICL from one project to another project along with protocol.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23427 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Praksah Vasaikar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |

### Description

As a **QC2 user** , I want to copy an existing Part ICL from one Position Number to other Position Numbers within the same project so that I can quickly replicate ICL data.

### Acceptance Criteria

* A **Copy** option should be available for Position-to-Position (P2P) copying. 
  * On clicking **Copy** , a popup must open. 
  * The “Copy To Position” list should show only Position Numbers where ICL has **not** yet been generated. 
  * On confirming: 
    * Quality ID, ICL stages, and protocol should be copied to all selected Position Numbers. 
  * If Position Number already has ICL data, the system **must not** copy and should skip it.

###

  * The popup must allow: 
    * Selecting source Project Number.

## US-23432 — Add a “Recent” tab in the mega menu for quick access to recently viewed sessions

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23432 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 3 |
| Assigned To | NIKHIL JAIN |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23432) |

### Description

**As a**
Logged-in user of the application, 
**I want**  
to see a “Recent” tab in the mega menu that lists my recently accessed sessions, 
**So that**  
I can quickly navigate to frequently used sessions without searching for them again.

### Acceptance Criteria

* **UI Changes:**
  * A new tab labeled **Recent** is added to the mega menu alongside existing tabs. 
  * The tab displays a list of the last 5–10 sessions viewed by the user. 
  * Each session name is clickable and redirects to the respective session page. 
  * Refer attachment [Recent-tab-megamenu.png](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/45e6fd4b-5def-4944-bc9a-e24d9f7e0a96/_apis/wit/attachments/4d2a1cd2-7ce5-4cc4-b586-1e424ec71ecf?fileName=Recent-tab-megamenu.png&download=true)


* **Functionality:**
  * The system tracks user activity and stores recently viewed sessions. 
  * Sessions are displayed in reverse chronological order (most recent first). 
  * Optionally, provide a “Clear History” button for privacy. 


* **Performance:**
  * The list should load instantly when the mega menu is opened. 
  * No noticeable lag in navigation. 


* **Edge Cases:**
  * If no sessions have been viewed, display a message like:  
_“No recent sessions available.”_
  * Handle scenarios where sessions are deleted or become inaccessible.

### I want to add a new section named **“Job and Saddle Details”** with additional fields in the **Maintain HTR** screen, So that I can record all required dimensional and weight-related information accurately for each HTR entry.
### **Requirements / New Fields to Add in Maintain HTR**
Add new section **Job and Saddle Details** in Maintain HTR with the following fields (saved in **HTR001** table): 
  1. **Length (m)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  2. **Width (m)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  3. **Height (Product + Support) (m)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  4. **Volume (m³)**
     * Auto-calculated 
     * Formula: `Length * Width * Height`
  5. **Minimum Thickness (mm)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  6. **Stool Weight (per unit) (MT)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  7. **Stool Total Weight (MT)**
     * Auto-calculated 
     * Formula: `Stool Weight (per unit) * Nos of Stool`
  8. **Saddle Weight (MT)**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (Decimal 2 digits) 
  9. **Nos of Stool**
     * Mandatory 
     * Manual Input 
     * Numeric (int)

### Acceptance Criteria

* A new section **Job and Saddle Details** must be visible in Maintain HTR. 
  * All mandatory fields should have validation messages if left blank. 
  * Auto-calculated fields should compute instantly once dependent fields are entered. 
  * All data must be stored in **HTR001** table. 
  * UI should match styling and position as per provided screenshot.

## US-23462 — CTQ Module Shop Flow

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23462 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Praksah Vasaikar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23462) |

### Description

**1\. Add Production Center & Update Name of Process **  

  * As a QC2 user, I want to add Production Center information and remove unnecessary fields in the Name of Process Maser, so that the CTQ creation process is aligned with updated business requirements.


  

  

**2\. Show Annexure Popup on CTQ Submit**  

  * As a QC user, I want a popup to appear after clicking the Submit CTQ button
  * As a **system** , I must save each process-wise CTQ entry so that the data can be routed to respective shops.  

  *   * As a **QC user** , I want previously selected shop and in-charge details from CTQ to auto-fill in the popup so that I don’t re-enter the same information.  



**3\. Send CTQ to All Selected Shop In-Charges**  

  * As a QC user, I want each applicable shop in-charge to receive the CTQ task so that they can acknowledge it. 


**4.Shop Acknowledgement Flow**  

  * As a Shop In-Charge, I want to acknowledge assigned CTQs so that QC can approve only after all shops have reviewed.


**  
**
**5.Send Email Notification on Acknowledgement**  

  * As a CTQ initiator, I want to receive an automated email when a shop acknowledges the CTQ so that I remain informed of progress.

### Acceptance Criteria

**1\. Add Production Center & Update Name of Process**  

  * Remove Select Department from Name of Process screen. 
  * Add Select Production Center dropdown. 
    * Data to be fetched from Global Master (Category: CTQ Production Centre). 
  * Function dropdown to be fetched from Global Master (Category: CTQ Function). 
  * In Maintain CTQ → Add CTQ: 
    * Add Production Center field before Function. 
    * Save in database table CTQ002 (new column `ProductionCenter nvarchar(40)`). 


**2\. Show Annexure Popup on CTQ Submit**  

  * On clicking Submit, a popup will open showing required CTQ details as per Annexure-1. 
  * Popup includes 6 fields: 
    * Process 
    * Applicable (Yes/No) 
    * Detail of CTQ 
    * Production Centre 
    * Shop 
    * Shop In-Charge 
  * Processwise CTQ Details should be stored in new table 
  * If Applicable = Yes: 
    * Detail of CTQ must be **alphanumeric** , **200 characters** , **mandatory**. 
  * If Applicable = No: 
    * CTQ Detail auto-filled as **NA** (non-editable). 
  * Applicable Shop: 
    * Dropdown, data fetched from **Name of Process Master** , **mandatory**. 
  * Applicable Shop In-Charge: 
    * Dropdown, dependent on selected Shop, **mandatory**. 
  *   * System fetches selected Process, Shop, and In-Charge from CTQ. 
  * Other process rows remain blank for user input. 


**3\. Send CTQ to All Selected Shop In-Charges**  

  * After Submit CTQ: 
    * CTQ data goes to all selected Shop In-Charge trays. 
  * For Applicable = No: 
    * System still sends to shop with message:  
"There is no specific CTQ identified for this project related to XXXX shop."

**4.Shop Acknowledgement Flow**  

  * In-Charge opens Maintain CTQ → clicks Acknowledge. 
  * Status for that shop updates to Complete. 
  * Only after all shops acknowledge, QC2 can approve. 
  * Shop Name must be displayed in CTQ Header. 

**5.Send Email Notification on Acknowledgement**  

After each shop acknowledges: 
  * Email sent to initiator stating:  
"XXX shop has reviewed & acknowledged project CTQ."

## US-23470 — Maintain Master Data for Resource Allocation

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23470 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 1 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23470) |

### Description

****
**As a** Production Planner  
**I want** to maintain a master data table that maps ID/Blank and Length ranges to specific resources  
**So that** I can automatically assign the correct machine (Lathe, VTL-West, K-VTL, SKZ) based on part dimensions.

### Acceptance Criteria

* **Create & Update Records**
*   * Ability to add or edit rules with non-mandatory fields: 
    * **ID/Blank** (numeric or range) 
    * **Length** (numeric or range) 
    * **Resource** (text) 
  * Predefined mapping: 
    * `<200` → Lathe 
    * `200-500` & `<1000` → VTL-West 
    * `200-500` & `>1000` → K-VTL 
    * `>500` → SKZ 


* ****
ID/Blank |  Length |  Resource  
---|---|---  
<200 |  - |  Lathe  
200-500 |  <1000 |  VTL-West  
200-500 |  >1000 |  K-VTL  
>500 |  - |  SKZ  
**  
**
* **Validation**
  * Ensure ranges do not overlap incorrectly. 
  * Resource must be selected from predefined list. 


* **Auto-Assignment**
  * When a new part is entered with ID and Length, system suggests the correct resource based on rules. 


* **View & Search**
  * Ability to view all mapping rules in a tabular format. 
  * Ability to filter by Resource or range. 


* **Export**
  * Ability to export master data to Excel for reporting.

## US-23477 — Calculate and Display Start Date & End Date for Components

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23477 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23477) |

### Description

As a user  
I want the system to calculate Start Date, End Date, and Cycle Time based on welding logic  
So that I can plan component timelines accurately and update them when needed.

### Acceptance Criteria

* Add Columns 
  * Add Start Date, End Date, and Cycle Time columns in the relevant session. 


* Calculation Logic 
  * Start Date = Previous Component’s Start Date + (Previous Component’s ID Weld KG ÷ Weld Deposition per day) 
  * Cycle Time = Attached File 
  * End Date = Start Date + Cycle Time 


* Dynamic Update 
  * When the user clicks Update Date, the system recalculates Start Date, End Date, and Cycle Time dynamically based on the latest data. 


* Editable Fields 
  * Start Date, End Date, and Cycle Time columns should be editable by the user. 
  * If edited, system should log changes for audit purposes. 


* UI Behavior 
  * Display calculated dates in respective columns. 
  * Provide an Update Date button to trigger recalculation. 
  * Ensure validation for date formats and logical sequence (Start Date < End Date).

* **Document Upload & Filtering:**

  * TPI result is saved when L&T result is saved. 


* **Filtering & Export Enhancements:**

## US-23568 — Protocol Revision Functionality for Seam Inspection Reports

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23568 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Praksah Vasaikar |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23568) |

### Description

### Requirement :- 
### As a **QC User** ,
I want to **revise the protocol data** for specified Seam Inspection Protocols,  
so that I can update and maintain accurate protocol information with revision history for audit and traceability.  

  

  

  

  

**Scope :-**
**
****
**
The **Revise Option** must be added for the following protocols: 
**Protocol No****** |  **Protocol Description******  
---|---  
PROTOCOL036_1 |  SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM  
PROTOCOL043_1 |  VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM  
PROTOCOL037_1 |  SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM  
PROTOCOL044_1 |  VISUAL AND DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM  
PROTOCOL042_1 |  SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR NOZZLE  
PROTOCOL047_1 |  WELD VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR NOZZLE  
PROTOCOL038_1 |  SET-UP INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED HEMISPHERICAL D'END  
PROTOCOL045_1 |  VISUAL AND DIMENSION INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED HEMISPHERICAL D'END  
PROTOCOL041_1 |  SET-UP INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED ELLIPSODIAL,TORISPHERICAL D'END WITH CROWN AND TIER  
PROTOCOL046_1 |  VISUAL AND DIMENSION INSPECTION REPORT FOR ELLIPSOIDAL,TORISPHERICAL FORMED D'END  
PROTOCOL052_1 |  SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR PEPE TO PIPE, PIEPE TO FLANGE, PIPE TO ELBOW SEAM, PIPE TO FORGING, FORGING TO FLANGE, ELBOW TO FLANGE  
PROTOCOL053_1 |  VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR PEPE TO PIPE, PIEPE TO FLANGE, PIPE TO ELBOW SEAM, PIPE TO FORGING, FORGING TO FLANGE, ELBOW TO FLANGE  
  

Remaining protocol list will be provided later. 
**Current work flow :-**
  1. QC3 logs in → Maintain ICL → Attaches protocol against the stage 
  2. QC3 fills protocol details 
  3. QC3 submits ICL 
  4. QC2 approves ICL 
  5. Production user offers stage when protocol data is filled 
  6. QC3 Attend the same, Submit Protocol Data and Cleared the stage. 


## ****New Requirement :-****
**1\. Add Revision Functionality**
  * Add **Revision No** field in Protocol (default = **R0**) 
  * Revision No **should not appear in protocol print**
  * Add **Revise button** on Protocol page 
  * Revise button becomes visible only **after protocol submission**


**2\. Revision Flow**
  1. QC User clicks **Revise**
  2. System shows **confirmation popup**
  3. QC User enters **Revise Remark**
  4. System: 
     * Saves remark in protocol table 
     * Increments Revision No by **+1** (R1, R2, etc.) 
     * Updates **Edited By** and **Edited On**
     * Enables all QC fields for data editing 
     * Saves previous revision PDF on FCS Server 


**3\. Protocol History**
  * Add **Protocol History** button 
  * On click, show popup displaying Previous Revision Details. 
    * Revision list 
    * Revision No 
    * Revised By 
    * Revised On 
    * Remark 
  * **View button** opens corresponding PDF saved on FCS Server

### Acceptance Criteria

* Protocol must start with **Revision No = R0**


  * Revise button should be visible only after initial protocol submission. 


  * System must display popup asking for confirmation before revision. 


  * All QC fields become editable again. 
  * Revision No increments correctly. 
  * Revise Remark, Edit By, Edit On are stored. 


  * Protocol History popup must display complete revision list. 
  * View button must open correct PDF from FCS Server. 


  * Revision number must **not** appear on the print. 


  * Only QC users can revise protocols. 
  * Production users cannot revise.

## US-23584 — Additional development points for blasting and coating protocol page

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23584 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | NIKHIL JAIN |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23584) |

### Description

**Blasting & Coating Module Enhancements**  

**  
**
As a user, I want the system to automatically set the default value of _Grinding Clearance_ to “No”, validate this field during save, and automatically calculate _Relative Humidity (%)_ and _Dew Point Temperature (°C)_ based on _Dry Bulb Temperature (°C)_ and _Wet Bulb Temperature (°C)_ in the Blasting and Coating Protocol pages, so that data entry is standardized and errors are minimized.

### Acceptance Criteria

* **1\. Grinding Clearance Default & Validation**
  * The default value of **Grinding Clearance** should be set to **“No”** in the “Offer Blasting for Inspection” popup page. 
  * When user clicks **Save** , if _Grinding Clearance = No_ , an error message should appear: 
> “Grinding Clearance is required to proceed.” 
  * Saving should only be successful when _Grinding Clearance = Yes_. 


* **2.Auto Calculation of Relative Humidity and Dew Point**
  * On the Blasting and Coating Protocol pages: 
    * System should automatically calculate **Relative Humidity (%)** and **Dew Point Temperature (°C)** using the entered values of _Dry Bulb Temp (°C)_ and _Wet Bulb Temp (°C)_. 
  * The formulas are: 
    * **Relative Humidity (%):**  
`= 100 * ((6.112*EXP((17.62*C5)/(243.12+C5)) - 1013.25*(B5-C5)*0.00066*(1+0.00115*C5)) / (6.112*EXP((17.62*B5)/(243.12+B5))))`
    * **Dew Point Temp (°C):**  
`= 243.04 * (LN(D5/100) + ((17.625*B5)/(243.04+B5))) / (17.625 - LN(D5/100) - ((17.625*B5)/(243.04+B5)))`


*   * The same functionality should also be applied to the **Coating Protocol** page.

## US-23630 — Enable Parallel Handling of NDE Stages After PWHT

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23630 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 1 |
| Assigned To | Harsh Adadhiyawala |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23630) |

### Description

**As a** Welding Engineer / QC / Production User,  

**I want** the system to allow parallel handling of NDE (Non-Destructive Examination) stages after PWHT (Post Weld Heat Treatment),  
**So that** inspection processes can be executed efficiently while maintaining proper sequence, offering, and rejection handling logic.  
  

The system should support parallel execution of specific NDE stages after PWHT, ensuring: 
  * Proper sequence management in Stage Master. 
  * Parallel offering of inspections where applicable. 
  * Correct rejection handling logic for failed inspections. 


  

### **Business Value**
  * Improves efficiency by enabling parallel inspections. 
  * Reduces delays caused by sequential handling. 
  * Maintains compliance with inspection and rejection logic.

### Acceptance Criteria

#### **Stage Master**
  * All NDE stages after PWHT must have the same sequence number in the stage master data. 
  * Business will provide master data for modification. 
  * Data shall be maintained from the backend. 


#### **Quality ID**
  * Welding Engineer can maintain and approve all after-PWHT stages in the same sequence. 
  * Roles: 
    * Maintain Quality ID → **WE3 (20071329)**
    * Approve Quality ID → **WE2 (20010289)**


#### **Test Plan**
  * Welding Engineer can maintain and approve all after-PWHT stages in the same sequence. 
  * Roles: 
    * Maintain Test Plan → **WE3 (20071329)**
    * Approve Test Plan → **WE2 (20010289)**


#### **Inspection Checklist (ICL)**
  * QC can maintain and approve all after-PWHT stages in the same sequence. 
  * Roles: 
    * Maintain Seam ICL → **QC3 (20042591)**
    * Approve Seam ICL → **QC2 (20001746)**


#### **Offer Inspection**
  * After PWHT: 
    * All stages with the same sequence should be available for production to offer. 
    * **Parallel Offering:**
      * RT & UT → parallel 
      * PT & MT → parallel 
    * Other stages → offered individually. 
  * Role: 
    * Offer/Re-offer Inspection – Seam → **PROD3 (20010414)**


#### **Inspection Execution**
  * Quality user attends inspection requests individually. 
  * **Rejection Handling Logic:**
    * RT/UT parallel: If one fails → both rejected → regenerate next iteration. Next offer requires PT/MT confirmation. 
    * MT fails → both MT/PT rejected → regenerate next iteration. Next offer requires PT/MT confirmation. 
    * PT fails → both MT/PT rejected → regenerate next iteration. Next offer does **not** require PT/MT confirmation.

## US-23695 — Feedback of Digital Dossier

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-23695 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Nenshi Patel |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/23695) |

### Description

As a QA user or document submitter, I want an improved Digital Dossier module so that I can efficiently compile, manage, and track project documentation with enhanced usability, automation, and control. 
### Background 
The current Digital Dossier workflow has usability gaps and bugs, such as inconsistent status updates, lack of sequencing, and missing automation for completion dates. These issues impact efficiency and user experience for document management and quality assurance. The enhancements aim to address these gaps and introduce new features for a streamlined process. 
### Acceptance Criteria 
  1. **Status Management**
     * The system must save and display “Accepted” and “Returned” statuses for QA users, and “Submitted” for document submitters, consistently across all environments. 
  2. **Document Compilation**
     * Users can compile multiple uploaded documents into a single dossier file via a ‘Compile’ button. 
     * The system opens an overlay for linking documents with the index, merges selected files, and updates their status to “Compiled & Submitted”. 
  3. **File Deletion & Labeling**
     * Users can delete files that are not yet compiled. 
     * The label in the grid changes from ‘Attachment’ to ‘Action’. 
  4. **Status Filtering**
     * All folders have a status filter, defaulting to show “Not Compiled” documents. 
  5. **Sequence Management**
     * Users can set the sequence/order of records in the grid for compilation, both in uploaded and e-signed folders. 
  6. **Grid Auto-Update**
     * The grid updates automatically when a document is compiled and sent to QA. 
  7. **Compiled File Deletion & Status Reversion**
     * Users can delete compiled files, which removes them from the dossier and reverts the status of source files to “Not Compiled”. 
     * A confirmation pop-up is shown before deletion. 
  8. **Section Number Display**
     * The compiled file’s section number is displayed in the Digital Dossier tab. **Index Management Overlays**
  9.      * Overlay windows are provided for adding, copying, and importing indexes, supporting multi-selection and search. 
  10. **PDF Conversion**
     * Users can convert digitally signed documents into print-ready PDF files from the upload folder. 
  11. **Completion Date Automation & Assignment**
     * The system automatically calculates and updates expected completion dates based on project milestones (e.g., CDD/Ex Works date minus one week). 
     * “Assigned To” works for all subsections of the index. 
  12. **Non-Functional**
     * The system ensures data integrity and security (LNT Internal Use). 
     * The UI is intuitive and responsive for all user roles. 


### Out of Scope 
  * Mobile enablement is not included in this enhancement.

### Acceptance Criteria

### 1\. Status Management 
  * The system must save and display “Accepted” and “Returned” statuses in the grid for QA users, and “Submitted” status for document submitting users. 
  * Status updates must be consistent and visible in both QA and production environments. 


### 2\. Document Compilation 
  * A ‘Compile’ button is available in the ‘Upload Documents’ tab. 
  * Clicking ‘Compile’ opens an overlay window for linking documents with the index. 
  * Selected files are merged and sent to the ‘Digital Dossier’ tab. 
  * Status of merged documents in ‘Uploaded Documents’ is updated to “Compiled & Submitted”. 


### 3\. File Deletion & Labeling 
  * Users can delete files from the ‘Upload Documents’ folder if their status is “Not Compiled”. 
  * The label in the grid changes from ‘Attachment’ to ‘Action’. 


### 4\. Status Filtering 
  * All folders provide a status filter. 
  * By default, the grid displays only “Not Compiled” documents. 


### 5\. Sequence Management 
  * Users can set the sequence/order of records in the grid for compilation. 
  * Sequence management is available in both uploaded documents and e-signed records folders. 


### 6\. Grid Auto-Update 
  * The grid automatically refreshes when a document is compiled and sent to QA. 


### 7\. Compiled File Deletion & Status Reversion 
  * Users can delete compiled files from the ‘Digital Dossier’ tab. 
  * Upon deletion, the system removes the compiled file and reverts the status of source files to “Not Compiled”. 
  * A confirmation pop-up is shown before deletion, with “Yes” and “No” options. 


### 8\. Section Number Display 
  * The compiled file’s section number is displayed in the ‘Digital Dossier’ tab. 


### 9\. Index Management Overlays 
  * Overlay windows are provided for “Add Index”, “Copy Index”, and “Import Index”. 
  * The “Import Index” button lists indexes from the source project. 


### 10\. PDF Conversion 
  * Users can convert digitally signed documents into print-ready PDF files from the upload document folder. 


### 11\. Completion Date Automation & Assignment 
  * The system automatically calculates the expected completion date for each index item as one week before the CDD or CDD Ex Works date. 
  * “Assigned To” functionality works for all subsections of the index section. 


### 12\. Non-Functional 
  * The system ensures data integrity and security, as the document is classified as “LNT Internal Use”. 
  * The UI is intuitive and responsive for all user roles. 


### 13\. Out of Scope 
  * Mobile enablement is not included in this enhancement.

### Description

**As a** QI2 role user  

**I want** to create or update a QAR Master record with **User PS Number** , **User Name** , and **User Initials, Stage**  
**So that** the system can correctly identify and store qualified personnel for QAR activities

### Acceptance Criteria

1. **User PS Number**
     * **Data Type:**  Alphanumeric 9 Digit 
     * **Behavior:**
       * Mandatory field. 
       * Supports search and selection from Employee Master. (Workman, MFG2, PROD3) 
       * On selection, system validates if PS Number exists in Employee Master. 
     * **Error Handling:**
       * If PS Number is invalid or not found, show error:  
_“Invalid PS Number. Please select a valid employee.”_
  2. **User Name**
     * **Behavior:**
       * Auto-fetched from Employee Master when PS Number is selected. 
       * Non-editable if PS Number is provided. 
       * Editable only if PS Number is blank. 
     * **Error Handling:**
       * If Employee Master does not return a name, show error:  
_“Name not found for the given PS Number.”_
  3. **User Initials**
     * **Data Type:** Alphanumeric 
     * **Behavior:**
       * User input field. 
       * Mandatory (if business rule requires). 
       * Maximum length: e.g., 5 characters. 
     * **Validation:**
       * Only letters and numbers allowed. 
       * No special characters. 
     * **Error Handling:**
       * If invalid characters entered, show error:  
_“Initials can only contain letters and numbers.”_
  4. **Inspection Stage**
     * **Data Type:**  Alphanumeric 8 Character 
     * **Behavior:**
       * User selection (Multiselecting). 
       * Selection shall be fetched from stage master(QMS002). 
  



* * *
#### **Additional Notes**
  * All three fields should appear together in the **QAR Master maintenance screen**. 
  * Duplication check should consider **PS Number + Name combination**. 
  * Audit trail: Created By and Created On should be auto-fetched.
