           * Length limit (max 100 characters). 
    * **Buttons:**
      * **Upload:**
        * Upload the captured photo/video to the selected project folder with the given file name. 
        * Show progress indicator during upload. 
        * Display success/failure message. 
      * **Retake:**
        * Navigate back to camera screen for retake. 
      * **Close:**
        * Exit the workflow for the same project and return to camera screen 1. 


### ****
### **Functionality Flow**
  1. Capture photo/video → Confirm → Navigate to next screen. 
  2. Load project list from backend or local cache. 
  3. User selects project number and enters file name. 
  4. On **Upload** : 
     * Validate inputs. 
     * Call API to upload file to corresponding project folder. 
     * Handle success/failure gracefully. 
  5. On **Retake** : 
     * Clear current media and return to camera screen. 
  6. On **Close** : 
     * Discard media and return to home screen. 


### **Technical Considerations**
  * **API Integration:**
    * Endpoint to fetch project list. 
    * Endpoint to upload media file with metadata (project no., file name). 
  * **UI/UX:**
    * Responsive design for mobile and tablet. 
    * Ensure buttons are clearly visible and accessible. 
  * **Error Handling:**
    * Network failures. 
    * Invalid file name. 
    * Empty project selection. 
  * **Performance:**
    * Optimize upload for large video files limit would for 2minutes with count down. 
    * Show progress bar for uploads. 


### **Acceptance Criteria**
  1. New screen appears after photo/video capture confirmation. 
  2. Project dropdown loads correctly from project document folder. 
  3. File name field accepts valid input. 
  4. Upload button successfully uploads media with metadata. 
  5. Retake and Close buttons work as expected. 
  6. No crashes or UI glitches on mobile (6.5") and tablet (7").

## US-24227 — Add “Move to Folder” Button to Transfer Media from Camera Roll to Department Folder

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24227 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24227) |

### Description

**As a** user (or any user within the same department),  

**I want** a **Move to Folder** button on the camera roll screen,  
**So that** I can move captured photos/videos from the camera roll to my department’s designated folder.

### Acceptance Criteria

* **Current Behavior:**
    * Users can capture photos/videos and upload them, but there is no option to move existing media from the camera roll to a department folder. 
  * **New Requirement:**
    * Add a **Move to Folder** button alongside existing options (e.g., Upload, Delete). 
    * The logic for **Move to Folder** should follow similar steps as the **Delete** button, but instead of removing the file, it transfers it to the selected department folder. 

  

### **UI Changes:**
  * On the media management screen: 
    * Display **Move to Folder** button near Add New Folder and Upload Files buttons. 
    * Ensure consistent styling and accessibility. 
  * When **Move to Folder** is clicked: 
    * Show a **folder selection dialog** : 
      * Fetch list of department folders from backend. 
      * Allow user to select the target folder. 
    * Confirm action before moving the file. 


### **Functionality Flow:**
  1. User selects media from camera roll. 
  2. Clicks **Move to Folder**. 
  3. System displays folder selection dropdown (department folders). 
  4. User selects folder and confirms. 
  5. System: 
     * Validates permissions (user belongs to department). 
     * Moves file from camera roll to selected folder. 
     * Updates metadata and file path in database. 
  6. Show success/failure message. 


### **Technical Considerations:**
  * **API Integration:**
    * Endpoint to fetch department folders. 
    * Endpoint to move file (update file location in storage and database). 
  * **Permissions:**
    * Validate user department before allowing move. 
  * **Error Handling:**
    * Network failures. 
    * Invalid folder selection. 
    * File not found. 
  * **Performance:**
    * Optimize for large files. 
    * Ensure atomic operation (move + update metadata). 


### **Acceptance Criteria:**
  1. **Move to Folder** button is visible and functional. 
  2. Folder selection dropdown loads department folders correctly. 
  3. File moves successfully and is no longer in camera roll. 
  4. Permissions are enforced (only same department users can move). 
  5. No crashes or UI glitches during operation.

## US-24405 — Unlock Action & Owner Selection

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24405 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | NIKHIL JAIN |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24405) |

### Description

**As a**  user  
**I want** to lock a group via an icon next to Group Name and select one or more Group Owners  
**So that** the group’s ownership and locked state are controlled, auditable, and owners can later manage the owner list

### Acceptance Criteria

## FR 
  * FR-1.1: Add an Unlock icon button beside the Group Name on the group creation page. Anyone can lock the group; the system logs who locked it. 
  * FR-1.2: On clicking Unlock: 
    * Add a pop-up with 2 fields (FR-1.4) multi-select dropdown of employees in Group Owners. 
    * Allow picking multiple users from the active user directory. 
    * On Save, the page state changes and shows a Lock icon. 
  * FR-1.3: A group is considered Locked only when locked by one (initiating) user; log who and when it changed to locked. 
  * FR-1.4: Maintain 4 fields: Group Owners (list), Locked/Unlocked (boolean), Locked By (user), Locked At (DateTime). 
  * FR-1.5: Once the group is locked, only Group Owners can add/remove owners. 


## Key Assumptions & Clarifications 
  1. Visibility & Permissions 
     * “Anyone can lock” means any authenticated user with access to create/edit this group can perform the initial lock. 
     * After locking, only Group Owners can modify the owners list (FR-1.5). 
  2. UI Icon State 
     * Initial state: Unlock icon shown (group is unlocked). 
     * After successful locking: icon toggles to Lock icon. 
  3. Owner Selection 
     * Multiple owners can be selected at lock time. 
     * At least one owner is required to lock (derived from FR-1.2 multi-select intent). 
  4. Audit 
     * Log Locked By (the user who clicked Save on the lock), and Locked At (server time). 
     * Maintain system audit trail for subsequent owner changes (added/removed by which owner and when). 
  5. Directory Source 
     * “Active user directory” is assumed to be the platform’s current active user list (e.g., AD/AAD/DB). 
     * Only active users are selectable. 
  6. Group Creation vs Edit 
     * Locking can occur on the creation page and on edit page when unlocked. 
     * Once locked, the lock state is not changed as part of this story (only owners list updates are allowed by owners). 


##  UX Behavior & Flow 
### Placement 
  * Icon: An Unlock icon (e.g., 🔓) placed inline to the right of the Group Name field label or input. 
  * Tooltip text: 
    * Unlock icon: “Click to lock this group and assign owners.” 
    * Lock icon: “Group is locked. Owners can manage ownership.” 


### Lock Action (from Unlock icon) 
  1. User clicks Unlock icon. 
  2. Modal pops up: “Assign Group Owners”
     * Component: Multi-select dropdown 
     * Source: Active user directory (searchable) 
     * Validation: At least 1 user required 
  3. Buttons: Save (primary), Cancel (secondary) 


### Owner Management (post-lock) 
  * Editable Owners field (multi-select) visible only to current owners. 
  * Non-owners see this field as read-only (chips/list). 
  * Allow add/remove owners with Save and auditable events.

## US-24412 — Auto‑Flag and Restrict When Linked Shop DIN Is Revised or DCR Raised

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24412 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Mandar Kamde |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24412) |

### Description

As a **PLNG3** user, I want impacted **Index** rows to be clearly flagged and issuing restricted whenever any **linked Shop DIN** is revised/released or a **DCR** is created, so that I’m forced to review changes before proceeding.

### Acceptance Criteria

When a linked Shop DIN is **revised and released** or **any DCR** is created for it, the system **red‑highlights** the affected Index row, shows a **“Review Required”** hyperlink, and **restricts issuing**. The hyperlink opens a pop‑up with revised Shop DIN/DCR details and allows the user to decide **Revise** or **Keep as is** (mandatory comment). 
**Note:**
  * The BRD mentions visibility/ownership by **PMG** in some places and **PLNG3** in others. Reviewer role to be **confirmed** ; this story assumes **PLNG3**. 
  * Issuance restriction applies until **all impacted Index rows** in the same Planning DIN are reviewed. 


**Acceptance Criteria:**
  * **Trigger:** If any **linked Shop DIN** is revised/released **OR** any **DCR** is created for it, the associated Index row becomes **red‑highlighted**. 
  * A **“Review Required”** hyperlink (blue, underlined) appears on the impacted row; **tooltip:** “Linked Shop DIN revised. Click to review.” 
  * Impacted Index is **hidden** from non‑authorized users; hyperlink visible only to the **reviewer role** (PLNG3; role to be confirmed). 
  * **Restrictions:**
    * PLNG3 **cannot issue** any document in the Planning DIN until review is complete for all impacted rows. 
    * PLNG3 **cannot revise** a red‑highlighted row before completing the review. 
  * **Review Pop‑up:** Opens with **Shop DIN details** and **DCR info** ; actions: **Revise** or **Keep as is**. 
  * If **Keep as is** , a **mandatory comment** is required; if **Revise** , proceed to revision workflow. 
  * On decision, **red highlight** is **removed** ; status updates to **Revised** or **No Revision**. 
  * **Error Handling:** On failure to submit decision, show: “Unable to update status. Please retry.”

## US-24416 — Highlight and QAR Confirmation for Hold/Witness Seams

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24416 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | CHANDRASHEKHAR VENKANNA |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24416) |

### Description

**As a** PROD3 user  

**I want** seams in stages where intervention type is **Hold**  to be highlighted in Pink and where intervention type is **Witness  **to be highlighted in Yellow.  
**So that** I can easily identify seams requiring special attention before submitting under QAR.

### Acceptance Criteria

* 

**Highlighting Logic**
  * If a seam’s intervention type description in any intervention (1st to 6th) = contain **Hold or H** , then: 
    * The corresponding row in the seam list should be highlighted in **Pink**. 
  * If a seam’s intervention type description in any intervention (1st to 6th) = contain **Witness** , then: 
    * The corresponding row in the seam list should be highlighted in **Yellow**. 
  * If a seam’s intervention type description in any intervention (1st to 6th) = contain **Witness or Hold or H** , then: 
    * Give priority to **Hold or H.  **
    * The corresponding row in the seam list should be highlighted in **Pink**. 


* **Pop-up Trigger**
  * When the user attempts to submit a **yellow-highlighted or pink-highlighted seam under QAR** , show a pop-up with message:  
**“** This stage is <Witness> stage for <Customer Representative1>, <Hold> stage for <Customer Representative2>, …. 
Have you offered this stage and obtained clearance from <Customer Representative1>,<Customer Representative2>,…..  for this stage? 
**”**


* **Pop-up Options**
  * **Yes** : 
    * Sets **Under QAR = Yes** for that seam. 
    * Close the pop-up. 
  * **No** : 
    * Resets **Under QAR = No** for that seam. 
    * Close the pop-up. 


* **Validation**
  * Pop-up must appear **only for yellow-highlighted seams or pink-highlighted seams  **when user selects Under QAR = Yes. 
  * If user does not confirm, Under QAR remains **No**. 


* **UI/UX**
  * Yellow highlight should be visually distinct but not distracting. 
  * Pop-up should be modal, centered, with clear message and two buttons: 
    * **Yes**(primary, Green) 
    * **No**(secondary, Red) 
  * Pop-up closes automatically after user action. 


*

## US-24437 — Maintain Group Master (Create Groups, Update Group Lead, View Change History)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24437 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Bhumika Sahu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24437) |

### Description

**As an**  User  
**I want** to create groups, assign/update a Group Lead, and view the change history  
**So that** groups are consistently maintained, and any updates to Group Lead are traceable and auditable.

### Acceptance Criteria

### AC1: Create Group 
  * **Given** I am on the Group Master page 
  * **When** I click **Add** and enter `Group Name` (≤ 20 chars, non-empty) and `Group Lead` (valid PS No.) 
  * **Then** the system **creates** the group 
  * **And** persists the record with Group Name immutable 
  * **And** captures an initial history entry: 
    * `Last Modified By = creator’s PS No.`
    * `Effective From = creation timestamp`
    * `Effective To = null` (open-ended) 


### AC2: Validate Group Name 
  * **Reject** empty or whitespace-only input 
  * **Reject** names exceeding **20 characters**
  * **Reject** exact duplicate **Group Name** (case-insensitive) 


### AC3: Validate Group Lead 
  * **Reject** blank Group Lead 
  * **Reject** invalid / non-existent PS No. (must exist in Employee Data) 
  * **Optional** : warn if PS No. is inactive, but allow if business approves 


### AC4: Edit Group Lead Only 
  * **Given** a group exists 
  * **When** I click **Edit**
  * **Then** only **Group Lead** is editable 
  * **And** **Group Name** is **read-only** (no deletion/edit) 


### AC5: Audit Trail on Group Lead Change 
  * **When** Group Lead is changed 
  * **Then** system: 
    * Closes the previous version by setting **Effective To = now**
    * Creates a new history row with: 
      * `Last Modified By` = current user’s PS No. 
      * `Effective From = now`
      * `Effective To = null`


### AC6: View History 
  * **When** I click **View** for a group 
  * **Then** show a table with historical entries (**most recent first**) containing: 
    * `Group Lead (PS No.)`
    * `Last Modified By (PS No.)`
    * `Effective From (Date-Time)`
    * `Effective To (Date-Time or blank if current)`


### AC7: Concurrency Control 
  * If two users try to edit the same group simultaneously: 
    * The second save must **fail gracefully** with a message:  
“This record was updated by {PS No.} at {timestamp}. Please refresh and try again.” 
    * Use optimistic concurrency (row version / updated at check)
  
  
---

  * Group dropdown should fetch active groups from Group Master table

  * Sort alphabetically for usability.

## US-24486 — Create a page to manage API configuration details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24486 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Komal Chandolure |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\IEMQS-SAP-Integration |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24486) |

### Description

**As a** system administrator  
**I want to** create a new page with fields to store API configuration details  
**So that** I can manage and update API settings easily for integration purposes

### Acceptance Criteria

### **Fields with Data Types**
  1. **API URL** – _String_ (Mandatory) 
  2. **Method** – _String_ (Allowed values: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) 
  3. **AuthType** – _String_ (Allowed values: API Key, Bearer Token, Basic Auth) 
  4. **Key** – _String_ (Visible if AuthType = API Key) 
  5. **Value** – _String_ (Visible if AuthType = API Key) 
  6. **Token** – _String_ (Visible if AuthType = Bearer Token) 
  7. **Username** – _String_ (Visible if AuthType = Basic Auth) 
  8. **Password** – _String (Encrypted)_ (Visible if AuthType = Basic Auth) 
  9. **RequestType** – _String_ (Allowed values: JSON, XML, Form-Data) 
  10. **IsActive** – _Boolean_ (Checkbox) 
  11. **ModifiedBy** – _String_ (Auto-populated with current user) 
  12. **ModifiedOn** – _DateTime_ (Auto-populated with current timestamp) 


* * *
### **Validation Rules**
  * **API URL** : Mandatory, must be a valid URL format 
  * **Method** : Mandatory, must be one of the allowed values 
  * **AuthType** : Mandatory, controls visibility of related fields 
  * **Password** : Must be stored securely (hashed/encrypted) 
  * **ModifiedOn** : System-generated, cannot be edited

o Department Head (DH)

 \- User need to provide the required  editable fields in separate section will be displayed in the Rehiring page, such as  

          \- Cadre 'dropdown' (from cadre master )  

          \- Department 'dropdown' (from department master)  

          \- Rejoining date 'date picker'  

          \- Basic 'number'  

  

\- All these data will be fetched from workforce information based on the old PS No.  

\- All the below details will be displayed to the user, when the user clicks on edit icon, the user will be able to edit the data.  

\- Edit icon will be available for each section, when edit icon is clicked only the fields related to the particular section will become editable text field, all the other sections and fields will be kept non editable.  

  

Fields that will be displayed for the rehiring apart from the four mandatory fields are attached in the link.  

  

\- After filling the required values and the mandatory fields,  user need to click the Submit button, so that request will be sent to the IR Approver for approval and message displays 'Rehiring process has been successfully submitted'.   

  

 \- User need to click 'Okay' button in the popup message to redirect to the "onboarding review Overview" page.  

  

 \- User need to click on the Cancel button, then user will navigate to the previous page.

### Acceptance Criteria

Upon logging in to the application the user will be navigated to the IR dashboard, from the dashboard the user can click on the hamburger menu to open the side navigation.  

   

\- from the side navigation page user need to select the 'Onboarding Overview' sub menu from the 'Onboarding' menu.  

   

'Onboarding Overview' page will be displayed with the respective tabs.  

\- All  

\- Quick Onboarding  

\- Rehiring  

\- Full Onboarding

User can able to view the list of all the details of the requests in the grid.  

Data grid:  

 \- PS no   

 \- Name   

 \- Employment Type   

 \- Dept Code   

 \- Immediate Supervisor  

 \- Date of Joining   

 \- Submitted On  

 \- Approved On   

 \- Onboarding Type ('Quick Onboarding', 'Rehiring', 'Full   Onboarding')  

 \- Status

Search Bar  

 \- The User should be able to search the respective request using the search bar.  

  

Page Navigation

o Approved  

o Completed  

o Returned

 \- Submitted on: for quick onboarding and rehiring type - the date when the IR submitted the request for IR approver’s approval.

## US-24549 — IR - Bulk Upload - View and select bulk upload option

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24549 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies\Iteration 1 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24549) |

### Description

As an Industrial Relation, I want to be able to view the Bulk Upload page so that I can upload the bulk upload document

### Acceptance Criteria

\- From the IR dashboard, the user need to select the side navigation page.
 \- from the side navigation page user need to select the 'Bulk Upload' sub menu from the 'Onboarding' menu.  

 \- 'Bulk Upload' page will be displayed with the following card option.  

   

List  of Cards:  

 \- Bulk Onboarding 'Upload File'  

 \- Bulk Update 'Upload File'  

 \- Bulk Image upload 
 \- Bulk Document upload 
  

Buttons:  

 \- Download Template  

  

User will be able to upload document (excel file) and perform the following action in bulk such as  

 \- Quick onboarding of workmen  

 \- Rehiring of workmen  

 \- Updating workmen detail  

 \- Separation  

  

User will be able to view a dropdown with the following options in the bulk onboarding option is selected,  

\- Quick onboarding   

\- Rehiring  

  

Based on the selection from the dropdown the list of entities and fields related to the selection will be displayed to the user,  

\- If user selects Quick onboarding, all the respective quick onboarding fields will be displayed to the user.  

\- If the user select rehiring all the entities related to full onboarding will be displayed.  

  

Validation:  

\- When user selects quick onboarding all the mandatory fields should be auto selected in the checkbox and user should not be able to change it.  

\- When the user selects Rehiring the respective mandatory fields should be auto selected in the checkbox and user should not be able to change it.   

\- Cadre   

\- Department  

\- Rejoining date  

\- Basic  

All the other fields apart from these mandatory fields will be displayed to the user and they will be able to select it based on requirement.  

  

 \- User can upload document (excel file) by drag & drop and by clicking on the upload button, user can upload file.  

  

Validations:  

 \-  Error message is displayed in popup in case the character of the fields is above max limit or invalid, or when mandatory field is missing in the excel file.  

 \- After validation the system will assign sequential PS numbers in the background to the employee.   

 \- Example: if the previous PS No ended at 125, and if IR bulk uploads 30 employee data, then the employee would receive PS numbers from 126 through 155 sequentially.  

 \- After upload, the system generates a downloadable Excel file that lists each employee’s name, assigned PS number, and any additional configured fields (configurable at runtime).

### Description

As an Industrial Relation, I want to be able to fetch the Bulk image Upload, so that I store the images in the file directory

### Acceptance Criteria

List of Attributes: 
\- Upload 'button'    

  

\- when the user clicks on the upload button, user will be able to upload the URL of all the images.    

\- System should capture the URL and save all the data in the file directory.   

  

Buttons:  

 \- Save  

 \- Cancel  

   

 \- user need to click the save button to save the data.  

 \- user need to click on the Cancel button, then user will navigate to the previous page  

  

**Note:  
**
When a bulk photo upload is triggered, the system will search/fetch for photos in the specified location. Users should store all photos in that location, ensuring each photo is named with a **unique identifier** corresponding to the PS number. The system will then extract the PS number from the photo name and update the record by associating it with the respective photo. Example if PS number 123456 then name of photo file should be 123456.JPG.   

  

Photos download functionality will be there. Photos can download as per department, all photos or uploaded PS number through excel. Bulk photos should download in zip folder

### Description

As an Industrial Relation Approver, I want to view all the request so that I can view respective details by clicking on it.

### Acceptance Criteria

\- From the IR Approver dashboard, the user need to select the side navigation page.  

 \- In the side navigation page user need to select the 'Onboarding Approval' menu.  

 \- 'Onboarding Approval' page will be displayed with the following tabs.  

  

 The user need view the three tabs in the 'Onboarding Approval' such as 'All', 'Pending', 'Approved'.  

 \- User need to click on the 'All' tab  

User can able to view the list of all the requests in the grid.  

  

Data grid  

 \- All Select 'Checkbox'  

 \- PS no   

 \- Name   

 \- Employment type   

 \- Dept code   

 \- Immediate supervisor  

 \- Date of joining   

 \- Submitted on   

 \- Onboarding type  

 \- Status  

   

Button  

 \- Approve  

 \- Reject  

 \- Export  

  

 \- User can select all the list by clicking on “All select – checkbox”   

 \- User need to click on the approve button, pop-up message displays 'Data approved successful'.  

 \- user need to click Export button, when the data is exported pop up message displays 'Data Exported Successfully'.  

  

\- ‘PS No/Name’ hyperlink will be displayed in the grid view and by clicking on the respective request, user will be directed to the workmen details approval page.   

  

Search Bar  

 \- The User should be able to search the  respective request using the search bar.  

  

Page Navigation  

 \- The User should be able to navigate to other pages using the page navigation.  

  

Validations:  

 \- system will generate the PS number for quick onboarding and rehiring process only after approval from IR approver.   

 \- User can select multiple request and can approve in the bulk count  

 \- PS no: The PS no will be displayed based on these status such as 'Pending',  'Approved',  'Returned'.   

 \- Pending: waiting for the approval from the IR approver.  

 \- Approved: IR approver approved the onboarding process.   

 \- Returned: IR approver returned the onboarding or rehiring process.  

 \- Submitted on: The date when the IR submitted the quick onboarding or rehiring of the employee for IR approver’s approval.

## US-24574 — IR Approver - Onboarding approval - Approve/reject employee details in Employee overview page

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24574 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies\Iteration 1 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24574) |

### Description

As an Industrial Relation Approver, I want to click on the respective request so that I can view workmen details approval page and process the request.

### Acceptance Criteria

The user will be navigated to request view page upon clicking the PS no or Name in the following tab (all and pending).  

  

 \- User will be able to view all the details of the employee that was captured during the quick onboarding or rehiring will be auto populated in separate sections.   

 \- User will be able to approve the employee onboarding by clicking approve button.  

 \- A pop will be displayed when approval is successful with the message such as “Approval successful”  

 \- User will be able to reject the employee onboarding by clicking reject button.  

 \- A pop will be displayed with the message such as “Do you want to reject employee onboarding?”  

 \- When the user clicks Yes button in the pop up, the onboarding process will be returned, and the user will be redirected to the onboarding approval page.  

 \- When the user clicks No button in the pop up, the onboarding process will not be returned, and the user will stay in the workmen details approval page.

### Description

****
**As a** product/integration consumer in the IEMQS system, 
  
**I want** a standardized SQL view named **`COM010`** that reads directly from the **MDM** data table **`tltibd901175`** ,** ** so that all modules in IEMQS can consistently and securely consume material master data without duplication or inconsistent access patterns.

### Acceptance Criteria

* The IEMQS system must fetch Material Master data exclusively from SQL view **COM010**. 
* All modules that require material data should use this view. 
* The SQL view should provide: 
  * Material Number 
  * Description 
  * Product 
  * Material Category 
  * Specific Gravity   

  * Item Group 
  * Density

### Description

**As a** SAP/CPI Integration Engineer  
**I want** the existing Project and Deliverables creation APIs to accept **multiple records in a single request**  
**So that** we can minimize the number of API calls and reduce **CPI token usage** , improving throughput and reliability. 
  

## In-Scope Endpoints (Existing) 
  1. **Project Creation**  
`POST https://phzpdiemqsweb.lthed.com/api/DESLN/AddProject`
  2. **Project Deliverables Creation**
     * `POST https://phzpdiemqsweb.lthed.com/api/DESLN/AddPart`
     * `POST https://phzpdiemqsweb.lthed.com/api/DESLN/AddBOM`


[](https://phzpdiemqsweb.lthed.com/api/DESLN/AddBOM)

### Acceptance Criteria

**Request Body** and **Response Body** shall have multiple as JSON array based on primary key and it's status.

## US-24715 — SAP Outbound - Get Contract Deliverables

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-24715 |
| State | Closed |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | CHANDRASHEKHAR VENKANNA |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\IEMQS-SAP-Integration |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/24715) |

### Description

****
**As an**  integration consumer in the IEMQS system, 
  

ASIS  
Get contract deliverables from **tltpdm105175, tltpdm105175, tltpdm105175, ttppdm600175 (ERPLN Tables)  **
  

TOBE 
Get contract deliverables from **DES066 and DES067 (IEMQS Tables)**  

**  
**
**  
**
**SP Name:** SP_FKMS_GET_PARENTNODE_BY_PROJECT
 
select 
a.t_cono, a.t_cprj, ltrim(case c.t_item when '' then c.t_nitm else c.t_item end) parent, d.t_dsca parentdesc,  c.t_pono ParPono, ltrim(case a.t_item when '' then a.t_nitm else a.t_item end) t_item,  a.t_pono, a.t_edes,  a.t_qnty, a.t_unit, a.t_igrp, a.t_amno, a.t_mdel
from 
[LNENTREP].[lnapppddb].dbo.tltpdm105175 a with(Nolock) 
Join  (select bb.t_cono, max(bb.t_amno) t_amno from [LNENTREP].[lnapppddb].dbo.tltpdm105175 bb with(nolock) group by bb.t_cono) b on a.t_cono = b.t_cono and a.t_amno = b.t_amno left join  [LNENTREP].[lnapppddb].dbo.tltpdm105175 c with (nolock) on a.t_cono = c.t_cono and b.t_amno = c.t_amno and a.t_cprj = c.t_cprj and c.t_ityp = 2 left join [LNENTREP].[lnapppddb].dbo.ttppdm600175 d with (nolock) on a.t_cprj = d.t_cprj
where 
a.t_ityp in (1) and a.t_cprj ='S040935'

### Acceptance Criteria

* The IEMQS system must fetch contract deliverables from IEMQS tables (**DES066** & **DES067**) only instead of ERPLN tables. 
*

Y-RING Sub Assembly |  S040911-Y-R0016SUB-ASM |  22 |  S040911-Y-0016SA |  16  
Y-RING Internal Sub Assembly |  S040911-Y-R0017INT-SUB-ASM |  26 |  S040911-Y-0017I-SA |  18  
Y-RING External Sub Assembly |  S040911-Y-R0018EXT-SUB-ASM |  26 |  S040911-Y-0018E-SA |  18

### Acceptance Criteria

****
  1. Item codes generated during node creation in FKMS must be restricted to a maximum of 18 characters.
  2. The logic in IEMQS should be updated to enforce this restriction across **Sections, Assembly, Sub-assembly, and related structures**. 
  3. Any item code exceeding 18 characters should be automatically truncated or handled as per the agreed logic. 
  4. The system should ensure compatibility with SAP material code requirements. 
  5. Testing must validate that both existing and newly generated item codes comply with the 18-character limit. 


  

****
**Notes:**
  * This change is driven by SAP’s material code character limitation. 
  * Impact analysis should be performed to confirm no disruption in the new FKMS system.

## US-25662 — Additional Work on NuBAL

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-25662 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 1 |
| Assigned To | Nenshi Patel |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/25662) |

### Description

Data Not Captured in Manually Updated Fields for Manual LTFPS in NuBAL 
  

We have recently observed that data entered into the **manually updated fields** for **Manual LTFPS** is **not being captured or saved** in the NuBAL system. Although users are able to input values and save the record, the entered data does not persist and is missing upon refresh or subsequent access. 
This issue impacts the accuracy and completeness of Manual LTFPS records and may lead to data inconsistencies and reporting gaps. 
### **Steps to Reproduce**
  1. Log in to the IEMQS system 
  2. Navigate to the NuBAL--> Generate BAL---> Project No: S020050G 
  3. Enter data into the manually LTFPS 
  4. Save the record

### Acceptance Criteria

**AC1: Data Persistence on Save**
  * **Given** a user is on the Manual LTFPS screen in the NuBAL system 
  * **When** the user enters valid data into all manually updated fields and clicks **Save**
  * **Then** the entered data must be successfully saved and stored in the system 


* * *
**AC2: Data Retention After Refresh**
  * **Given** a Manual LTFPS record has been saved with manually entered field values 
  * **When** the user refreshes the page 
  * **Then** all manually updated field values must remain populated and unchanged 


* * *
**AC3: Data Visibility on Reopen**
  * **Given** a Manual LTFPS record has been saved 
  * **When** the user navigates away and reopens the same record 
  * **Then** all manually updated field values must be displayed correctly 


* * *
**AC4: No Data Loss on Edit and Resave**
  * **Given** a saved Manual LTFPS record with manually entered data 
  * **When** the user edits the record and saves it again 
  * **Then** the updated values must overwrite the previous values and persist correctly 


* * *
**AC5: Backend Data Capture Validation**
  * **Given** a Manual LTFPS record is saved 
  * **When** the record is validated at the database or API level 
  * **Then** all manually updated fields must be correctly captured and stored 


* * *
**AC6: Error-Free Save Operation**
  * **Given** the user saves a Manual LTFPS record with manually entered data 
  * **Then** the system must not display any validation, save, or system errors related to these fields

## US-25684 — IR -  Attendance - Maintain shift schedule

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-25684 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/25684) |

### Description

As an IR, I want to view the Maintain Shift Scheduling Plan details so that I can easily review the details.

### Acceptance Criteria

From the side navigation page user need to select the 'Maintain Shift Scheduling Plan' sub menu from the 'Attendance Management' menu.  

  

 \- 'Maintain Shift Scheduling Plan' page will be displayed.  

   

Attributes:  

 \- Shift Code* (shift code for every week fetched from shit code master)  

Based on the shift code selection, system should automatically display the from and to date of the week  

 \- From (DD-MM-YYYY)   

 \- To (DD-MM-YYYY)  

  

Grid Columns:  

 \- Employee (PS No and Employee Name) 'drop down' (fetched from workforce management)  

 \- Dept code and Shop Name (fetched from department code master)  

 \- Cadre (fetched from cadre master)   

 \- Category (fetched from category code master)   

 \- Shift (shift details will be fetched from the shift master)   

 \- Shift plan (fetched from shift rotation master)  

                     \- Monday  

                     \- Tuesday  

                     \- Wednesday  

                     \- Thursday  

                     \- Friday  

                     \- Saturday  

                     \- Sunday    

 \- Supervisor (will be auto populated based on dept. code)   

 \- TPT user (yes/no) (fetched from workforce info)  

 \- Last modified by (Displayed ad PS no, Name and Date) (the Shop person who modified the shift)   

 \- Action (edit icon button)   

 \- multi select check box for the user to select multiple employee details.   

  

Buttons:  

 \- Save  

 \- Export  

  

When the user clicks on the edit icon the following fields will be editable in the data grid,  

 \- Shift (shift details will be fetched from the shift master)   

 \- Shift plan (fetched from shift rotation master)  

                     \- Monday  

                     \- Tuesday  

                     \- Wednesday  

                     \- Thursday  

                     \- Friday  

                     \- Saturday  

                     \- Sunday   

  

Validation:  

\-  User will be able to change the shift for a selected date displayed on the table.   

\- When the user changes the "shift" column, then the shift details should be changed for the entire days displayed in the table. (eg., if the user changes the shift of an employee in the table from shift "II" to shift "I", the the shift plan for the all the days (Monday to Sunday, which ever applicable) should be changed automatically.  

\- When making the changes, system should make sure that the user is able to change the shifts only which are applicable to the user based on the shift rotation, all the other field entry should be restricted.     

  

Logics:  

\- System will automatically release the shift plan to the shop users based on the lock in period scheduled by the admin users.    

\-  Every week, as per the scheduled day and time, the shift plan will be released to the user. During this period the IR will not have any provision to edit the shift plans or schedule any pattern for any work man.   

\- IR will be able to make changes to the shift plan on any day apart from the Scheduled lock in period days.  

\-  User will be able to select multiple details in the data grid and change the scheduling patter for the selected users when clicking the "schedule shift" button.  

  

Search Bar:  

 \- The User should be able to search the respective request using the Column Search Bar and Global Search Bar.  

  

Page Navigation:  

 \- The User should be able to navigate to other pages using the page navigation.  

  

Validation:  

 \- The system should fetch the shift schedule plan from the shift rotation master and display the shift plan for each day in their respective columns.      

  

 \- If user click on the edit icon, user can able to edit the values such as in the respective row then the user need to click on the save button to save the changes in the existing page.  

  

 \- If user click on the save button, the edited changes need to changed and pop-up message need to be displayed  as 'Changes have been saved successfully'.

## US-25685 — IR -  Attendance - Maintain shift schedule

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-25685 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/25685) |

### Description

As an IR, I want to edit the Shift Scheduling Plan details so that I can review the details.

### Acceptance Criteria

When the user clicks on the "schedule shift" button, the following details will be displayed in a popup  

  

 \- List of employee (PS no and name) which was selected by the user before clicking the schedule shift button  

  

Fields:  

\- Shift pattern (fetched from shift rotation master and workforce info based on the shift type of the employee)  

\- Start date (date picker)   

\- End date (date picker)  

\- Forever  

\- Pattern week (drop down with the list of the pattern for the weeks in the current month, eg, week 1, week 2 , week 3, till week 5 based on te shift rotation pattern)  

  

Data grid:  

\- Rotation type (rotation shift weeks which was are displayed in the pattern week drop down will be displayed here).  

\- Monday to Sunday (display all the shift plan assigned for each day. Fetched from work force info and shift master)  

  

  

High points:  

\- Shift pattern: This is the rotational pattern of the shift (Eg., If a user has Shift pattern as I-III-II, this means that the user will be on the particular shift for a week like Shift I in week 1, in third shift in week 2 and second shift in week 3. This shift pattern will start when the user is onboarded - Based on the onboarding date) (Fetched from shift rotation master and workforce info)  

\- Start pattern on and Pattern week: This is the weeks of the pattern, In which week of the current months the shifts are patterned will be displayed (eg., If a month has 5 weeks and the current shift pattern is on week 3 to week  5, then system will display those three weeks in the drop down).  

  

The user will be able to save the shift plan by clicking the schedule shift button.   

The user will be able to revert the changes by clicking on the cancel button.  

  

\- Once the user selects any of the option and clicks on the schedule shift button, the following message should be displayed     

once the user saves the plan a message will be displayed as  

  

For option 1: “Shift plan successfully changed for one day”   

For option 2: “Shift plan successfully changed for current week only from DD-MM-YYYY to DD-MM-YYYY”   

For option 3: “New shift rotation will be carried forward for the workman from DD-MM-YYYY to "Forever"".   

  

  

Validation:  

\- the user will be able to change the shift plan by selecting the from date and to date.   

\- The user will be able to change the shift only for the selected week not for every week when they choose the start date and end date.  

\- the user will be able to change the shift for any number of days based on the start date and end date selection. System should not restrict the user to select the shift only for the given week, it can be for "n" number of days based on "Start date" and "End date".  

\- When the user selects the start date and clicks on "Forever" but, then system should change the shift patter for the employee from the start date and should follow the same shift pattern will the end of the employee's worktime in the organization.

## US-25695 — User - Attendance - Maintain Regular timecard - date view

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-25695 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/25695) |

### Description

As a user, I want to view the Maintain Timecard details based on Date (Log-in and Log-out) so that I can easily review timecard entries for a specific day or date range.

### Acceptance Criteria

From the side navigation page user need to select the 'Maintain Timecard' sub menu from the 'Attendance Management' menu. \- 'Maintain Regular Timecard' page will be displayed with the following tabs such as 'Date View', 'Employee View'. \- By default, user will view the 'Date View' tab. Attributes: \- Date* 'date picker' Grid Columns: \- Employee (PS No and Employee Name) (fetched from info comm) \- TRT No (fetched from info comm - punching machine number) \- In (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - punch in time) \- Out (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - punch out time) \- Late (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - time calculated after start time of the actual shift) \- Early (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - time calculated before end time of the actual shift) \- Reg. Shift \- Actual Shift \- Employee status (Direct/indirect) (fetched from workforce information) \- Cadre (fetced from workforce information) \- Leave Remarks (fetched from "Leave remarks" master) Buttons: \- Save \- Export Search Bar: \- The User should be able to search the respective request using the Column search bar and Global Search Bar. Page Navigation: \- The User should be able to navigate to other pages using the page navigation. Validations: \- Default : In the grid view the user should able to view the punching data of the completed date and time (previous day and current day till shift 3 end). System should run a scheduler to fetch this data every morning around 9.30 am from the infocomm API. \- If user choose the 'Date' then the data related to that date will be displayed in the grid. If the user does not choose any date, then the data for the current date when the user is logged in should be displayed by default. \- In and out: Punch in and punch out time in Mins and Hours (Mins: 120 mins, Hours: 2:00) (eg. 484 � in mins , this is the time in mins. e.g. if in time is 08:04 then 8 * 60 min + 4 mins will be 484) \- Reg. Shift (Register): Planned shift � Fetched from "maintained shift schedule" module. It is the shift which is assigned for the workman every day. \- Act. Shift (Actual): punch in and out time of the employee calculated based on punching data. \- Timing of each shift, for auto scheduling will be captured from �Maintain shift timing master� in the backend. \- The system will consider only the first punch in and last punch out data and remove the duplicate punches and multiple punching data. \- The system will adjust the timing of the punching to the actual punch data in case of early punch in and late punch out. (ex: if workman punches in around 6:53 am for shift 1 and the shift start time is 7:00 am, then system will display the time as 6.53 am but will not pay any additional payment to the employee for that extra 7 mins, system will round off the extra time and will consider it as only 7:00 am, thus the employee will be only paid from 7:00 pm. Similarly for late punch out, if the shift time is 15:25 and the workman punches out at 15:35, then system should adjust the time to 15:25) \- If there is no Punch in and out data of the workman, then, system will consider it as absent (ABS). \- if remark is marked as ABS, it will remain ABS until the workman applies for PL or any other leave approval and get approved in the system. \- Based on the punch, leave remarks will be showed to the IR and to the employee as well (for employee it will be displayed in Kiosk). \- The system will run a schedule in real time basis and update the master card with the required punch data every day. Auto schedule will be done for yesterday's date and today's date, considering the night shift will end today.

User can save the export file to a location.

## US-25698 — Shop in charge - Attendance - Maintain Regular timecard - date view

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-25698 |
| State | New |
| Priority | 2 |
| Assigned To | Unassigned |
| Area Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Iteration Path | Workforce Management by MX Techies |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/25698) |

### Description

As an Shop In charge (IS), I want to view the Maintain Timecard details based on Date (Log-in and Log-out) so that I can easily review timecard entries for a specific day or date range.

### Acceptance Criteria

From the side navigation page user need to select the 'Maintain Timecard' sub menu from the 'Attendance Management' menu. \- 'Maintain Regular Timecard' page will be displayed with the following tabs such as 'Date View', 'Employee View'. \- By default, user will view the 'Date View' tab. Date view: Attributes: \- Date* 'date picker' Buttons: \- Export Grid Columns: \- Employee (PS No and Employee Name) (fetched from info comm) \- TRT No (fetched from info comm - punching machine number) \- In (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - punch in time) \- Out (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - punch out time) \- Late (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - time calculated after start time of the actual shift) \- Early (HH:MM) (fetched from info comm - time calculated before end time of the actual shift) \- Reg. Shift \- Actual Shift \- leave Remarks (fetched from leave remarks master) \- Employee status (Direct/indirect) (fetched from workforce information) \- Cadre (fetced from workforce information) Search Bar: \- The User should be able to search the respective request using the Column search bar and Global Search Bar. Page Navigation: \- The User should be able to navigate to other pages using the page navigation. Validations: \- Default : In the grid view the user should able to view the punching data of the completed date and time (previous day). The data should be refreshed on daily bases but the previous data will be stored. \- If user choose the 'From' date and 'To' date then the data related to those dates will be displayed in the grid. \- In and out: Punch in and punch out time in Mins and Hours (Mins: 120 mins, Hours: 2:00) \- Reg. Shift (Register): Planned shift � Fetched from "maintained shift schedule" module. It is the shift which is assigned for the workman every day. \- Act. Shift (Actual): punch in and out time of the employee calculated based on punching data. \- Timing of each shift, for auto scheduling will be captured from �Maintain shift timing master� in the backend. \- The system will consider only the first punch in and last punch out data and remove the duplicate punches and multiple punching data. \- The system will adjust the timing of the punching to the actual punch data in case of early punch in and late punch out. (ex: if workman punches in around 6:53 am for shift 1 and the shift start time is 7:00 am, then system will display the time as 6.53 am but will not pay any additional payment to the employee for that extra 7 mins, system will round off the extra time and will consider it as only 7:00 am, thus the employee will be only paid from 7:00 pm. Similarly for late punch out, if the shift time is 15:25 and the workman punches out at 15:35, then system should adjust the time to 15:25) \- If there is no Punch in and out data of the workman, then, system will consider it as absent (ABS). \- if remark is marked as ABS, it will remain ABS until the workman applies for PL or any other leave approval and get approved in the system. \- Based on the punch, remarks will be showed to the IR and to the employee as well (for employee it will be displayed in Kiosk). \- The system will run a schedule in real time basis and update the master card with the required punch data every day. Auto schedule will be done for yesterday's date and today's date, considering the night shift will end today.

## US-26313 — Maintain ITP Changes

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-26313 |
| State | Resolved |
| Priority | 1 |
| Assigned To | Basil Babu |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/26313) |

### Description

This requirement is raised to enhance the **Maintain ITP / NDE Summary / Stage Details** functionality in IEMQS by resolving multiple system and UI issues currently affecting user operations. The requested changes include enabling multi-selection for **Equipment Name** and **Equipment Tag Number** , correcting the **Product** and **Document No.** dropdown values, allowing more appropriate document upload options instead of restricting only to PDF cover page, making the **Sub Category** dropdown visible, enabling selection of **Main Sr No** and **Sr No** in **NDE Summary** , enabling **Main Sr No** selection in the **Stage Details** section, and correcting the disturbed column alignment in the Stage Details grid. These issues are presently preventing users from properly defining NDE summary and stage details, thereby impacting transaction completion and system usability.

### Acceptance Criteria

* The system shall allow users to select **multiple values** in the **Equipment Name** field within the applicable transaction screen. 
* The system shall allow users to select **multiple values** in the **Equipment Tag Number** field within the applicable transaction screen. 
* The **Product** dropdown shall display the **complete and correct list** of business-approved values relevant to the transaction. 
* The **Document No.** dropdown shall display only the **correct and relevant document numbers** as per the applicable business logic and record context. 
* The system shall allow upload of the **approved document/file types** as per business requirement and shall not remain restricted only to **PDF cover page** unless explicitly mandated by the finalized business rule. 
* In the **NDE Summary** section, the user shall be able to select **Main Sr No** successfully. 
* In the **NDE Summary** section, the user shall be able to select **Sr No** successfully after the relevant parent selection, wherever applicable. 
* The system shall allow the user to **save/define NDE Summary** successfully after valid selection of mandatory fields. 
* The **Sub Category** dropdown shall be **visible and functional** in the applicable section of the screen. 
* In the **Stage Details** section, the user shall be able to select **Main Sr No** successfully. 
* The system shall allow the user to **save/define Stage Details** successfully after valid selection of mandatory fields. 
* The columns in the **Stage Details** section shall be properly **aligned and readable** , with headers and row data displayed consistently. 
* No existing valid functionality in the affected module shall break after implementation of these enhancements. 
* Business users shall be able to complete the relevant transaction **without workaround or manual dependency** caused by the reported issues.

## US-26354 — Report PT, MT, RT, and UT

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| ID | US-26354 |
| State | Active |
| Priority | 1 |
| Assigned To | Santosh Soni |
| Area Path | IEMQS 4.0\New Enhancement |
| Iteration Path | IEMQS 4.0 |
| Tags |  |
| ADO URL | [Open in ADO](https://dev.azure.com/LnT-HeavyEngineering-IEMQS/Workforce%20Management%20by%20MX%20Techies/_workitems/edit/26354) |

### Description

Implement controlled **Revision functionality** for Seam-related Protocols, NDE Requests, and Test Result reports so that authorized users can revise already maintained/cleared records without disturbing the existing inspection workflow. 
Currently, QC users maintain protocols against stages, production users offer/reoffer stages, and QC users attend seams through the applicable inspection/test result screens. The requirement is to introduce a structured revision mechanism where a revision number is maintained, starting from **R0** by default, and incrementing sequentially whenever a record is revised. The revision number should be visible for tracking purposes but should not be printed on the protocol print where specifically mentioned. 
For protocol revision, a **Revision** button needs to be added on the protocol page for **QC3 and QC2 users**. The button should be visible when the stage status is not equal to **Ready to Offer**. On clicking the Revision button, the system should display a confirmation popup asking for a mandatory revise remark. Once submitted, the revision number should increment by 1, relevant fields should become editable for the QC user, and the revise remark should be saved in the protocol table along with updated **Edit By** and **Edit On** details. The previous revision’s print PDF should be saved on the FCS server before allowing changes. 
  

A **Protocol History** button should be provided to view previous revisions. The history popup should show details such as revision number, reason for revision, created by, created on, and action. On clicking the view action, the previously saved protocol print PDF from the FCS server should open. 
  

If the stage status is **Cleared** , revision changes made by QC3 should require QC2 approval. QC2 should be able to access such revised protocols from the **For Approval** tab, which is renamed from the existing **Pending Protocol** tab. The system should show an **Approve** button to QC2 users for approving protocol revision changes. 
  

The revision functionality should initially be implemented for the specified protocols, including setup, visual, and dimensional reports for longitudinal seam, circumferential seam, nozzle, formed hemispherical D’end, ellipsoidal/torispherical D’end, and pipe/flange/elbow/forging seam-related protocols. 
  

A similar revision methodology should also be implemented for **PT, MT, RT, and UT NDE Test Result Seam requests**. Once the NDE3 user clears the seam, the revise option should become visible. The system should maintain revision number, revise remark, edit details, previous revision PDF on the FCS server, and history view. Revision changes made by NDE3 should require approval from NDE2 through the **For Approval** tab, which should be visible only to NDE2 users. 
  

Additionally, revision functionality should be implemented for **PMI, Ferrite, Hardness, Chemical, PTC, and MAL reports** under Test Result for Inspection Seam. Once the QC3 user clears the seam, the Revise option should be visible. Revision changes should not affect the main workflow but should allow controlled update of identified fields. QC2 approval should be required for revision changes, and QC2 should approve the changes using the Approve button from the For Approval tab.

### Acceptance Criteria

### **1\. Revision Number Handling**
  * The system shall maintain a **Revision No.** field for applicable Protocols, NDE Requests, and Test Result reports wherever it is not already available. 
  * The default revision number shall be **R0** when the record is created for the first time. 
  * On every successful revision submission, the revision number shall be incremented by 1, for example, R0 to R1, R1 to R2, and so on. 
  * The Revision No. field shall be visible on the applicable screens for tracking/reference purposes. 
  * For protocol print, the Revision No. field shall not be displayed where specifically mentioned in the requirement. 


* * *
### **2\. Protocol Revision Functionality**
  * The system shall provide a **Revision** button on the Protocol page for **QC3 and QC2 users**. 
  * The Revision button shall be visible when the stage status is not equal to **Ready to Offer**. 
  * On clicking the Revision button, the system shall display a **Revise Confirmation** popup. 
  * The Revise Confirmation popup shall contain a mandatory **Revise Remark** field. 
  * The system shall not allow submission if the Revise Remark field is blank. 
  * On successful submission, the system shall save the revise remark in the Protocol table. 
  * The system shall update **Edit By** and **Edit On** details during revision submission. 
  * After revision is initiated, all applicable protocol fields shall become editable for the QC user. 
  * Before allowing revised data to be saved, the previous revision’s printed PDF shall be stored on the FCS server. 
  * A **Protocol History** button shall be available on the protocol screen. 
  * On clicking Protocol History, the system shall display a popup showing previous revision details. 
  * The Protocol History popup shall show revision number, reason for revision, created by, created on, and view action. 
  * On clicking the view action, the system shall open the previous revision protocol print PDF saved on the FCS server. 


* * *
### **3\. QC2 Approval for Cleared Protocol Revisions**
  * If the stage status is **Cleared** , revision changes made by QC3 shall require QC2 approval. 
  * QC2 shall access revised protocols from the **For Approval** tab. 
  * The existing **Pending Protocol** tab shall be renamed to **For Approval**. 
  * The system shall display an **Approve** button to QC2 users on applicable revised protocol records. 
  * QC2 shall be able to approve the revision changes using the Approve button. 


* * *
### **4\. Applicable Protocols**
The Revise option shall be added for the following protocols initially: 
Protocol No.| Protocol Description  
---|---  
PROTOCOL036_1 | SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM   
PROTOCOL043_1 | VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR ROLLED SHELL LONGITUDINAL SEAM   
PROTOCOL037_1 | SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM   
PROTOCOL044_1 | VISUAL AND DIMENSION REPORT FOR CIRCUMFERENTIAL SEAM   
PROTOCOL042_1 | SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR NOZZLE   
PROTOCOL047_1 | WELD VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR NOZZLE   
PROTOCOL038_1 | SET-UP INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED HEMISPHERICAL D'END   
PROTOCOL045_1 | VISUAL AND DIMENSION INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED HEMISPHERICAL D'END   
PROTOCOL041_1 | SET-UP INSPECTION REPORT FOR FORMED ELLIPSODIAL,TORISPHERICAL D'END WITH CROWN AND TIER   
PROTOCOL046_1 | VISUAL AND DIMENSION INSPECTION REPORT FOR ELLIPSOIDAL,TORISPHERICAL FORMED D'END   
PROTOCOL052_1 | SET-UP & DIMENSION REPORT FOR PIPE TO PIPE, PIPE TO FLANGE, PIPE TO ELBOW SEAM, PIPE TO FORGING, FORGING TO FLANGE, ELBOW TO FLANGE   
PROTOCOL053_1 | VISUAL & DIMENSION REPORT FOR PIPE TO PIPE, PIPE TO FLANGE, PIPE TO ELBOW SEAM, PIPE TO FORGING, FORGING TO FLANGE, ELBOW TO FLANGE   
These protocol numbers and descriptions are taken from doc. 
* * *
### **5\. NDE Request Revision Functionality**
  * The system shall provide a revise option for **PT, MT, RT, and UT** NDE Test Result Seam requests. 
  * Once the NDE3 user clears the seam, the Revise option shall become visible. 
  * The system shall maintain a Revision No. field for NDE requests wherever it is not currently maintained. 
  * The default revision number shall be **R0**. 
  * After revision, the revision number shall increment by 1. 
  * On clicking Revision, the system shall show a confirmation popup with mandatory revise remark. 
  * The revise remark shall be saved in the respective NDE request table. 
  * The system shall update **Edit By** and **Edit On** details. 
  * All existing data shall be overwritten after saving the revised data. 
  * The previous revision’s printed PDF shall be saved on the FCS server. 
  * A **History** button shall be provided to view previous revision reports. 
  * On clicking the view action in history, the system shall open the request print saved on the FCS server. 


* * *
### **6\. NDE2 Approval for NDE Revisions**
  * Revision of NDE requests performed by NDE3 shall require NDE2 approval. 
  * NDE2 shall access revised requests from the **For Approval** tab. 
  * The For Approval tab shall be visible only for NDE2 users. 
  * NDE2 shall approve revision changes using the **Approve** button. 


* * *
### **7\. Editable Fields for PT, MT, RT, and UT**
  * For PT stages, the highlighted fields mentioned in the requirement document shall become editable after revision. This change shall apply to all PT stages. 
  * For MT stages, the highlighted fields mentioned in the requirement document shall become editable after revision. This change shall apply to all MT stages. 
  * For RT stages, the highlighted fields mentioned in the requirement document shall become editable after revision. This change shall apply to all RT stages. 
  * For UT stages, the highlighted fields mentioned in the requirement document shall become editable after revision. This change shall apply to all UT stages. 
  * Revision No. shall be displayed for view purpose on applicable PT, MT, RT, and UT screens. 
  * Save and History buttons shall be available where shown in the requirement screenshots. 


* * *
### **8\. PMI, Ferrite, Hardness, Chemical, PTC, and MAL Revision Functionality**
  * The system shall provide Revise functionality for **PMI, Ferrite, Hardness, Chemical, PTC, and MAL** reports under Test Result for Inspection Seam. 
  * Once the QC3 user clears the seam, the Revise option shall become visible. 
  * Revision functionality shall allow update of data without affecting the main workflow. 
  * The system shall maintain Revision No. wherever it is not available. 
  * Default revision shall be **R0**. 
  * After revision, Revision No. shall be incremented by 1. 
  * On clicking Revision, the system shall display a confirmation popup with mandatory Revise Remark. 
  * Revise Remark shall be saved in the respective table. 
  * Edit By and Edit On shall be updated during revision. 
  * All existing data shall be overwritten after saving revised data. 
  * Previous revision print PDF shall be saved on the FCS server. 
  * QC2 approval shall be required for revision changes made by QC3. 
  * QC2 shall access revision records from the **For Approval** tab. 
  * QC2 shall approve revision changes using the **Approve** button. 


* * *
### **9\. History and PDF Storage**
  * The system shall save the previous revision’s printed PDF before overwriting existing data. 
  * The saved PDF shall be stored on the FCS server. 
  * The History popup shall allow users to view previous revision records. 
  * The view action shall open the corresponding saved PDF from the FCS server. 
  * History should include revision number, reason/remark for revision, created by, created on, and action. 


* * *
### **10\. Role-Based Visibility and Access**
  * QC3 users shall be able to revise applicable protocol and test result records after the required conditions are met. 
  * QC2 users shall be able to approve applicable QC revision records. 
  * NDE3 users shall be able to revise applicable NDE request records after the seam is cleared. 
  * NDE2 users shall be able to approve applicable NDE revision records. 
  * The For Approval tab for NDE revisions shall be visible only for NDE2 users. 
  * Approve buttons shall be visible only to the respective approval roles as applicable.
